AI developers’ and healthcare experts’ joint efforts become essential to bringing about this change, requiring a synergy that connects technology innovation with medical knowledge.

articleTitle: The Deep Investigation of the Part of AI Integ in The Field of Education: A Technical Review
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Advance Computing and Innovative Technologies in Engineering (ICACITE)
abstract: Artificial intelligence (AI) has been a force of influence changing almost every field, and the effects are massive. The paper, therefore, analyzes in deep depth the tremendous influence AI has had in the 21st century higher education. From an interdisciplinary perspective, we will delve into various ways through which AI is disrupting the traditional educational paradigms, reshaping the learning environments, and together with it, redefining the role of the educator and learner. The core areas of impact mainly include individualized learning experiences facilitated by adaptive learning systems powered by AI. AI helps in observing high levels of engagement and improvement in retention of information that will pave the way for improved academic outcomes through the offering of personalized learning pathways. Equally important, AI technologies ensure great advancements in the area of educational assessment and feedback mechanisms. The developed use of natural language processing and pattern recognition with AI-powered automated grading systems hastens the process of assessment by providing teachers with the chance to communicate useful feedback to students in time. This not only enhances the efficiency of evaluation but also fosters continuous improvement in learning outcomes.

articleTitle: A Computation of Time Management System in FTC System and Creating Strategy
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Advance Computing and Innovative Technologies in Engineering (ICACITE)
abstract: Using a use-case approach, we go into the specific ontology development, adding semantic rules to enhance its formulation and resolution. Our methodology seeks to capture the heterogeneity, variety, and complexity of data, as data itself provides these attributes. This explains why the different Big Data analytics difficulties are adaptable and scalable in a wide range of scenarios. By implementing this approach, we pave the way for the healthcare sector and beyond to use big data more effectively, improving patient outcomes through informed decision-making. This paper introduces a novel method for solving these problems: dynamics-based integer linear programming. By effectively allocating resources from dark computing to IoT devices, this method seeks to optimise workflow. It also aims to reduce stress associated with limited stealth resource containment by accelerating time-sensitive workflows and solving the termination problem as an integer linear programming (ILP) problem. Suggested With its task-first structure, the theory lowers fog node power consumption and delays in the environment by taking into account dynamic activities of greater quality. The trials’ findings demonstrate that, in terms of energy usage and service latency, the suggested strategy performs better than the experimental approaches.

articleTitle: An Optimized Framework Development of ABC Algorithm Along with SVMP Algorithm for Lung Cancer Detection
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Advance Computing and Innovative Technologies in Engineering (ICACITE)
abstract: In medicine, early detection of lung cancer is essential for successful treatment regimens. Despite the small sample size, cancer databases often include gene expression levels as attributes. Therefore, in order to increase the convergence speed of the classification algorithm, redundant features should be eliminated. In this work, we present a unique hybrid method for cancer classification called artificial bee colony with support vector machine selection. This approach for early search of a subset of genes for cancer prognosis optimizes feature selection by combining cuckoo search algorithm (CSA) and Spider-Monkey optimization (SMO) algorithm In order with increased accuracy of artificial bee colony method, we perform Minimum Redundancy Maximum Relevance (mRMR).) method, we reduce the redundancy in gene expression data from the cancer dataset and then these selected gene subsets are efficiently classified into different cancer clusters or groups using deep learning (DL) techniques. We evaluate the effectiveness of our proposed method against eight reference microarray gene expression data sets of various cancers. Classification performance is evaluated using measures such as confusion matrix, F1-score, recall, and accuracy. Our findings show that, when applied to large gene expression datasets linked to cancer, the suggested gene selection strategy in conjunction with DL provides improved classification accuracy compared to other existing DL and machine learning methods.

articleTitle: A Novel Design SDNS Framework for High end Level Communication (5G) Network
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Advance Computing and Innovative Technologies in Engineering (ICACITE)
abstract: Adding flexibility to 5G networks through circuit spinning an adaptable is a viable approach. Key components such as Network slicing, software-defined networking (SDN), and network service virtualization (NFV) are utilized in various innovative ways to enable end-to-end (E2E) isolation services. These methods facilitate the production of desired outputs, ensuring that each network slice is maintained and provisioned as necessary. The project’s goal is to develop a website with planned and efficient content distribution using machine learning, incorporating dynamic slices with updated scheduling.A list of primary Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) including CPU power, bandwidth, latency, and connectivity, are used with a substrate manufacturing device that comes equipped with a protective layer to ensure that performance is optimal and safety is not compromised. In addition, the optimization approach, namely ADAM, with an MLP, is used to create network slices. Network slices for any service that is demanded are classified as massive device-type communication (mMTC), ultra-reliable low-latency communication (uRLLC), and enhanced mobile broadband (eMBB. This classification ensures that not just network slices are provided but that the resources are provided in an optimal manner. The Dijkstra algorithm is used to allocate the resources, such that the shortest path amongst the nodes of the substrate network is determined to maximize both user accessibility and the efficiency of resource utilization. These approaches, in a comprehensive manner, are sought to be introduced to improve the efficiency of the overall system in catering to the needs of modern 5 G networks.

articleTitle: The use of Hybrid Method Using IOT and FIOT for Making Better Smart Cities
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Advance Computing and Innovative Technologies in Engineering (ICACITE)
abstract: Modern technology such as IoT, robotics, artificial intelligence, and drones are used by intelligent urban areas to improve sustainability, safety, and quality of life on their own. These advancements boost connection effectiveness, energy economy, and service quality. Many smart city applications, including “e-waste reduction, energy conservation, weather monitoring, transportation, agriculture, safety, disaster mitigation, and environmental protection,” depend on collaborative drones and the Internet of Things (IoT). This article presents a brief summary of current research on collaborative drones and IoT, with a focus on their immediate implications in enhancing smart cities.

articleTitle: An Intelligent Framework for Smart Automated House Implementation via Integration of IOT and DL
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Advance Computing and Innovative Technologies in Engineering (ICACITE)
abstract: The danger environment for the Internet of Things (IoT) has grown as a result of the widespread use of internet-connected devices, and malware detection is becoming increasingly difficult. Feature extraction, selection, and classification phases of machine learning turn it into a potent weapon against many dangers in Internet of Things environments. Particularly, in order to decrease feature size and speed up detection, feature selection is critical. Three approaches are usually used by researchers: feature reduction, feature selection, or hybrid approaches. This study examines feature selection and feature reduction for IoT malware identification using deep learning (DL) and machine learning (ML) techniques. According to the findings, feature selection by itself can lead to an accuracy rate of $94 \%$. This demonstrates that when it comes to recognizing IoT malware, feature selection works better than feature reduction.

articleTitle: Modern Control Methods to Boost Microgrid’s Performance
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Advance Computing and Innovative Technologies in Engineering (ICACITE)
abstract: Because the microgrid (MG) differs from traditional generators in its dynamic properties,, the greater penetration of RES-based MGs into the power system may have an impact on system stability. Therefore, it becomes crucial to evaluate the recently established dynamic stability issues and manage the power system’s operation in the context of growing microgrid penetration. This paper describes a microgrid system aided by renewable energy that uses an extreme learning machine (ELM)-based PID controller and superconducting magnetic energy system (SMES) storage. Microgrid contains two energy sources wind energy and PV solar panel. The energy generated by them is supplied to load and extra energy is stored in SMES. The PID controller is used in a feedback system to control the flow of energy. This research investigates in detail how the penetration of microgrids based on renewable energy affects the Stability and management of the multi-machine, multi-area system dynamically in a range of operational scenarios. A brief wind power prediction model based on ELM is developed. For this system, a new robust ELM-controlled PID-based power system stabilizer (PSS) is proposed. In spite of all the uncertainty, the system is guaranteed to stay stable by the ELM control technique. The ELM technique is used in order to optimize the controller’s parameters, and the resulting controller beats both regular PID and fractional order PID (FoPID) controllers in terms of performance. The controller’s ability to attenuate oscillations at low frequencies in a system with varying microgrid penetration percentages under varied operational settings and disturbances is evaluated using nonlinear time-domain simulations and many execution indicators.

articleTitle: Linear Graphical Optimized Cost Analysis for Balanced and Unbalanced Network Topology- Min- Min Right Algorithm and Min-Min Next Immediate Right Algorithm Approach
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Advance Computing and Innovative Technologies in Engineering (ICACITE)
abstract: The suggested method in this study is Next Immediate Right Minimum Cost. Calculating the Minimum Designation and minimizing the toll in order to determine the most feasible solution that minimizes the deviation from the basic achievable solution for the Transportation Network Problem, minimum right-side designations are linked. The suggested computation could offer a unique method for reaching the optimal, practical, and vital layout to some extent without disturbing influence of decadence condition and inferred the direct fetched organize to get the linear path for the comparing organize, to infer the Reduced for Balanced and Unbalanced Problem.

articleTitle: The Roadmap to Classify Malware Using ML Algo Through IOT Based SN
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Advance Computing and Innovative Technologies in Engineering (ICACITE)
abstract: Therefore, the Internet of Things has revolutionized the daily life of human beings with smart devices and systems, and many healthcare systems have advanced greatly in recent years. However, recent cyberattacks have shown the security flaw of current IoT in healthcare environments. Generally, current security solutions based on the classic paradigms of network security cannot adequately face the challenges posed by the particular behaviors of the IoT environments, since most of the protocols that are present show atypical behaviors, and resources are limited. In this sense, it is clear and urgent to create specific tools, methodologies, and datasets for the IoT. In light of the foregoing, we propose a new paradigm to develop context-aware security solutions also suitable for the IoT settings. The solution should be aimed at achieving the goal: Malicious communications detection. Development of open source program IoT-Flock, which can simulate IoT devices benign and malicious, as a base to test and improve IoT security; Development of a utility to convert the collected traffic into standard IoT dataset to be used for further analysis and research; and As a proof of concept, we create an IoT healthcare dataset from benign and attack scenarios. We use several machine learning techniques to analyze the data and detect cyber-attacks, thus fortifying security from threats that might occur in a healthcare system..

articleTitle: The Development of Structured Tele Based Medicine Concept Using Programmable System
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Advance Computing and Innovative Technologies in Engineering (ICACITE)
abstract: In the medical field, clinics and hospitals frequently use dispersed applications like telediagnosis. These apps must nevertheless provide information security in order to properly transit security measures like firewalls and proxies. The User Datagram Protocol (UDP) is often recommended for videoconferencing applications because of its low latency; nevertheless, security problems occur when UDP tries to pass through firewalls and proxies without a specified set of fixed ports. In order to overcome these obstacles, this study presents a revolutionary platform that uses Transmission Control Protocol (TCP) rather of UDP: VAGABOND, which stands for “Video Adaptation framework, across security gateways, based on transcription,” Adaptation Proxies (APs) that are designed to accommodate user preferences, device variations, and dynamic changes in network capacity comprise VAGABOND. This platform’s versatility at the user and network levels guarantees seamless operation in a range of scenarios. VAGABOND uses a binomial probability distribution to start making adaptation decisions. This distribution is formed from the retention of video packets inside a certain time period. VAGABOND gets beyond firewall and proxy constraints by using ordinary TCP ports (like 80 or 443) to provide videoconferencing data via TCP. But even though TCP is a dependable transport protocol, it can occasionally have latency and socket timeout problems. VAGABOND has clever adaptation techniques to deal with these problems and ensure smooth data transfer.

articleTitle: Enhancement of Level of Security using Wireshark Through Continuous Monitoring and Detection System
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Advance Computing and Innovative Technologies in Engineering (ICACITE)
abstract: We suggest using edge computing to install an intrusion detection system (IDS) at the network edge in order to address the problem of intrusion detection in wireless sensor networks (WSNs). This IDS functions as a proactive defence system designed specifically with WSNs in mind. Our method combines an arithmetic optimisation algorithm (AOA) with Wireshark and machine learning to create an edge intelligence framework for identifying denial-of-service (DoS) assaults in wireless sensor networks (WSNs). We use the wireshark for optimisation adjustment and a parallel strategy to promote communication between populations in order to increase model accuracy. Our model achieves $\mathbf{9 8 . 9 \%}$ accuracy (ACC) through simulated studies utilising the IDS dataset in Matlab2018b. The effectiveness and practical significance of our suggested intrusion detection approach are highlighted by these experimental results.

articleTitle: Promoting Reliable Artificial Intelligence by Means of an Ethical Foundation for Trust Evaluation
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Advance Computing and Innovative Technologies in Engineering (ICACITE)
abstract: The transformative potential of AI raises serious moral questions for organizations and calls into question the need for trust. Many ethical frameworks are often offered in order to solve this, but only on a theoretical level. Additionally, workers need efficient trust calibration in AI. There hasn’t been much research done on how an ethical framework might help workers in practice calibrate their trust appropriately. This study introduces a framework for adaptive trust calibration in human-Al cooperation, comprising trust equations, a trust calibration cue (TCC), and a trust calibration Al (TCAI). Human-Al cooperation involves a series of actions where users decide between Al and manual execution based on task requirements. The responsibility for task outcomes lies with the user. Trust equations define over-trust and under-trust, facilitating the assessment of trust calibration status. The TCC notifies users of improper trust calibration, while the TCAI manages the adaptive calibration process. The framework aims to prompt users to recalibrate trust dynamically, mitigating over-trust or under-trust through timely interventions.

articleTitle: MPLS: A Way to Achieve Optimized Framework for Secured Transmission of Data in Various Cloud Environments
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Advance Computing and Innovative Technologies in Engineering (ICACITE)
abstract: Traditional MPLS-based recovery methods, such as link-based and one-to-one dedicated routing methods, typically use multiple resources. To address this issue, we offer a new approach called the Common Protection Path (CPP) that provides better resource management. Methods/Accounts. Unlike existing methods, CPP considers factors such as route failure probability and first return position when selecting a shared safety channel for traffic flows with identical intake and egress routers We real-world COST with link capabilities used ns-2 simulations to evaluate the efficiency of the CPP in a 239 network. Dedicated single channels, network-based systems, and modified UNIFR (RFNS) with UNIFR-like names all stood out significantly. Our findings show that CPP outperforms conventional methods in providing more efficient bandwidth protection and handling higher levels of traffic congestion. In MPLS-based recovery systems, the CPP scheme offers a significant improvement in resource utilization, with interesting implications for switching and network management.

articleTitle: Numerical Analysis of Cu-water Nanofluid flow in a Darcy-Forchheimer Porous Medium under the Combined Effects of Magnetic Field, Suction/Blowing, Stretchable Surface and Radiation
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Advance Computing and Innovative Technologies in Engineering (ICACITE)
abstract: The article looks at what happens when you mix the effects of a magnetic field, suction/blowing, a flexible surface, and radiation on the flow of a Cu-water nanofluid in a Darcy-Forchheimer porous medium (DFPM). A Cartesian coordinate system and a rough border layer are used to show the governing equations. A similarity analysis is used to turn the system of partial differential equations (DEs) into a higher-order system of coupled-ordinary DEs. The Keller box method is then used to solve this system. A graph shows how the effects of several things work together. The main findings show that increasing the Forchheimer, magnetic, porous, and suction/injection factors slows things down. Also, the Forchheimer, magnetic, and porous properties slow down the rate of heat transfer, while force or injection does the opposite.

articleTitle: Image Detection For Visually Impaired
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Advance Computing and Innovative Technologies in Engineering (ICACITE)
abstract: Visual impairment is on the major setbacks for the people suffering from it in society. The age of modernism has created an opportunity for the technological world to make this challenge easier for people suffering from it. The proposed image detection technique uses MATLAB’s image processing technique to tackle the challenge. Generating output in the form of audio from the visual environment and providing information for visually impaired people. The implementation of MATLAB based technique requires collaboration of various disciplines of electronics field such as Weiner filtration, RGB, Gray-scaling which eventually converts pixels in audio format for people with visual impairment. The aim is to achieve an audio output from visual data which can eventually be fed to audio output devices for betterment in understanding of physical world to people suffering from visual impairment. [1]

articleTitle: The Plant’s Leaf Identification using G-A-N and Using IA Technique
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Advance Computing and Innovative Technologies in Engineering (ICACITE)
abstract: The identification of the disease of paddy leaves is a very critical issue, as it is quite hard with the naked eye, and even professionals like agricultural scientists may make mistakes in this regard. This is a problem that our approach, which we undertake in this paper, may remedy. In this paper, we present deep learning with the use of generative adversarial networks in leaf disease diagnosis using artificial intelligence. In our experiment, we used a dataset with 12,880 paddy leaf images produced by Cycle GAN, displaying five main disease classifications. GANs should be taken into consideration while data augmentation is performed to prevent overfitting, while a GAN design that uses two networks-a Generator and a Discriminator-is suggested. The generator was taught to produce samples of data that are comparable to the original data. The deep learning proposed approach can be regarded as an important tool for early disease identification in the detection and classification of paddy leaf diseases.

articleTitle: A Discussion of Improving Efficiency and Addressing Obstacles with the use of Data mining and IoT for crop production
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Advance Computing and Innovative Technologies in Engineering (ICACITE)
abstract: The advancement of industries such as supply chain management, smart grids, and healthcare has been made possible by the Internet of Things (IoT), which also improves people’s daily lives and interactions. However, the growing size and complexity of IoT networks pose challenges in security, authenticity, reliability, and scalability. Blockchain emerges as a solution due to its security, transparency, reliability, and traceability. This study examines the problems with Internet of Things (IoT) systems, talks about how blockchain might help solve them, assesses the state of the art, and suggests a two-layer architectural solution that combines blockchain and IoT utilizing dew and cloudlet computing. This study presents an analysis of a blockchain-based trade origination and verification system, comparing its performance to the Hyperledger Fabric framework. The system comprises three phases: Trade Origination, Verification & Authentication, and Commit. Through experiments, the system demonstrates superior performance in transaction validation, block closing times, and memory scalability as the number of trades and participating nodes increases.

articleTitle: The simplified and enlarged memory management with efficiency through cells
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Advance Computing and Innovative Technologies in Engineering (ICACITE)
abstract: Memory with multiple ports is widely employed in numerous domains, especially for parallel computations that require rapidity and efficiency. Conventional SRAM-based memory modules encounter constraints on performance and flexibility, including the need to handle a multitude of write inputs and read outputs. Standard cell-based memory, in contrast, provides greater parameterization and flexibility. However, current tools encounter difficulties in constructing these memories as a result of intricate circuitry and a lack of understanding regarding the regular structure of these arrays. This may occasionally lead to an inability to converge under specific circumstances. New techniques for the physical and logical implementation of many-ported standard cell memory (MPSCMs) are introduced in this study. It is suggested that the traditional design process be substituted with two discrete methodologies that offer direction and control to design tools in order to improve the performance, area utilisation, and power efficiency of these memory arrays. An assessment and evaluation process was undertaken on MPSCM macros of different dimensions utilising a commercial 65 nm CMOS technology. These macros were compared to their equivalents that were developed employing conventional and cutting-edge techniques.

articleTitle: An analysis of the Technological and Economic viability ofa Microgrid that uses Hybrid Renewable Energy resources to Electrify rural Areas
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Advance Computing and Innovative Technologies in Engineering (ICACITE)
abstract: This study demonstrates that H.R.E.S. (hybrid re- newable energy systems) are technically and economically feasible for use in applications of electrification in rural areas. Using village-owned renewable resources like solar radiation, biomass, etc., develop an enhanced-performance electrical system. This study’s primary goal was to develop a perfect and affordable design for a hybrid energy source, combining photovoltaic and biomass power generation, for a residential and farm locality in a village of Farrukhabad (coordinates: 27.387049, 79.588127), Uttar Pradesh. Data on the amount of electricity used for household and irrigation purposes was gathered. The HOMER software provided these outcomes, which showing a cost-effective alternative of hybrid energy system.

articleTitle: A Technical Review on Composite of Components Used in Textile Industry Identification using ML Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Advance Computing and Innovative Technologies in Engineering (ICACITE)
abstract: This check delves into the fusion of device gaining knowledge of with textile-based totally sensors, aiming to pioneer smart wearable products for fashionable human motion tracking. Utilizing the progressive combination of single-walled carbon nanotubes (SWCNTs) and spandex cloth (PET/SP), we engineered stretchable fabric sensors. These sensors aren’t truly sensitive and bendy however, even as blanketed with device gaining knowledge of algorithms, pave the manner for a wearable technology able to real-time, correct human movement kind. This research stands on the intersection of advanced substances technological expertise and computational intelligence, providing a completely unique technique to wearable technology. It demonstrates the potential of smart textiles superior with device studying to revolutionize non-public healthcare and athletic overall performance evaluation. The very last consequence of this exploration is a promising step toward wearable devices that now not best provide unique movement detection but also introduce a new size to tracking and know-how human physiology and motion styles in remarkable detail.

articleTitle: Increasing Prediction Accuracy using Pca-Regression Technique in Ehwsn
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Advance Computing and Innovative Technologies in Engineering (ICACITE)
abstract: Energy Harvested Wireless Sensor Networks (EHWSN) play a vital role in mission-critical applications such as forest fire detection and industrial control and safety applications. Accurate solar forecasting is essential for the proper design of the Medium Access Control protocol (MAC). Recent work has focused on considering only a single variable, i.e., previous solar data, for solar forecasting, resulting in low accuracy. In the proposed work, covariance among the features was determined using Principal Component Analysis (PCA). Only those features showing strong correlations were retained. Subsequently, the KNN-Regression technique, applied with the reduced feature set, demonstrated a significant improvement over the previous method. The proposed approach achieved an accuracy of 92.47% with a Root Mean Square Error (RMSE) of 11.52, compared to the previous figures of 85.14 and 17.11, respectively.

articleTitle: Identification Emoticon Meaning using Facial Expression via Inception V3 as Well as KNN Methods
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Advance Computing and Innovative Technologies in Engineering (ICACITE)
abstract: Recognising emotions in people is essential to understanding human behaviour since it allows for correct perception and suitable reactions to people’s emotional states. In order to get a deeper understanding of complicated human behaviour, researchers meticulously examine a variety of physical indications across modalities, such as facial expressions, verbal signals, and body language. The ability of spontaneous multi-modal emotion identification to collect and understand emotions in real time is shown by the current spike in interest in this field, highlighting the importance of combining audio input with facial expressions. In order to tackle the difficulties associated with speech emotion identification, this research makes use of the RAVDESS dataset and applies deep learning techniques, such as inception V3 and KNN models. The librosa package is used to extract spectrograms, and KNN models are employed to recognise speech emotions. The study also combines methods from video-based emotion recognition with point-wise convolution for frame analysis. The main goal of this project is to improve real-time emotion identification, which has potential uses in the fields of software engineering, gaming, education, and personalised online experiences. Metrics like accuracy, precision, and confusion matrix may be used to do a thorough assessment of the suggested multimodal emotion detection system.

articleTitle: The Intensive Analysis of the Peddling Signal Routing for GPS System
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Advance Computing and Innovative Technologies in Engineering (ICACITE)
abstract: In the research community, vehicular ad hoc networks, or VANETs, are a unique paradigm in wireless networking. Vehicle-to-Vehicle (V2V) communication is a fundamental feature that is particularly important for improving driver and passenger safety and convenience. A major issue for routing, a crucial component of VANETs, is the dynamic nature of vehicular nodes and the frequently changing network architecture. Position-based routing protocols, on the other hand, have grown in popularity as an attractive alternative to VANETs because they can utilize location information to adapt to changing environments. Although a number of position-based routing protocols have been created to help with message routing in VANETs using greedy forwarding techniques, only a small portion of them show effectiveness in extremely dynamic networks. This study presents a summary and comparative analysis of current position-based routing protocols, emphasising those that use neighbour and destination node position prediction. We qualitatively analyse performance metrics such as packet delivery ratio and end-to-end latency using the NS-2 emulator

articleTitle: A Development of 5G Wireless Sensor Network using Man Design
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Advance Computing and Innovative Technologies in Engineering (ICACITE)
abstract: This article investigates the key drivers influencing the design of the forthcoming Metropolitan Area Network (MAN), focusing on the integration of two pivotal elements: Cloud Radio Access Network (C-RAN) for 5G implementation and the deployment of edge computing. As we delve into these aspects, the article systematically uncovers the crucial architectural components essential for effectively addressing the challenges inherent in implementing C-RAN and edge computing. Through this strategic approach, the objective is to ensure a cost-effective solution that aligns with the specific requirements of these applications. The article aims to provide insights into the symbiotic relationship between CRAN and 5G, emphasizing their collaborative role in enhancing network efficiency. Simultaneously, it underscores the significance of edge computing, highlighting its potential to optimize data processing and reduce latency within the evolving landscape of metropolitan networks. This comprehensive exploration contributes to a nuanced understanding of the future MAN design, grounded in innovative solutions and considerations for seamless integration.

articleTitle: MRP System to Improve the Quality of QOS Optimization System in the Field of WMSN
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Advance Computing and Innovative Technologies in Engineering (ICACITE)
abstract: The technologies of Named Data Networking (NDN) such as multipath routing protocol and Edge Cloud Computing (ECC), QoS optimization are critical to the evolution of the Internet, especially when it comes to the fast information transmission required for 6 G and other next-generation networks. This paper explores the synergistic potential of integrating NDN and ECC, aiming to enhance network utility, QoS and routing in wireless multimedia sensor networks. Our proposed framework adopts an N-Tier architecture, with NDN forming Tier 1, connecting IoT devices to Tier 2 (Edge Computing), and further extending to Tier 3 (Cloud Computing) via Microsoft Azure Cloud servers. Through this integration, we focus on achieving expedited information response times. We deploy an NDN-based ECC system and assess its performance using simulations and testbed experiments. We analyze at metrics including round trip time (RTT), service search time, and interest aggregation with different traffic loads. Our results show how effective it is to employ NDN in conjunction with edge computing to minimize backbone network congestion, process massive amounts of data quickly in real time, and drastically cut latency-all of which contribute to smooth user experiences.

articleTitle: The Unique Way of Designing SNN Network for Content Recommending System using Hybrid Algorithms
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Advance Computing and Innovative Technologies in Engineering (ICACITE)
abstract: In the rapidly evolving panorama of e-commerce, personalised apparel recommendation systems stand as a pinnacle of technological advancement, aiming to reflect the intricacies of human style feel and social interactions on-line. This paper offers a singular technique via using Siamese Neural Networks (SNN) to research and integrate style fashion consistency with user social circle data, thereby addressing the pervasive challenges of bloodless start and records sparsity in traditional collaborative filtering systems. Our methodology leverages huge statistics from a distinguished social fashion platform, demonstrating good sized upgrades in advice personalization and accuracy. This integration no longer handiest enhances the user experience by way of providing tailor-made fashion suggestions however additionally marks a great step forward within the application of neural networks in the realm of fashion e-commerce.

articleTitle: The Effective Detection of Alzheimer in the System via ML Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Advance Computing and Innovative Technologies in Engineering (ICACITE)
abstract: Effective therapy for Alzheimer’s disease depends on early diagnosis. Key results from four research that used machine learning to detect Alzheimer’s disease during its initial level. Early research indicates that combining cognitive and neuropsychological data may enhance diagnosis. The second research interprets neuroimaging data using machine learning methods. Finding the first signs of illness is the objective here. In the third research, risk variables for Alzheimer’s defect conditions are detected using machine learning algorithms. They stress the need of comprehensive data for precise prediction. A novel algorithm is presented in the fourth research. The soft voting classifier method increases recognition accuracy by operating on an averaging mechanism. These papers demonstrate how machine learning may enhance approaches for diagnosing Alzheimer’s disease. To enhance therapeutic results, combine everything from cognitive evaluations to multimodal data.

articleTitle: Cost Analysis for Rectangular Balanced and Unbalanced Transportation Matrix With Minimum Supply And Minimum Demand Support of its Right-Side Minimum Cost
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Advance Computing and Innovative Technologies in Engineering (ICACITE)
abstract: Next Immediate right of supply or demand Minimum allotment strategy and we also discuss least supply or demand Least right-side allotment represents modifications to Vogel’s approximate method to obtain an initial solution to the unbalance transport problem. In this paper, we have suggested one more modification that may lead to better initial solutions.

articleTitle: An Innovative Design of SH System using T and L Techniques
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Advance Computing and Innovative Technologies in Engineering (ICACITE)
abstract: The project begins with gathering a lot of data from different hotels and accommodation facilities in different places. The recommendation system is built on this large dataset, which allows it to provide customised recommendations according to user needs. An essential component of this dataset’s enrichment is user input. Through the process of integrating and evaluating user preferences and views, the system leverages an extensive data set that is crucial for making appropriate hotel recommendations. Because of this user-centric approach, the suggested solutions are guaranteed to closely match the preferences of travellers for their lodging. The problem of selecting the ideal hotel for a certain trip time is one of the main issues our project attempts to solve. The technology does a great job of offering insightful data that helps consumers find the perfect hotel for their trip dates. The technique for the project takes a multifaceted approach. There is much focus on data preparation in addition to data collection. This stage of preparation guarantees that the data gathered is streamlined and optimised for further examination. Utilising the NLTK package and the Python programming language, the system makes use of sophisticated methods like tokenization and lemmatization This is a crucial stage since it enables the system to interpret and handle text-based data effectively. The user-facing interface that displays suggestions is one of the project’s primary deliverables. A carefully selected list of the top five hotels that most closely fit their needs is given to users. This carefully chosen assortment streamlines the decision-making process and provides consumers with practical options to suit their demands for lodging.

articleTitle: The use of Ontology in Diagnosing LC: A Detailed Framework Discussion
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Advance Computing and Innovative Technologies in Engineering (ICACITE)
abstract: Accurate diagnosis and classification of lung cancer is essential for effective surgical management and drug development. The complexity of this effort comes from the difficulty of analyzing CT (computed tomography) images. Our proposed solution reduces false positives, segments jumps, and classifies images as normal and abnormal using deep learning techniques using fuzzy-K-means clustering The system has two main methods: Feature extraction, preprocessing, and classification phase: Texture features extracted after preprocessing input CT image. Crow search optimization methods are used to select features, and artificial neural networks are used to classify images as correct or incorrect. The ontology and fuzzy K-means method is then used to analyze the abnormal images for tumor classification. To reduce false positives, a support vector machine (SVM) classifier and ontology is used in this step. Impressive outcomes are obtained by the suggested approach, which successfully lowers false positives while achieving a $\mathbf{9 6 \%}$ accuracy rate, 100% specificity, and $99 \%$ sensitivity. Experimental results show improved sensitivity, specificity, and accuracy when compared to previous studies. In addition, our system achieves a notable reduction in computing time by finding a compromise between efficiency and efficacy. Our approach demonstrates a straightforward yet effective combination of deep learning techniques with fuzzy K-means clustering.

articleTitle: A Novel Way of Finding the Irregularity Present in the System Through Design of CPS System
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Advance Computing and Innovative Technologies in Engineering (ICACITE)
abstract: Strong security measures are required as Cyber-Physical Systems (CPSs) have developed into extremely sophisticated and complicated systems. However, classic anomaly detection approaches are facing difficulties because to the increase of sophisticated assaults and the growing complexity of CPSs. Furthermore, a major obstacle is the increase in data volume, which necessitates domain-specific expertise for efficient analysis. To address these issues, several deep learning-based anomaly detection systems have been created. In this work, we provide a unique approach to anomaly detection by the combination of a powerful deep learning technique, Convolutional Neural Network (CNN), with a Gaussian-Mixture Model (GMM) based on the Kalman Filter and ontology (KF). Our proposed method seeks to detect and distinguish odd behavior in CPSs. The framework has two crucial processes. The first stage in data preparation is to securely prepare the original data for usage in a new format. We provide our second introduction, the GMM-KF-BiLSTM integrated deep CNN model for anomaly detection, which enables precise estimation of posterior probability for both anomalous and normal events in CPSs.

articleTitle: Hybrid Based Wheelchair Design Module using MT And IOT
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Advance Computing and Innovative Technologies in Engineering (ICACITE)
abstract: Every day, technology in the globe advances. As each second goes by, new technologies come into being, and human knowledge continues to grow. Since the beginning of time, mankind has struggled with several issues, one of which is the provision of safe and unfettered movement for those who are physically handicapped. This is our crude attempt to assist folks who rely less on human labour as the world revolves around automation. In this research, an IoT-enabled hybrid wheelchair is designed to assist those with innate mobility problems. It is equipped with a number of sensors, a camera, and mobile applications to guarantee risk-free and unconstrained movement. Two unique modes of the wheel chair are intended to accommodate the physically and visually handicapped, respectively.

articleTitle: Development of Structure For Reliability Kind of Assessment Through Artificial Intelligence
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Advance Computing and Innovative Technologies in Engineering (ICACITE)
abstract: The transformative potential of AI raises serious moral questions for companies and calls into question the need for trust. To address this, several ethical frameworks are commonly proposed, if only in theory. AI is also necessary for workers to appropriately measure trust. There aren’t many studies that address how an ethical framework may help employees calibrate their practical trust. To ensure trust calibration and reduce this gap, research is being done on an ethical framework that centres on AI safety and reliability. Finally, an assessment of the efficacy of the deployed framework is conducted through interviews conducted at a multinational automotive supplier. This ethical foundation thus led to a significant rise in trust. This is a groundbreaking finding: workers are willing to tolerate a lesser level of AI safety as long as AI reliability is preserved.

articleTitle: The Efficient Energy Routing Strategy Making Through Hybrid Techniques of ANFIS and SVM
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Advance Computing and Innovative Technologies in Engineering (ICACITE)
abstract: Due to their reliance on batteries for power, conventional wireless sensor networks (WSNs) continue to have significant energy-related limitations. Consequently, prolonging the lifespan and enhancing the performance of WSNs requires improved energy efficiency. The aim of this study is to address WSN energy utilisation by selecting relay nodes and cluster heads (CH) using adaptive neuro-fuzzy inference system (ANFIS) and support vector machine (SVM). The CH is required for data transmission and collection from all other nodes in the cluster, and the book concentrates on advanced optimisation approaches to reduce power usage at this node. By dramatically decreasing energy consumption at the relay node and CH by 30%, the recommended optimisation strategy enhances WSN’s energy-efficient operations and extends its lifespan. This paper presents the development and impact of the revolutionary optimisation technique.

articleTitle: Comparative Docking Strategies for Alzheimer’s Therapy: Exploring Drug and Phytocompound Interactions with BIN1 Protein
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Advance Computing and Innovative Technologies in Engineering (ICACITE)
abstract: One of the main culprits of dementia is Alzheimer’s disease which is a progressive one, marked by a steady decline in cognitive functions, notably affecting memory, logical reasoning, and decision-making processes. It stands as the predominan cause of dementia, progressively impeding individuals’ daily lives by hindering their capacity to perform even fundamental day-today activities. Most instances of AD typically manifest late on set and involve multiple contributing factors. Through genome-wid association studies, over 30 loci have been recognized in connection with sporadic Alzheimer’s disease (SAD), among them the Bridging Integrator 1 (BIN1). Herein, we performed docking of the BAR domain of the BIN1 protein using FDA-approved clinical and pre-clinical kinase inhibitors for neurological disorders, along with certain phytocompounds with anti-cancer properties as the target ligands. We recommend Sirolimus and Cryptotanshinone drugs for BIN1 gene downregulation as a therapeutic technique for tackling the progression of AD.

articleTitle: The Development of ID System for Detecting Attacks in WSN Through Ontology Method and its Strategy
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Advance Computing and Innovative Technologies in Engineering (ICACITE)
abstract: Cybercriminals are becoming increasingly targeted by the rapid expansion of the Internet of Things (IoT), leading to an increase in cyberattacks targeting IoT devices and their communication channels These attacks, if failure to detect may result in significant service disruption, financial loss or damage to sensitive data. Real-time intrusion detection is essential to ensure reliability, security and profitability of IoT applications. This study introduces a new intrusion detection system designed for IoT devices that uses deep learning (DL). Utilizing ontology in wireless sensor networks (WSN), this intelligent system detects suspicious activities that pose a threat to connected IoT devices with configuration-neutral design provides ease of use, while the test performance analysis is simulated and real-world. It highlights its strong performance in determining admissions. The effectiveness of the system against many types of attacks such as denial of service, workholes, blackholes, opportunistic service attacks, etc. is confirmed by experimental research and furthermore, the system achieves F1 scores, accuracy and the number of memories. This advanced deep learning intrusion detection system shows great promise to improve IoT network security due to its high detection rate.

articleTitle: A Well-Structured Data Sharing System Implementation using EC Technology and Higher end Communication Network
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Advance Computing and Innovative Technologies in Engineering (ICACITE)
abstract: Vehicular traffic networks (VANETs) are an important part of modern transportation systems, focusing on critical applications such as collision avoidance, lane change assistance, and traffic recognition. However, data distribution in VANETs is very challenging, especially due to the unique characteristics of wireless communications and the dynamic traffic environment. In this context, packet delivery control is very important for proper communication. In this paper, research proposes a new Computer defined Vehicle Network (SDVN) Controlled Routing and Scheduling (CDRS) method to solve the complex data distribution problem of VANET unlike existing approaches, CDRS uses SDVN management functions to integrate a routing strategy and a scheduling strategy that optimizes multihop data transmission. Priorities in CDRS are based on routing and scheduling constraints. Current protocols focus on finding the shortest path connecting source and destination pairs, ignoring factors such as packet proximity and link length, but performance is limited in dynamic VANET environments. Similarly, current scheduling approaches focus on single-hop data distribution and ignore the << potential benefits of multihop transmission over multiple channels. To solve these problems, CDRS formulates the data allocation problem as an integer linear programming (ILP) model that aims to maximize the number of packets sent and minimize the service interval. CDRS ensures efficient data transmission over the network by effectively allocating resources taking into account packet length, link length, and different types of channels (e.g., vehicle-to-vehicle traffic and vehicle-to-vehicle infrastructure) The simulation results show that CDRS performs better in both routing and scheduling methods. Through comprehensive evaluations, CDRS continues to achieve higher delivery rates, reduced service delays, and better differentiation between real-time and virtual transactions. Additionally, CDRS has proven to be effective across a variety of network sizes and marketing methods. The simulation results show that CDRS has the best performance compared to conventional routing and scheduling methods. Through comprehensive evaluations, CDRS continues to achieve higher production rates, reduce service delays and improve the differentiation between real-time and virtual trading. Furthermore, the robustness of CDRS is demonstrated over a variety of network sizes and traffic conditions, demonstrating its ability to deliver performance in a variety of VANET environments.

articleTitle: USE of DL technique to make detailed flow for detecting COVID
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Advance Computing and Innovative Technologies in Engineering (ICACITE)
abstract: COVID-19, often known as the coronavirus sickness of 2019, is a fast-spreading virus-related disease that has affected masses of people worldwide. Given its rapid spread and growing number, the healthcare personnel are finding it impossible to manage. Determine the disease and stop it from spreading. Consequently, it changed into the diagnostic procedure must be automated. This effectiveness will help to prevent the spread of the infection among healthcare personnel. One of the more recent academic fields that can address these concerns is medical image analysis. This essay contrasts and compares the utilization of Current deep learning models include VGG16, VGG19, DenseNet121, DenseNet169 and DenseNet201 to cope with the identification and classification of from cases of non-covid and covid-19. This study uses 7200 chest X-ray images from individuals with non-covid (3600) and COVID-19 (3600). Each technique was examined by means of performance and confusion metrics. Results indicate VGG series when compared to the other pretrained model performance was better.

articleTitle: The Development of Framework Design Using AI for VC in 5G N/W
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Advance Computing and Innovative Technologies in Engineering (ICACITE)
abstract: This paper provides an introduction to the 5G mobile network testbed, with the proposed idea of using containers for architectures’ virtualization and orchestration. This testbed is integrated using open technologies and methods for the flexible deployment of virtual network functions under the scenario of applying integrated artificial intelligence features to boost the performance of an AI-driven network and, hence, reduce costs. For example, this work presents the versatile testbed architecture engineered to support the integration of AI agents for performance enhancement of mobile network functionalities. The performance of the testbed and its relevance are validated by the performance evaluation of two use cases, namely RAN slicing and VNF placement. For example, RAN-slicing applications take advantage of FlexRAN and Ryu controllers to dynamically allocate resources based on slice requirements, whereas supervised learning ensures an optimal resource allocation. This study has proved that AI-driven resource allocation ensures throughput and SLA requirements much better than traditional methods. Similarly, the testbed supports VNF placement applications, where several placement scenarios are evaluated and the VNF placement is dynamically altered in accordance with the output of ML models to offer massive improvement in latency and meet SLA requirements. The overall results of the evaluation are a demonstration of the potential of the testbed to simulate and test AI-driven enhancements in mobile networks by providing a flexible environment to research on many AI algorithms and methodologies in optimizing resource allocation and enhancing network performance.

articleTitle: Analyzing speech patterns for Parkinson’s diagnosis: Insights from ML models
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Advance Computing and Innovative Technologies in Engineering (ICACITE)
abstract: Parkinson’s disease (PD) is the most ubiquitous neurological disease in the globe which affects the human neurological system. It is a primary concern to detect PD in its early stages to slow down its progress with proper treatment and foster a better quality of life for affected individuals. PD primarily impacts motor and cognitive function, recent studies also revealed that $\mathbf{9 0 \%}$ of Parkinson’s patients encounter speech difficulties in the preliminary phase of the disease. In the framework of this study, we have conducted a comparative analysis of various machine learning (ML) models, including Support Vector Machine (SVM), Gaussian Naïve Bayes (GNB), K-Nearest Neighbors (KNN), Decision Tree (DT), Logistic Regression (LR), Random Forest (RF), Extreme Gradient Boosting (XGB), and Principal Component Analysis (PCA), for the precise identification of PD in early phase using a speech dataset. Three different approaches are employed for classification. The XGB model performed remarkably well, with $98.30 \%$ accuracy and $96.67 \%$ precision. The results hold significant promise for enhancing early-stage PD diagnosis in healthcare centres as well as within the home environment.

articleTitle: An Extensive Examination of Different Phases Available in Enhancing the Power of WSN
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Advance Computing and Innovative Technologies in Engineering (ICACITE)
abstract: In this whole test, we delve into the evolution and transformative ability of Wireless Sensor Networks (WSNs), emphasizing the pivotal position of graphical statistics in elucidating the technological improvements and stressful conditions interior this region. By harnessing the energy of the IEEE 802.15.4 general, this research provides an in-intensity analysis of WSNs’ operational efficiencies, energy consumption styles, and network resilience through meticulously designed graphs and information visualizations. These graphical representations now not only offer a easy and concise overview of WSN universal performance metrics but additionally spotlight the giant enhancements completed thru the implementation of a singular WSN framework. The examiner’s findings underscore the vital importance of empirical statistics visualization in advancing our knowledge of WSN technologies, offering valuable insights into the optimization strategies that may result in extra power-inexperienced, reliable, and scalable sensor networks. This research contributes to the continued communicate in the subject, paving the manner for future enhancements and programs of WSNs across several sectors.

articleTitle: A Deep Assessment of ML Based Procedure used as a Classifiers in the Clinical Field
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Advance Computing and Innovative Technologies in Engineering (ICACITE)
abstract: In the unexpectedly evolving panorama of healthcare technology, the mixing of data mining and machine mastering gives exceptional possibilities for the advancement of sickness prediction fashions. This research paper introduces a unique Machine Learning Smart Health Procedure designed to harness the predictive energy of those era for forecasting illnesses. By meticulously reading ancient healthcare facts, which includes affected individual signs and symptoms and effects, this system leverages cutting-edge algorithms which includes Naïve Bayes, Support Vector Machines (SVM), and neural networks to expect capacity health problems with accelerated accuracy. This method now not best pursuits to facilitate early and specific evaluation but also strives to noticeably enhance affected individual care and treatment consequences. Through the strategic utility of statistics mining and prediction analysis in the healthcare area, our proposed machine demonstrates the capacity to revolutionize conventional diagnostic techniques, developing a proactive and predictive healthcare model more plausible and effective than ever earlier than.

articleTitle: Empirical Analysis of Developing EC Based Algorithms for Various WSN Network Applications
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Advance Computing and Innovative Technologies in Engineering (ICACITE)
abstract: Wi-Fi Sensor Networks (WSNs) have emerged as a transformative era for several applications, from environmental monitoring to protection systems, due to improvements in wi-fi verbal exchange and sensor technologies. The deployment of Mobile Wireless Sensor Networks (MWSNs) introduces the task of maximizing community lifetime at the equal time as making sure green facts series and processing. This test proposes a novel technique to extend the lifetime of MWSNs by using way of leveraging Evolutionary Computing (EC) techniques. Through a comparative assessment of five EC algorithms-Genetic Algorithms (GA), Differential Evolution (DE), Particle Swarm Optimization (PSO), Artificial Bee Colony (ABC), and Neighborhood Field Optimization (NFO)-the research highlights the strengths and limitations of every method in optimizing the energy performance of MWSNs. The results show the functionality of EC strategies in enhancing the sustainability and operational basic overall performance of WSNs, presenting treasured insights for destiny studies and realistic programs in the subject.

articleTitle: An Overview of Obstacles in 5G Backhaul and Latest Studies
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Advance Computing and Innovative Technologies in Engineering (ICACITE)
abstract: 5G, the upcoming cellular generation, addresses data rate demands and facilitates the Internet of Things. While research focuses on radio challenges, including network densification and advanced features, a new bottleneck emerges: backhaul. This survey explores the 5G backhaul paradigm, critiques existing solutions, and proposes a consolidated framework. This study presents two backhaul frameworks aimed at optimizing energy consumption in different network environments. The first framework, EMMA (Energy Management for Software Switch Networks), focuses on SDN/NFV-based integrated backhaul/fronthaul transport networks, targeting efficient power consumption monitoring and device power state optimization. The EMMA prototype, deployed in the 5TONIC laboratory, leverages Lagopus software switches and an OpenDaylight SDN controller to dynamically regulate power states based on traffic load. Functional validation demonstrates significant improvements in service provisioning time. The second framework addresses energy optimization in mmWave meshed networks overlaid on LTE macro cells, crucial for dense urban scenarios. The Energy Management for Meshed Access (EMMA) algorithm intelligently controls mmWave node activation to reduce energy consumption while maintaining user connectivity. System-level simulations reveal substantial energy-saving potential, particularly with the network- centric approach, which prioritizes energy efficiency without compromising user experience.

articleTitle: A Design of Efficient Biometric based Banking System Through AI-Powered Transaction Security Fintech System for Secure Transactions
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Advance Computing and Innovative Technologies in Engineering (ICACITE)
abstract: The financial sector is such a world that is constantly under evolution, always with searches for the balance between strong security and the exponential increase of digital customer-centric operations. Here is where Albiometric recognition steps in, possibly contributing at the same time to efficiency and security for bank transactions. Therefore, this paper will help in studying the incorporation of AI in biometric authentication for banking activities and its impact from these dual perspectives. From the efficiency front, the paper will study how AI can make the user experience effective. This biometric recognition can be, for example, through fingerprint scanning or facial recognition, which will, at the These operations could be further streamlined with AI learning and adapting to user behavior, and even predicting actions and pre-populating transaction details. The traditional means of authentication, including passwords, are easily susceptible to phishing attacks and bruteforce hacking. On the other hand, this biometric data is unique for every individual and hence is more secure. AI can further cement this security by keeping an eye all the time for any anomaly or spoofing attempts in the biometric data. It means that machine-learning algorithms can identify even the slightest difference in fingerprints, facial features, or voice patterns, which human experts might oversee, and would provide a great help for security.

articleTitle: The Way of Creating GA (Genetic Algorithm) for Controlled and Secured Data Management in Cloud Environment
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Advance Computing and Innovative Technologies in Engineering (ICACITE)
abstract: The main computing paradigm for a wide range of applications, cloud computing is a cornerstone of contemporary IT businesses and includes an abundance of hardware and software resources. By creating a worldwide software infrastructure, it makes remote environments for application development and administration possible. Cloud computing serves a global clientele with a wide range of needs, all while functioning inside an ecosystem that depends on the internet. But cloud computing comes with a lot of risks and possible threats in addition to its extensive use and rising demand. Concerns about data integrity and privacy become critical in cloud computing systems because of the spread of information over several geographic locations. The integrity and safety of sensitive data are important considerations for both cloud consumers and service providers. In this regard, the research suggests a unique use of genetic algorithms (GAs) for cloud data security. The fundamental idea of GAs is used to produce encryption and decryption keys, which are then combined with cryptographic techniques to strengthen data security and integrity in cloud computing environments. In order to assess and contrast the suggested method, the study also explores common encryption parameters including execution time, throughput, and key size. A range of datasets are utilised in order to verify the effectiveness of the suggested technique. Results from experiments show that the suggested model successfully protects data from unwanted access. A comparison examination of the suggested algorithm is also carried out against cutting-edge cryptographic methods including AES, Blowfish, DES, RSA, and 3DES. The comparative evaluation highlights the effectiveness and resilience of the suggested solution, providing information about its possible benefits over current cryptographic techniques.

articleTitle: Low Profile Absorber of Triple Band Metamaterial for RCS Reduction in C and X Band
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Advance Computing and Innovative Technologies in Engineering (ICACITE)
abstract: Ultra-thin metamaterial absorbent design exhibiting triple band characteristics has been presented for C and X band applications. The unit cell consists of a closed and split square loop connected together with square patches at corners along with a modified square loop in center printed on dielectric substrate supported by copper layer. It offers a triple band response with the resonant frequencies of 4.2 GHz, 9.0 GHz and 10.9 GHz respectively with an electrical size of $0.14 \lambda_{0} \times 0.14 \lambda_{0} \times 0.01 \lambda_{0}$, at $f_{0}=4.2 \mathrm{GHz}$. Moreover, it shows an absorption greater than $80 \%$ for a wide angle of incidence of 60 degrees for TE and TM polarizations.

articleTitle: Integration of ML Layer with GBC based Classifier for Better Recognition of Voice in Mobile
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Advance Computing and Innovative Technologies in Engineering (ICACITE)
abstract: People can express their feelings through words and sentences in different languages during a speech. Spoken language frequently contains feelings including surprise, fear, indifference, contempt, fury, grief, and happiness. This essay explores the topic of identifying these feelings in speech. We performed an investigation to identify and categorize emotions present in speech by utilising machine learning methods, such as random forest, additional trees, gradient boosting, decision tree, and light gradient boosting classifiers. We were able to acquire informative findings by using the previously specified classifiers along with datasets.

articleTitle: A Model Development to Differentiate Among Brain Activity and Cognitive Ability
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Advance Computing and Innovative Technologies in Engineering (ICACITE)
abstract: Although the phrase “process model” is frequently used in literature, its exact definition is still unclear. In this study, we provide a new paradigm for explaining and building models of cognitive processes. Process models go beyond traditional models, which concentrate mostly on inputoutput interactions, and capture the dynamic information transformations that take place at different levels of abstraction. Our thesis depends on a number of process model defining characteristics. First of all, they cover a wide range of topics and several layers of abstraction. Second, they provide insights into the underlying cognitive processes at work by articulating a theoretical mental information transformation. Most importantly, these models shed light on the underlying mechanisms that underlie the behavior of interest in addition to predicting it. Notably, these forecasts are produced directly from input data, eliminating the requirement for output data to be reverse-inferred. Additionally, our methodology guarantees that the assumed information transformation procedures are consistent with what is already understood about human cognitive capacity, which adds to their validity and reliability. When it comes to the information that enters the mind, the suggested mental events, and the behavior that is being examined, process models require a well-defined conceptual scope. Across modeling paradigms, this approach is a useful tool for improving process models before to and following empirical testing. As a thorough guide for the creation of models of cognitive processes, it can contribute to the current discussions on how to classify various models in this field.

articleTitle: Heart Rate Predictive Value Using Wearable Sensors in Social Robotics Conversations to Help Children with Autism
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Advance Computing and Innovative Technologies in Engineering (ICACITE)
abstract: The problematic behavior in children suffering from autism, especially in the skills of social and communication, is a problem for family, therapists, caretakers, and also in the treatment process. The work presented in this paper investigates the potential for different machine learning algorithms, applied to data collected through children’s wearable sensors while interacting with toys and social robots. Data were collected through the wearable devices and video annotations from the sessions for identification of problematic behaviors. The extracted time features were then integrated with four machine learning algorithms for detection of problematic behavior: the mean, standard deviation, min, and max. The research also takes into consideration the variations in HRV. Among the included machine learning techniques, the XGBoost algorithm has shown a higher rate of better performance and outperformance in detecting problematic behaviors, with $91 \%$ accuracy. Physiological features outperform kinetic ones in the detection of problematic behaviors, while the predicting factor of one significant thing is in detecting heart rate accuracy. Difficult behavior in this study is proven to be associated with one particular HRV measure, RMSSD. This paper also highlights the importance of development of the instruments and the strategies necessary for the detection of problematic behaviors in autistic children during the social robot-aided session.

articleTitle: Revolutionizing Brain Tumor Analysis: Unleashing the Potential of Residual UNet for Enhanced Segmentation Accuracy
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Advance Computing and Innovative Technologies in Engineering (ICACITE)
abstract: Advances in diagnosis have been made, leading to significant changes in the approach to mental health diagnosis. This update delivers the powerful segmentation algorithms needed to provide accurate diagnosis and treatment planning. Within the scope of this research, a new technology that uses the Residual UNet deep learning architecture is proposed to increase segmentation accuracy. Our method solves the problem of incompleteness while ensuring that the model captures the correct data. This is done by taking advantage of the fixed connection available in the UNet design. The results show that this method is more efficient than other methods. This is done through long-term experiments on large datasets, including multimodal neuroimaging. An unlikely oncology surrogate is Residual UNet, which has proven to be accurate and useful in most cases. Specifically, our strategy achieved 0.9897 accuracy, 0.9726 accuracy, 0.9985 accuracy, and 0.8665 accuracy. BraST 2020 profile is used for this purpose. Additionally, our study proves that Residual UNet exceeds standards for brain tumors. This shows that it can provide superior segmentation for existing and specific technologies.

articleTitle: An Intensive Review on Propagative Antagonistic N/W which is used in Health Care System
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Advance Computing and Innovative Technologies in Engineering (ICACITE)
abstract: This article introduces a Generative Adversarial Network tailored for medical imaging, in particular designed to synthesize retinal images alongside side their segmented mask. This innovation addresses the challenge of obtaining big datasets for deep getting to know, in particular in scientific fields wherein expert annotations are high priced and time-ingesting. It not satisfactory generates fantastic synthetic scientific pics for supervised analysis but moreover achieves cutting-edge day overall performance with dice coefficients of 0.837 on the STARE dataset and 0.832 on the dataset, surpassing present techniques. This development highlights the capability of GANs in scientific imaging, deep gaining knowledge of, and style transfer applications.

articleTitle: A Development of Control0020Techniques for Design of OM Based Robots Using Fuzzy Logic
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Advance Computing and Innovative Technologies in Engineering (ICACITE)
abstract: In this study, a fuzzy controller design specifically for omnidirectional robots is presented. We explore mobile robot dynamics and kinematics, providing a basis for our suggested fuzzy control technique. Our method targets the football robots created in our research lab and deals with the mobile robot’s position and rotational angle control. Our created control algorithms demonstrate effective navigation skills for these football robots through extensive simulation testing. The positive outcomes attested to the efficacy of the controllers we suggested. We also do an analysis of the performance characteristics of our proposed control systems, which shows significant improvements in regulation times for modifying orientation angles and attaining new locations. In the future, we want to investigate how Z number-based fuzzy techniques might be applied to improve control system performance even further.There is potential to improve our control tactics and achieve even higher efficiency in robotic navigation tasks by utilising the Z number system.

articleTitle: A Composite of Design of Collaborative Filtering Models for Stay Recommendation
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Advance Computing and Innovative Technologies in Engineering (ICACITE)
abstract: Analytics and filtering are becoming more and more important in the online retail space to improve consumer experience and guide corporate strategy. The abundance of faked reviews, known as spam, poses a danger to the accuracy of this data as it attempts to sway consumers’ opinions about rival brands and goods. Numerous researches have looked at effective ways to identify spam reviews in order to address this problem; these methods frequently make use of text analysis and artificial intelligence systems. In this paper, we offer a unique approach for filtering of personalized reviews related to hotel industry. Our method shows encouraging results across several performance parameters after thorough testing on a variety of review datasets. We do more than just remove spam from search results; We also provide customers with accurate product information, improving the overall hotel stay experience.

articleTitle: IOT and Machine Learning Based Real-Time Protection Against Cyber-Physical Threat Mitigation
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Advance Computing and Innovative Technologies in Engineering (ICACITE)
abstract: An investigation is carried out into the dynamic relationship between machine learning algorithms used in IoT security, with detailed scrutiny of performance indicators to give a fuller view of what happens. The study pays particular attention to metrics like accuracy, precision, recall, and F1 score when ten varied samples are being examined. As a result, all the algorithms exhibit excellent performance with $95.5 \%-98.2 \%$ accuracy values, inspiring high reliability under diverse scenarios. Precision and recall metrics also depict the models’ capabilities. Balancing precision and recall can be observed in F1 scores that are between $95.2 \%$ and $98.0 \%$, and these numbers show that the approach based on this understanding of trade-offs is characterized by its operationalization. At the other end, results obtained from performance metrics go beyond numerical benchmarks to give a holistic appreciation of the algorithms’ strength and areas for possible enhancement. The paper also does not provide only a theoretical approach to machine learning related to security in the IoT environment but also provides information about security considerations for the successful deployment of powerful, adaptive models into real-life scenarios. In this case, findings of the research help in understanding how to make sure that smart and effective measures are implemented during the process of developing security solutions considering all related issues in connection with the IoT technology landscape.

articleTitle: A Support System Development for Healthcare System using FL and FC Techniques
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Advance Computing and Innovative Technologies in Engineering (ICACITE)
abstract: This has been increasing in difficulty for accomplishing time-consuming and complex tasks with the rise in the number of Internet of Things (IoT) devices and the generated big data, along with problems of expanding concerns often in the form of latency and use of power. Fog computing is the potential solution advanced by a dispersed form of computing and has a solution to these issues. IoT-Fog applications are limited in meeting time constraints to reduce service latency and energy consumption, due to the limited processing capacity that fog computing devices have. Based on this factor, this paper now proposes an alternative approach by using Fuzzy Logic to find the solution based on Dynamic Integer Linear Programming to reduce the workload in the clinical decision support system by efficient allocation of resources to the IoT devices from the Fog compute layer while accounting for the system constraints and resource availability.
