articleTitle: An Innovative FV with 3D Based RS in SR
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Advance Computing and Innovative Technologies in Engineering (ICACITE)
abstract: This work presents a novel valve that allows the intuitive spatial control of manipulators that are continuum or soft. The valve’s distinctive design allows it to concurrently manage three pressure feed points, drawing inspiration from hydraulic flapper valves. Soft robots may be precisely positioned thanks to the three antagonistically organised hydraulic actuators that are driven by these sites. The radial design of the variable control orifices is symmetrical with respect to rotation, enabling inline placement within the manipulator’s body. Different actuator pressurisations may be obtained by varying the 3D configurations of the valve ring, which results in a variety of manipulator spatial configurations. Because the valve design may be miniaturised, it can be used in situations where size is limited, including surgical robotics and compact soft manipulators. The valve’s performance may be accurately modeled through experimental validation, and it can be utilized to operate three actuators in an antagonistic arrangement for soft manipulator control.

articleTitle: An Effort Towards Efficient Learning via Integrating the AI Technique for the Design of Smart Education System
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Advance Computing and Innovative Technologies in Engineering (ICACITE)
abstract: The integration of AI (artificial intelligence) tools with instructional practices in higher education is bringing breakthrough innovations onto the landscape of teaching and learning. The paper delves into the various ways that AI technologies empower educators towards bettering their instructional strategies, more effective student engagement, and also fostering personalized learning experiences. As AI is developing at great speed, its application in the field of education is progressing now and offering educators powerful tools for their pedagogical approaches. In addition, the paper delves into some of the merits linked to AI use while instructing. It further makes them better educators, as AI in their hands will give them the capability to offer personalized learning experiences that match the varying needs and preferences of students. This study further delves into some of the difficulties and ethical considerations that come with the use of AI in education. The issues of information security, algorithmic bias, and how exactly technology may leave the human instructor jobless are elaborated in detail. Though AI holds incredible promise in the area of teaching and learning, these challenges really have to be met with cautiousness and ethicalness so that the use of the technology brings about access to educational opportunities equitably and, most essentially, educational outcomes for all the students.

articleTitle: Exploring Gear Optimization Using Firefly Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Advance Computing and Innovative Technologies in Engineering (ICACITE)
abstract: The research paper study about the performance of the Firefly Optimization algorithm incorporating its varying addendum and dedendum gear parameters is examined. The Firefly algorithm, a nature-motivated procedure, is known for its applications in resolving challenging optimization issues. Through our research, we ran a series of experiments by different AP and $B P$ values to explore how they influence the algorithm’s convergence and solution quality. For the sake of our study, we ran ten test cases where the values of AP and BP varied. The algorithm was assessed based on speed of convergence and the quality of final solution. The result shows that the choice of AP and BP parameters of the algorithm influence its behavior. We find that some combinations of these elements speed up the convergence process and yielded better solutions; while other combinations were slower with slightly worse solutions. These results provide room for parameters tuning of Firefly Optimization, where practitioners can now have a chance to change the algorithm to get the most out of various optimization tasks. Knowing about the impact of AP and BP values can aid in the achievement of the best outcomes even for real world sectors like robotics, embedded systems and automation for which optimization is a key aspect in system design and control.

articleTitle: Extraction of Features from Lung Image for the Detection of Covid-19
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Advance Computing and Innovative Technologies in Engineering (ICACITE)
abstract: The World Health Organization has identified two new human cases of Coronavirus type 2 (CoV-2)-induced severe acute respiratory syndrome and a new pandemic illness known as coronavirus disease (COVID-19). It was initially discovered in Wuhan, China, in December 2019, and afterwards spread widely. The novel COVID-19 continues to increase with confirmed cases that may result in deaths worldwide as a result of respiratory failure and alveolar damage. The common symptoms of SARS- CoV- include dyspnea, chest pain, fatigue and less common symptoms include headache, vomiting and nausea. The diagnosis of SARS-CoV2 infection was the key step to identify the infection and then prevention and quarantine are next steps to be considered as the way to stop the spreading of virus, since there is no specific vaccine, drugs or antiviral against the COVID-19 virus. The patients with COVID-19 are helped with oxygen therapy and antivirals like Lopinavir, Ritonavir, Ribavirin and Favipiravir are currently used. The essential way to control and reduce the human transmission of the virus is by implementing the precautionary steps and hygienic measures. Machine learning technologies were used by healthcare organizations and medical professionals all around the world to combat the pandemic by lowering the need for human intervention and enhancing the pandemic medication development process’s screening, prediction, and forecasting capabilities. One method for finding the COVID-19 is X-ray imaging. We provide a supervised machine learning method in this study for identifying and categorizing COVID-19 infection from x-ray pictures. It is less necessary to manually label x-ray pictures when COVID-19 cases can be accurately detected and distinguished from non-COVID-19 instances. Performance metrics including Accuracy, Sensitivity, Specificity, F1-score, and Positive Predictive Value (PPV) are then used to assess the outcomes.

articleTitle: Identification of Paradigms of Heliacal Luminosity Through Onotological Mechanism and 5G Networks
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Advance Computing and Innovative Technologies in Engineering (ICACITE)
abstract: This paper develops a new ontological-based approach to network slicing in 5G backhaul networks, targeting low- or ultra-low-latency services. Our approach supports a modified $A^{*}$ approach with management of congestion to be more efficient than Dijkstra’s approach in real time with the help of a precomputed heuristic function. It embeds the network quality-of-service factors in a combined measure. The proposed approach is embedded in a slice module, which is, in turn, encapsulated by a route computation element that is a slice module used to compute the optimal paths of network slices. According to experiment results, our approach showed an increase in the order of magnitude of processing time reduction in comparison with the Dijkstra algorithm. Especially in the case of complex network topologies, the system dynamically changes the path to ensure the packet delay is smaller than the specified level, to satisfy the low-latency requirements. These measurements from the performed end-to-end tests for the Speed test client, which allows URLLC in 5G backhaul networks, give the system the capability to differentiate between no- and low-latency-bound traffic.

articleTitle: A Deep Study on Encroachment Recognition Model through W-S-N and I-O-T
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Advance Computing and Innovative Technologies in Engineering (ICACITE)
abstract: The burgeoning challenge of Internet of Things (IoT) technology heralds’ transformative capability for agriculture, mainly in enhancing the safety and operational performance of huge-scale farmlands. This paper introduces an revolutionary IoT-based framework that synergizes Global System for Mobile Communication (GSM) and Global Positioning System (GPS) modules to forge a whole, actual-time tracking and intrusion detection answer tailored for agricultural domain names. Our proposed framework is designed to address the dual demanding situations of optimizing farm management practices while ensuring robust safety in competition to capacity intrusions. By deploying a network of brand-new sensors across farmlands, our system enables the seamless collection, evaluation, and transmission of essential environmental statistics, thereby enabling farmers to make knowledgeable alternatives all of sudden. Furthermore, the combination of GSM and GPS technology enhances the tool’s functionality to without delay alert farmers about unusual sports activities, making sure immediate reaction to protection breaches. The pilot deployment of our framework demonstrates its effectiveness in no longer best substantially improving tracking accuracy however moreover in bolstering the safety of agricultural lands towards unauthorized get right of entry to.

Author Keywords: Global System for Mobile communication (GSM) module

articleTitle: The Combined and Path Allocation Technique with the use of Space Robotics
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Advance Computing and Innovative Technologies in Engineering (ICACITE)
abstract: Space robots have a wide range of possible applications in the aerospace sector. However, they are bounded with limited fuel and cannot recharge, given that they operate in their special working environment. Thus, in this way, path planning that is effective is necessary to maximize the operation of space robots. In this paper, simultaneous exploration task allocation and path planning are considered to reduce the completion delay of the exploration task. The VGTA algorithm proposed for variable genetic task allocation in this paper provides a general approach to the task allocation problem in a complex environment. It makes use of genetic principles to generate and optimize the task sequences, and its intrinsic conflict resolution ensures that the solutions are robust against the conflicts. The VGTA, with the help of the random mutation, greedy crossover, and conflict handling mechanisms, provides reliable and efficient results near to the optimal values. The evaluation metrics PDbest, PDav, and the cost-effectiveness ratio (CER) define the performance of VGTA in realistic applications by which, with a complex map, VGTA operates quite well in delivering solutions. VGTA is one of the preferable solutions in terms of any kind of task allocation optimization, as with a complex map, it gives a good balance in computation time and quality of the solution obtained.

articleTitle: Classification of Drone Detection Module using Hybrid Learning Algorithms
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Advance Computing and Innovative Technologies in Engineering (ICACITE)
abstract: Drones have grown in popularity due to their widespread use in many applications from research and surveys to logistics and entertainment, but the widespread use of drones also gave way to activities that could pose a security risk, such as illegal surveillance, smuggling and violation of privacy Must be created. This work focuses on an inclusive drone detection system based onsophisticated signal detection methods and machine learning algorithms and deep learning algorithms The proposed method seeks to identify and classify drone types greater accuracy in real-world datasets. Using real-world data sets and multiple high-accuracy classification methods, the developed model is reliable and can be readily used to generate useful target flights effectiveness

articleTitle: D-D Communication: the Development of Strategy for Resource Sharing in GIOT
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Advance Computing and Innovative Technologies in Engineering (ICACITE)
abstract: With the Internet of Things (IoT) expanding quickly and smart terminals and network data becoming more prevalent, green IoT is becoming more and more popular in academics and business. This paper examines two essential elements of the green IoT: social networks and device-to-device (D2D) communication. It begins by reviewing the most current developments in both fields. This paper proposes an loT system model aimed at addressing security concerns related to open-source software packages while optimizing energy usage and enhancing system reliability. The model comprises conventional device hardware connected to an embedded web server, which acts as an interface between physical devices and virtual objects hosted on a cloud server. By introducing a test platform within the cloud environment, the system ensures the security and reliability of deployed services and applications. Additionally, an energy-efficient scheduling algorithm optimizes the duty cycle of sensors and appliances, further enhancing the system’s sustainability and efficiency.

articleTitle: An Innovative Way of Empirical Analysis of Various Structures used in DL Algorithms for the Better Practices
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Advance Computing and Innovative Technologies in Engineering (ICACITE)
abstract: The importance of deep learning is growing with artificial intelligence. It operates quickly. Entangled nerve fibres (CNNs), a well-known deep learning method, have shown impressive results in painting, classification, and semantic division. The actuator function-a crucial part of CNNs -was looked at in the context of low velocities in this book study, Engineering Vehicle Rear System Programme. The text begins with a comprehensive analysis of all four conventional activation functions, including the well recognised sigmoid function, and a summary of their respective benefits. It then discusses the potential benefits. Swish, FTS, and Relu- are the three new operating systems that are offered with SoftPlus. The research then includes a combination of new activators and extra activation functions. It operates at the TensorFlow framework level. On the CIFAR-10 dataset, more image recognition comparisons are carried out. According to the results, using a combination of novel activation functions produces better recognition accuracy than using just one new activation function. Moreover, the hybrid technique shows higher convergence speeds and shorter average processing times, indicating its effectiveness in real-world applications.

articleTitle: Performance Analysis of 3D Stacked Memory Architectures in High Performance Computing
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Advance Computing and Innovative Technologies in Engineering (ICACITE)
abstract: The increasing speed of the CPU is greater than that of the RAM. The ‘Memory Wall’ issue, which occurs when the processor runs out of data, could occur. The I/O infrastructure is strained as the number of cores in CMPs rises because more data is needed from the memory subsystem. Memory bandwidth becomes a bottleneck in terms of performance. By layering memories on top of logic, three-dimensional integrated circuits are proposed as a solution to this problem. The widely-used compute-in-memory benchmark framework ‘NeuroSim’ is utilized by us to investigate the benefits of a three-dimensional design for a Neural Network application.

articleTitle: The Optimization of Output of Wind Turbine with the Ongoing Grid System through BP Method Using ANN
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Advance Computing and Innovative Technologies in Engineering (ICACITE)
abstract: Wind turbines are intricate devices that need careful planning, evaluation, and installation to guarantee peak performance under a range of environmental circumstances. Comprehensive load calculations, performance evaluations, and iterative optimisation processes are all part of the design process. However, complex simulation techniques are required to adequately depict the non-linear behaviour of wind turbine systems because of their complicated structure. Automation of optimisation processes and simulation executions is crucial to optimise the design process and manage the large number of simulations that are needed. This work provides a thorough framework using back propagation (BP) and artificial neural networks (ANN) for simulation and optimization that will make it easier to manage and automate the execution of iterative simulations during the design and development of wind turbines. The framework’s main goals are to make design load case simulations easier and optimise activities more automatically. The framework makes it possible to optimise wind turbine systems and explore design options more effectively by automating these procedures. Three example optimisation jobs illustrate the framework’s versatility and functionality.

articleTitle: aPython GUI based user Authentication using Typing Speed Test
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Advance Computing and Innovative Technologies in Engineering (ICACITE)
abstract: The goal of this paper is to create a Python based user-friendly typing speed test with user authentication. It utilizes the Tkinter, Time, Random and RegEx libraries. Tkinter is used to create an interactive GUI. Users are presented with a randomly selected sentence of moderate to complex difficulty, consisting of 30-50 words which must be entered accurately to measure typing speed. The time library is used to measure the total time elapsed while typing and the regex library measures the number of words in the sentence. This allows us to measure the user’s typing speed in words per minute (WPM). There is also a feature which detects if a bot is attempting the test. This paper also explores the uses of the typing speed test program in real life settings and its significance. In conclusion, the typing speed test made using python acts as a practical tool to measure typing proficiency and prevent the use of unfair means to get a higher speed.

articleTitle: Performance Evaluation of MPPT Based Photovoltaic Water Pump System for Sustainable Water Resource Management
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Advance Computing and Innovative Technologies in Engineering (ICACITE)
abstract: Water resources are crucial for various human needs, including preventive health, food production, energy generation, ecological balance, and socioeconomic development. However, a significant portion of the global population, particularly in water-poor regions, lacks access to clean and sufficient drinking water. This paper presents a sustainable solution implemented with photovoltaic water pump system to address these challenges. This paper reviews relevant literature on photovoltaic technology, maximum power point tracking, and solar cell technologies. It also outlines the basic of BLDC motor for these applications including the functioning of the proposed photovoltaic water pump system. This conference paper explores the use of DCDC Boost Converter in photovoltaic (PV) systems to achieve Maximum Power Point Tracking (MPPT). The Boost Converter is discussed in detail, highlighting its significance in voltage boosting and power optimization for PV panels. Impedance matching is emphasized as a unique advantage of DC-DC Boost Converters, enabling the extraction of maximum power from PV arrays. The paper also presents the modes of operation for the Boost Converter, focusing on charging and discharging modes.

articleTitle: Comparative Analysis of Load Frequency Control Strategies: PID, Fuzzy Logic, and Model Predictive Control (MPC)
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Advance Computing and Innovative Technologies in Engineering (ICACITE)
abstract: An effective power system operation must have load frequency control abilities. An essential part of the system is a reliable power source and a stable system. We need to keep the production and consumption of energy under check if we want to reach this goal. There is an in-depth analysis and review of twoarea power system Load Frequency Control (LFC) methods offered. Fuzzy control, PID, and MPC were among the many methods we explored. Determine which of the three choices is optimal; that is the goal of this assignment. Many factors are considered when assessing a control plan. It is crucial to consider about the transient reaction. Among the most important considerations are complex processing, robustness, and steadystate error. We may evaluate several control methods for a multiarea power grid and how well they handle demand fluctuations using MATLAB/Simulink models.

articleTitle: A Way to Design Fog Computing Model For 5G Network using Vanet
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Advance Computing and Innovative Technologies in Engineering (ICACITE)
abstract: Intelligent cities rely heavily on smart automobiles, providing portable computing as well as communication capabilities via a wireless link. By Mobile spontaneous groups, computer fog acts as a middleman between automobiles and the web, giving them access to storing, retrieving and abilities to network. With VANET, which stands processing the request to the vehicle takes fewer minutes since it is a latency-sensitive tech. The most well-known problems with fogged and VANETs are congestion and delays. In this study, we created a priority-based fogged approach to intelligent metro automobile journeys, which lowers fog compute time and postpone, to address such issues. 5G localised Multi-Access edge information workstations was also used to enhance the computer fog infrastructures in meeting timely and The caliber of Level standards, which has greatly reduced the latency and wait. Additionally, we achieved a 35% reduction in CPU usage as compared to the use of a public cloud platform.

articleTitle: A Development of 5G Technology in Cloud Computing and its Optimization Technique
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Advance Computing and Innovative Technologies in Engineering (ICACITE)
abstract: In the changing environment of the Industrial World of Things (IIoT), there has been a notable change, especially in the merger of cloud computing for the achievement of Industry 4.0. This combination, regularly referred to as Cloud production, signifies a major improvement in production systems. It offers features such as based on the cloud control and immediate process tracking, changing the standard industrial model. However, this development comes with a number of challenges, mainly in the world of threats to security and a boost in end-to-end delay across the production environment. The merging of cloud services reveals risks, including possible central points of breakdown and message route delays as data moves to and from the cloud service provider. To handle these problems, we suggest a new security service design that blends the stability of the technology’s blockchain with the speed of fog computing. This design works on fog nodes carefully positioned at the edge of production equipment groups.

articleTitle: A Way of Optimization of Wireless Sensor Network using TSCH
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Advance Computing and Innovative Technologies in Engineering (ICACITE)
abstract: Within ad hoc wireless networks, TimeSynchronized Channel Hop (TSCH) is a potential method for interference-free and collision-free communication, especially in the setting of wireless sensor networks, car networks, and networks containing robots or drones. Even though TSCH and its versions work well, they need centralized planning to keep the time-frequency sliding system in place. This leads to a restricted usage of time-frequency slots and slow convergence, especially when there is node change or movement. Using the idea of pulse-coupled oscillators, the protocol pairs distributed synchronization or desynchronization methods at the MAC layer to coordinate nodes to perform coordinated signal packet broadcasts over all available channels. Afterwards, peer-to-peer swap requests and acknowledgements between ongoing emitter in neighboring channels result in autonomous channel moving. Extensive evaluation against TSCH and the power source Successful It MAC (EM-MAC) protocol suggests that DT-SCS is a strong contender for centralized multi-channel MAC layer coordination due to its quick convergence, which refers strong connectivity, and high bandwidth utilization even in the midst of interference alongside hidden nodes.

articleTitle: Design of Unmanned Aerial Vehicle’s Drones for the Purpose of Security
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Advance Computing and Innovative Technologies in Engineering (ICACITE)
abstract: Government-funded, charities, and international organizations devote substantial resources to catastrophe avoidance, reduction, preparation, reply, and recovery. Planning for and responding to disasters present difficult logistical issues. Several organizations have looked at using helicopters as an extra tool for first responders to use while searching for casualties. Examining current studies on drone usage for searches and rescues is the aim of the present investigation. We find that there are issues with employing such aircraft for municipal rescue missions, identifying cell phones in an emergency using hidden sensors, and incorporating probability optimization for optimization within robot control.

articleTitle: The Use of 6G Communication Technology in Healthcare Applications for the Accurate and Better Transmission
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Advance Computing and Innovative Technologies in Engineering (ICACITE)
abstract: The IIoT is the most important element in the 6th generation networks, or 6G, so it greatly depends on effective data processing and storage. For the cause of ensuring smooth node-to-node communication, 6G provides ultra-low delays, high bandwidth, and higher-level QoS. Intelligent diagnosis, numerous in-hospital, and distant healthcare services are prerequisites to enable healthcare institutions to provide patientcentered care. What is essential is that the system hosting an array of uses, ranging from ambient appropriate living settings with wearable technology-enabled remote patient monitoring to robotic procedures powered by an intelligent networking platform. Therefore, this work addresses the needs of the healthcare sector by providing a reference-layered contact architecture for locations and devices in real-time communication. The unique 6G technology can, therefore, be utilized with great foresight to the future in the healthcare sector, enabling effective treatment and intelligent service integration. Because several networking nodes, including terminal devices, are integrated into effective health service delivery, a backbone structure is thus required for the services that take much time to complete. Therefore, a backbone structure for managing services is required to enable smooth communication by the framework, developed to enable this kind of 6G-enabled advanced healthcare application.

articleTitle: The Significant Technical Mantle of AI in the Field of Secular Engineering: an Innovative Design
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Advance Computing and Innovative Technologies in Engineering (ICACITE)
abstract: It is one of the main avenues through which AI technologies are coming into prominence as they promise to revolutionize civil engineering from design to maintenance. This is an elaborate paper on a plunge into the multifaceted applications of AI in civil engineering, its potential to transform, and the paradigm shifts that it introduces vis-à-vis traditional methodologies. The design phase is the cornerstone in any project related to civil engineering, where AI algorithms prove its extraordinary capabilities to optimize the design in a structure, smooth workflows, and even predict potential failures. On top of that, these AI technologies revolutionize how maintenance is done in civil engineering. They enable a kind of predictive asset’s maintenance strategies that increases reliability over assets and their service life. Predictive maintenance models with high degrees of accuracy toward equipment failure are driven by AI (artificial intelligence) and the sensor data from the IoT devices, with advanced analytics that make interventions of maintenance actions proactively in order to avoid further downtime.

articleTitle: Unraveling the Consequences of unethical act of use of Artificial Intelligence: A Systematic Review and Meta-Analysis
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Advance Computing and Innovative Technologies in Engineering (ICACITE)
abstract: Artificial Intelligence (AI) has rapidly transformed various sectors, significantly impacting the employment landscape. Today AI is becoming capable of performing almost every technical task which is perform by the human being and it is the great threat to the massive job loss in present and in the upcoming future as well. The automation of jobs, a core facet of AI, brings forth both opportunities and challenges. While concerns about job displacement exist, AI’s potential to efficiency, enhance productivity and accuracy across industries is undeniable. AI excels at automating routine tasks, allowing human workers to focus on more strategic responsibilities, fostering increased job creativity and satisfaction. Sectors like manufacturing, customer service and shipping already showcase the influence of AI-driven automation. However, the fear of widespread unemployment prompts the need for workforce adaptation through upskilling and retraining. The rising demand for skilled professionals in AI-related fields underscores the concurrent opportunities for human labor in developing, designing and maintaining AI systems. Collaborative work settings, where humans and AI systems complement each other, hold promise for heightened job satisfaction and productivity. AI-driven automation also offers the potential for safer working conditions by deploying robots for hazardous tasks. Addressing the challenges requires coordinated efforts from educators, legislature and corporations, emphasizing investments in lifelong learning, education and ethical deployment regulations. Balancing the benefits of workforce and automation support is vital for a future where humans and machines coexist, fostering a more prosperous and inclusive economy.

articleTitle: The Various Technical Study of Modern Business Growth Strategy Making With the use of AI, ML and DL
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Advance Computing and Innovative Technologies in Engineering (ICACITE)
abstract: Over the last years, the blast of Artificial Intelligence (AI) technologies has largely impacted known economic and technical landscapes that shape traditional business paradigms and breed new shifts within organizations in an unprecedented way. The paper hence tries to explore the nexus existing in between these AI-driven transformations and modern business dynamics so as to shed light on the multi-dimensional effects over economic change and technical revolution in Isabela State University, Echague Campus. The study will start with outlining the transformational potential of AI in different sections: finance, health, industrial manufacturing, and retail. This paper critically examines how the adoption of AI, seen from economic theory and empirical evidence, produces efficiency gains, cost cuts, and revenue augmentation that encourage businesses to increase their productivity and competitive advantage. The paper also examines the disruptions that AI-driven automation could bring about in the labor market, elaborating the nuances for employment dynamics, skill requirements, and income distribution. Other than that, below research will help investigate the deep nexus between AI-driven technical evolution and business strategies. It leverages organizational theory and innovation studies to detail how AI technologies catalyze novel forms of value creation, business model innovation, and industry convergence.

articleTitle: Fog Computing Integrated with and Blockchain Technology for Accurate Disease Prediction
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Advance Computing and Innovative Technologies in Engineering (ICACITE)
abstract: A modern computational paradigm known as fog computing provides distributed end users with very scalable and low-latency services. Because local fog nodes enable the quick storage and processing of data close to data sources, it has an inherent safety benefit over cloud computing. Simultaneously, the Blockchain (BC) technology represents a significant advancement, prioritizing data security, anonymity, and integrity via a consensus-building process. While BC was first widely used in finance, it is now finding its way into other industries, like as healthcare. In order to forecast diseases, this research suggests a safe healthcare service that uses Blockchain and fog computing. It focuses on diabetes and cardiovascular conditions. Health data about patients is collected from the fog nodes and safely kept on a blockchain. After grouping patient health data using a unique rule-based clustering approach, a feature selection-based neuro-fuzzy inference system with adaptive capability (FS-ANFIS) is used to forecast diseases. Significant real-world healthcare data trials are used to test the suggested technique. Performance measures, such as purity as normalized mutual information (NMI), are used to measure the effectiveness of rule-based clustering, as prediction accuracy is used to evaluate the performance of illness prediction. Comparing the testing results to other neural network methods, the suggested methodology achieved over 81% prediction accuracy, demonstrating its effectiveness.

articleTitle: Enhancing Educational Outcomes Through Exploring the Optimized Options Artificial Intelligence and Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Advance Computing and Innovative Technologies in Engineering (ICACITE)
abstract: Artificial Intelligence (AI) has the potential to herald a new dawn of instructional and operational excellence in the higher education domain, thereby reshaping the dimensions of teaching and learning and administrative efficiency. This paper explores great potential for AI in the customization of learning experiences to optimize each learner’s engagement, hence better academic performance. It also investigates the potential for AI to help in streamlining most of the administrative processes, which would lead to less work pressure on the faculty and staff, thus freeing up additional time for them to focus on core educational objectives. Specifically, the paper addresses key ethical issues that AI brings with it in relation to data privacy, algorithmic bias, and digital divide, which are fundamental barriers to an equitable and fair use of these technologies. This would form part of a mixed-methods research design that would synthesize such qualitative perspectives from expert interviews with data gleaned from the most recent example of educational interventions around AI. This provides a broad picture of the effectiveness of AI and challenges that may lie at the level of higher education. The range of artificial intelligence applications from current to likely use reviews is adaptive learning systems, automated grading tools, and predictive analytics for student support services.

articleTitle: The Capacity of AI in Education System Towards in Acquiring the Innovative tested Models to Enhance the Learning Experience
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Advance Computing and Innovative Technologies in Engineering (ICACITE)
abstract: Artificial intelligence (AI) stands as one of the game changers in a number of fields due to the growing potential that it comes with regarding advancing students in institutions of higher learning. This paper further explores the contribution of AI to increasing students’ achievements within higher learning settings. Recognizing success in a student with multidimensional attributes, embracing a wide dimension from academic to social and emotional, this study explores how AI technologies might support the diverse dimensions of development and attainment for students. AI has a pathbreaking opportunity in overcoming these challenges through personalized, scalable, and adaptive interventions designed for individual specific needs of the students. These dimensions would form the core toward the deeper analysis of AI applications across varied life cycles of students. Chatbots and virtual mentors provide immediate help and guidance; they even help predict the course of a likely academic or emotional risk so that timely interventions could be given in such cases with sentiment analysis and tracking of behavior. It further assumes a very important role in building learning environments that can meet the varied learning style, preferences, and abilities of learners.

articleTitle: Power Trading Framework of Cloud-Edge Computing in the Artificial Intelligence Market
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Advance Computing and Innovative Technologies in Engineering (ICACITE)
abstract: Cloud-edge computing and artificial intelligence proliferation make it necessary to learn how to properly manage energy in the environment. This paper will aim to design and assess a power trading framework on the possibility of adequately optimizing power allocation for cloud-edge AI systems. The problem that the paper seeks to address is the critical problem of energy acumen in cloud-edge AI. With the growing number of edge devices and the unpredictability of AI workload, power allocation must be effectively done. Therefore, the paper’s scope will include designing a power trading system that will effectively and dynamically allocate power resources in the AI to optimize and secure efficiency, effectiveness, reduce costs, and completely eliminate or reduce latencies. The research approach is wide and thorough. I conducted a collected theoretical framework, developed algorithms, acquired actual and credible real-world data, and analyzed big data. During this process, I conducted real-world simulations and deployed the framework in different case studies involving various cloud-edge AI environments. The results showed that power trading framework sufficiently optimizes power allocation, which has increased pyre efficacy, relatively reduced costs, and low latency. Implementing the framework will also secure sustainability ambitions, especially in reducing carbon emissions and depending less on non-renewable energy sources. The output of the study is more recommendable compared to traditional power management systems. This study has a promising starting point for power trading. However, some limitations proved to be challenging, such as some technical difficulties and problems in collecting and submitting data. Some future possibilities include creating new devices through collaboration or new novel applications. The framework can be applied to cloud-edge AI, and business and industries can apply it to their operations on how to manage energy in a rapidly dynamic and energy-intensive environment.

articleTitle: Prediction of Crime Hotspots using Machine Learning with Stacked Generalized Approach
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Advance Computing and Innovative Technologies in Engineering (ICACITE)
abstract: Crime prediction has an important part in growth of police tactics and the application of instruments for crime prevention and control. These days, machine learning is the most widely used prediction approach. Few research, nevertheless, have systematically examined several machine learning techniques for crime prediction. This study investigates the prediction capacity of various machine learning approaches employ historical data on public property crime from a portion of a huge seaside metropolis in India. Based just on historical crime data, the ADABOOST model outperforms K-nearest neighbour (KNN), Random Forest, Support Vector Machine (SVM), Naive Bayes, and Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs). Information about the offenses and their consequences. Furthermore, the density of the metropolitan road network and the built-environment data of sites of interest (POIs) were included as covariates for the Boosting model. When historical crime data was the only basis for the prior model, the model that included covariates linked to the built environment had a significant predictive impact. Therefore, it is appropriate to employ both factors connected to criminological theories and historical crime data is used to forecast future crime. When it comes to predicting crimes, machine learning techniques vary from one another.

articleTitle: AI Integrated Administration tool design with ML Technology for Smart Education System
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Advance Computing and Innovative Technologies in Engineering (ICACITE)
abstract: Artificial intelligence (AI) is increasingly the solution for higher education institutions wanting streamlined administrative operations in a time when technological change and new introductions are fast-paced. This paper takes a look at the prospective changes brought about by an AI-powered administration vis-à-vis the rise of technological advances in a higher education context, from operations and the use of resources to mechanisms for decision-making specifically in Cagayan State University, Carig Campus. AI adoption could revolutionize the traditional administrative job workflows within universities and colleges, helping it provide solutions to complex challenges for the whole world’s university and college ecosystem. AI also allows institutions to automate the running of routine administrative operations, such as student enrollment, course scheduling, and financial management, among others. For instance, the automation process of some selected routine administrative operations-comprising a very wide list of activities, such as student enrollment, course scheduling, and many others-can be implemented in institutions that use AI algorithms. More so, AI-powered analytic tools help in the optimization of resource allocation in higher education institutions. AI systems can give actionable insights into trends in enrollment, performance metrics of their student body, and demographics of students. The data-driven approach, therefore, allows institutions to be efficient in resource allocation and predictive future demands that will best fit in the students’ and stakeholders’ educational programs for evolution. Besides, artificial intelligence-based decision support systems offer real-time intelligence to the administrators in the process of making informed decisions.

articleTitle: The Design of AI Algorithms for DG Setting
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Advance Computing and Innovative Technologies in Engineering (ICACITE)
abstract: Artificial intelligence (AI) is the bedrock of management systems and will continue to support human society both now and in the future. These systems’ decision-making processes must be transparent, especially in sensitive areas such as autonomous driving and healthcare, to build trust. Although methods exist for achieving algorithmic transparency, there are no well-established design techniques to systematically address descriptive issues when reviewing AI. In response, we introduce the Explainability in Design (EID) approach, which operationalizes the definition of AI into six fundamental concepts. EID was refined through iterative empirical studies, including applied learning and interviews with practitioners. An empirical study with AI system designers tested the utility of EID, demonstrating its effectiveness in reducing barriers to integrating explanatory functionality in AI systems and enhancing decision-making processes.

articleTitle: AI Hybrid Based Plagiarism Detection System Creation
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Advance Computing and Innovative Technologies in Engineering (ICACITE)
abstract: The technological revolution in digital access and information that modern academia is facing today is an undoubtedly enormous enhancement in academic discourse, though at the same time also posing the problem of plagiarism and its threat to academic activity. Due to the increased desire to maintain high levels of scholarly ethics in institutions of higher learning, there is pressure to ensure that mechanisms for the detection of plagiarism are effective. This research paper, in light of this, seeks to explore how institutions of higher learning can improve their plagiarism detection through the use of Artificial Intelligence (AI). This paper commences with a statement of the multi-definition outline of plagiarism in academia, which includes intentional and, likewise, unintentional activities with regard to intellectual dishonesty. At first, traditional detection methods are reviewed by description of how manual examination and rule-based software prove to be inadequate and erroneous in pinpointing plagiarised textual content on the internet. However, the failure of conventional approaches underscores that extraordinary solutions need to be brought in through integrating AI technologies. It will give first an assessment of AI-enabled plagiarism detection systems that are built to use cutting-edge machine learning algorithms in scanning text materials to find traces of originality or lack of it at the highest levels of accuracy and speeds never achieved before.

articleTitle: An Innovative Navigating System Design along with AI Tech Integration for Modern System Implementation for Business
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Advance Computing and Innovative Technologies in Engineering (ICACITE)
abstract: The artificial intelligence (AI) business landscape has emerged in recent years as an inevitable scenario of integration into business operations. The present paper will discuss the economic and technical impacts of integrating AI in modern business settings. A major contribution of interest is the subject matter; we undertake an extensive literature review for the evolution of AI technologies and their effects on different kinds of industries. In this paper, we propose a methodology for assessing the effective integration strategy of AI and offer empirical findings based on case studies and data analysis. These are the challenges and, on the other hand, the opportunities that face transversing the digital frontier in business with a view of harnessing strategic AI implementation. This paper will thus discuss multifaceted impacts that AI integration in businesses carries along its chain and touch on the multi-faceted impacts that cut across technical and economic advancements. On the basis of an exhaustive literature review and some of the real case studies, the paper identified how the adoption of AI changed traditional business models and led to revolutionary changes in various industries. From an economic point of view, integration with AI leads to the development of gainful efficiency, the reduction of cost, and an increase in revenue through an improved decision-making process, the automation of tasks, and developing a personalized customer experience

articleTitle: A Development of Integration of Edge Cloud Computing with 5G N/W
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Advance Computing and Innovative Technologies in Engineering (ICACITE)
abstract: Multi-access computing on the edge (MEC) represents a developing environment that tries to combine communications and IT services, creating a cloud computing platform located at the edge of the radio control network. The main goal of MEC is to offer storage and computing powers at the edge that was thereby lowering delay for global end users and improving the use of handheld transport and core networks. This review paper offers an in-depth analysis of MEC, with a particular emphasis on the important supporting technologies. It dives into MEC accompaniment, addressing both individual functions and linked MEC systems that support mobility, shining light on various distribution choices for orchestration. Furthermore, the paper studies the MEC reference design and key implementation situations, stressing the provision of multitenancy aid to app builders, suppliers of content, and external organizations. Finally, the paper offers insights into current standards of efforts and looks into existing research issues in the MEC area.

articleTitle: The Step towards Future Targeted Spruce Pedagogy Through AI Based Models
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Advance Computing and Innovative Technologies in Engineering (ICACITE)
abstract: Artificial intelligence (AI) in higher education has been debated and is a curious issue for critics. The advocates of the technology point to how revolutionary it is for education, while its opponents wonder what it could mean for the traditional ideal methods of teaching. Emphasizing securing teaching against the face of technological advancements, this study offers a rudimentary analysis of higher education’s influence on AI. First, in terms of revolutionary prospects, the research studied artificial intelligence in higher education and explained how a number of innovations based on artificial intelligence—involving intelligently mentioned systems, personalized instruction phases, and an automatic evaluation framework—enable improved learning outcomes, good quality of advice, and adaptation to the needs of the undergraduate student. This paper also makes an attempt to delve deep into the role of AI in enabling more accessibility and inclusivity in education, especially to learners with different abilities or those who are coming under the purview of underrepresented groups of society. The paper thus re-installs the importance of some serious ethical frameworks and regulative mechanisms, which shall reduce the risks originating during AI implantation in the educational context.

articleTitle: Design of Cloud-Powered Type of Strategies for Management System Used in Drones
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Advance Computing and Innovative Technologies in Engineering (ICACITE)
abstract: Drones, sometimes referred to as drones that fly (UAVs), are becoming more and more popular as affordable solutions that may support creative business and civic applications in the Internet connected Things (IoT). Even while there is increasing excitement about their potential, there are still intrinsic difficulties that prevent their real-world use. The most significant of these difficulties is the restricted wireless communication range that drones have with ground stations, which limits their ability to effectively control across long distances. Furthermore, low-cost aerial platforms’ limited computing and energy resources make it difficult for them to run resource-intensive programs aboard. Our solution to these limitations is the Dronemap Organizer (DP), a cloud-based drone management platform that is service-oriented and intended to monitor, operate, and interact with drones over the Internet in a smooth and efficient manner. Numerous applications and proof-of-concepts created using DP’s architecture serve as examples of its adaptability. A thorough performance assessment research was carried out using an actual drone in a live monitoring application in order to gauge the effectiveness of DP. The study’s findings support DP’s promise for practical applications by highlighting how well it works to overcome issues with constrained processing power and communication range. In summary, the Dronemap Planner stands out as a ground-breaking solution in the field of UAV administration, especially when it comes to resolving the issues preventing the broad use of inexpensive drones. DP is a monument to the way drone technology is developing and how it is being incorporated into the wider Web of Things ecosystem by smoothly integrating computing capabilities and facilitating communications over the Internet without being limited by geography. By using this creative approach, DP not only demonstrates that it is possible to overcome current obstacles, but it also creates new opportunities for research and development in the area of drone-based applications.

articleTitle: Empowering Learning: A Comprehensive Review of the EduVista Educational App
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Advance Computing and Innovative Technologies in Engineering (ICACITE)
abstract: This review paper examines the usage and could be useful in the students and teachers who has used the EduVista educational app for a day. EduVista’s objective is to not only educate but to facilitate learning with new features like courses, internships, hackathons and roadmaps. These are tailored to meet the needs of students, professionals and adult-learners. The paper conducts the evaluation that considers whether the front-end and back-end systems of Web site are realized, including the setting of the UI and the database. Analysis of particular components of the application like Getting started, sign-in/sign-up, home, quests, and chat room of the community, shows how well they make a journey to the moon. Report stresses the importance of educational roadmap of EduVista that lead to hackathons and internships as a tool to practice skills and succeed in a job market. In fact, the article also investigates further upgrades for application, such as more numerous course options, personalized counselling routes, employment partnering schemes and coaching programs. Thus, implementing these amendments, that is professionals and students, EduVista will keep assisting them in terms of education and careers. In summary, it gives you a general idea of the app especially the areas that are the strongest and those that could be augmented and also gives some perhaps indication of its impact in the education technology.

articleTitle: A Drones for Controlling the Communication Network using GPS
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Advance Computing and Innovative Technologies in Engineering (ICACITE)
abstract: In the modern world, drones are growing into flexible tools, capable of performing diverse jobs such as security, transportation, and data gathering. Many of these uses are designed for indoor settings, covering industry sites, workshops, and buildings. This study attempts to present a new tool for the efficient control of drones within the indoor environment. The suggested system sees the coordination of helicopters akin to a the internet about Things (IoT) model, containing sensors and controllers. This platform works on a network linking drones that interact with a single computer. Users can easily handle and watch drones by way of a web application, allowing the creation of complex flight plans and getting access to real-time data collected by sensors. Aided by a wireless network, drones remain in constant contact with the computer through UDP messages. The user-friendly application enables individuals to develop and save flight arrangements, subsequently sending them to linked drones. The flexibility of this platform stretches to various applications in industry, allowing for the inclusion of special sensors (e.g., gas, humidity, radiation) or motors such as grasping devices and carriers on drones, further increasing its usefulness in diverse contexts.

articleTitle: Smart System with Leveraging AI Integrating System for well Designed Learning System
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Advance Computing and Innovative Technologies in Engineering (ICACITE)
abstract: Artificial intelligence (AI) technologies are forming in the features of the digital age and penetrate almost every field of human activity; higher education is not an exception. The work “Smart Campuses: Leveraging AI for Better Learning Experience in Higher Education” is a documentary of diverse roles that AI is playing towards transforming the traditional campuses for hosting modern students into smart learning environments. The following sections briefly describe the emergence of AI-powered solutions that are transforming pedagogical approaches, administrative processes, and campus infrastructures to deliver a range of improved learning experiences and academic outcomes. In so doing, it has been articulated that AI use in higher education is motivated by personalizing learning experiences and thus making it possible to realize better educational outcomes. Then, the big data on students can be applicable in analysis to discern patterns in learning, preferences, and problems at the individual level in the education institutions through the use of machine-learning algorithms and data analytics. This allows flexible learning systems to provide material adjusted, feedback, and support according to what the student needs, thus ensuring the students have better involvement in their studies and achieve improved academic performance.

articleTitle: An Automatic Instinctive Optimizing Technique for Tax Filing via AI-Driven based Compilation System
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Advance Computing and Innovative Technologies in Engineering (ICACITE)
abstract: Tax compliance is very key, affecting both businesses and individuals in the world of accounting. The biggest problem in observing the right compliance under taxes relates to a number of complexities that surround the legal framework for any form of compliance and constant changing tax laws. Normally, the task of tax compliance is quite laborious and inefficient by means of traditional methods and mostly prone to human errors. With the development of technologies, involvement with artificial intelligence (AI) is showing some promising solutions in this direction. This research paper takes into consideration the use of accounting information systems that have decision support systems using AI in place to enhance tax compliance. The paper will begin with a description of the present challenges in complying with tax, from complex tax laws to manual calculation and reporting work. These challenges, therefore, pose high risks of error and non-compliance to the efficiency of compliance. This calls for and requires the need to develop new methods that will bring about a revolution in the existing tax compliance practices. This paper tends to provide a full-spectrum literature review on the ways in which AI technologies have evolved in time and integrated into the practices of accounting. This support system has some capabilities: data analysis, pattern recognition, and predictive modeling that increase the level of task automation at the stage of making the decision in an informed and effective way.

articleTitle: A Structural Design for Labor Market System Which Optimizes the Disruptions in the Process through AI Adoption
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Advance Computing and Innovative Technologies in Engineering (ICACITE)
abstract: Recent decades have seen a quick development of artificial intelligence (AI) technologies and their integration into many spheres of human life, substantially influencing labor markets all over the world. Below is given a complete comparative analysis on the impacts of AI adoption in both developed and developing economies. This paper identifies the nuanced dynamics of disruptions in the labor market on account of the adoption of AI. We, therefore, look to an investigation of contextual differences within diverse economic contexts from a multidisciplinary perspective made up of economics, sociology, and technology studies. The first section of this paper summarizes the theoretical frameworks seeking a relationship between the adoption of AI and labor market disruptions. Drawing from existing literature, we highlight mechanisms through which AI technologies reconfigure jobs, job structures, job requirements for skills, and patterns of employment. The main mechanisms along which AI influences labor demand, the character of the jobs being offered, and, in aggregate, economic opportunities of individual agents can be summarized by automation, augmentation, and reconfiguration. From there, we will analyze the impacts of adopting AI in both developed and developing economies. This helps in underlining these divergent trajectories and outcomes, resulting from differences in the techno-readiness, institutional frameworks, and socio-economic context through the use of empirical evidence and case studies.

articleTitle: A Structured Design of 5G Based Assisted MTC System using Mission-Critical System
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Advance Computing and Innovative Technologies in Engineering (ICACITE)
abstract: Critical machine-type relationships (mc MTC) has become known as a crucial element within the Business Internet of Things (IoT) ecosystem, showcasing lucrative opportunities in disciplines like autonomous vehicles, intelligent energy/smart grid control, security services, while advanced wearable applications. As the fifth generation of cell phones unfolds, the changing environment of mc MTC puts diverse demands on the underlying technology. These demands embrace standards for low power usage, heightened dependability, and minimal delay connection. In answer to these challenges, recent versions and current advances in Long-Term Evolution (LTE networks) systems have added features that promote cost-effective solutions, increase coverage, reduce delay, and improve reliability for devices with different movement levels. This study focuses on assessing the impacts on mc MTC effectiveness in a connectivity network for 5G with varying user and equipment accessibility, influenced by a variety of movements. According to the study, integrating other modes of contact, such as quadcopter assistance and device-to-device linkages a voice, contributes a crucial role in achieving the strict demands of mc MTC programs across diverse situations that tell which includes industrial automation, vehicular connection, and urban messages. Significantly, our results confirm gains of as much as forty per cent in link availability and dependability when applying nearby connections as opposed.

articleTitle: The Resdesigning of Business Landscape Technology using hybrid algorithm-based Models
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Advance Computing and Innovative Technologies in Engineering (ICACITE)
abstract: Penetrations of modern Artificial Intelligence (AI) technologies have proven to bring a technical change in huge economics and have recently provoked many industries, evoking deep structural development in the modern business environment in Isabela State University. The respective research paper focuses on the exact analysis of the manifold implications that the adoption of AI poses on modern business environments, referring explicitly to the economic consequences, on the one hand, and the technical advances that build this transformative process. Economically, the penetration of AI technologies means that, with respect to changes taking place in the dynamics of production, distribution, and consumption, the classical business model is being redefined. Automation is going to be a key factor within AI to improve operational processes that guarantee more efficient productivity in different sectors. On one side of the coin, revolutionizing the decision-making process that analytics powered by AI enables, affords businesses room for finding value in petabytes of running data and being precise in strategy modifications. These have allowed streamlining of operations, creation of innovative products, and being competitive in gaining an advantage towards driving economic growth and market expansion. In so doing, technical dimensions were attached to the implementation of AI, which has redefined the basis of modern business infrastructure.

articleTitle: The Power of AI in Generating Novel Based and Impactful Character Development for Fiction Story
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Advance Computing and Innovative Technologies in Engineering (ICACITE)
abstract: The intersection of artificial intelligence (AI) and literature now embarks on a new realm of creating plots to develop stories and characters. This paper will delve in some detail to consider just how the landscape of storytelling has changed with the invention of new and advanced AI technologies, changing the nature of engaging tales as literature has otherwise always been carried out. This is one of those studies among them, “The Turing Test for Literature,” which examines the question of whether the leading AI is driving the traditional concept of authorship and human creativity into an even more subtle question. Underlining the discussion is the concept of the Turing Test, proposed by Alan Turing in the year 1950 as one of the methods to determine a machine’s intelligence. The test was originally designed to test whether AI could engage in conversation like humans. Although that offers a good stage for using the possibility that AI-authored literature would be undistinguished in plots and characters from human-authored ones, it remains likely that a great deal of literature could pass for being authored by humans. It is from this premise that questions, therefore, arise and call for an examination of AI-produced texts from human-authored works, parallels, differentials, and implications against the future of storytelling. The impact of AI extends to narrative construction in a manner that is beyond simple automation; it has an influence on the very nature of the creative process. Such linguistic competencies and stylistic finesse, which AI systems can “learn” and be fine-tuned to, come through the use of algorithms enabling large corpus text analysis and allow the systems to relate compelling stories.

articleTitle: The Optimized Algorithm Creation for the Whole HE System
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Advance Computing and Innovative Technologies in Engineering (ICACITE)
abstract: Thus, integration of artificial intelligence (AI) has become one of the very critical forces in the molding organizational dynamics within the present rapidly changing modern business environment. This paper, therefore, discourses a very large area: leadership in the age of AI, whose dense interconnections exist between technological development and organizational strategy and capacity in human leadership. Thus, the development of AI, according to the study, brings a different aspect of operations from decision-making processes right down to interfacing with customers, and leaders are to grapple with the challenges and opportunities that this presents as it demands strategic adaptation and innovative approaches. This paper sets out to explain how the technological paradigm AI is shifting the conventional paradigms of leadership. The very nature of their work is literally changed from being just managers to orchestrating collaboration between human and machine because of how AI-driven automation makes routine tasks either really easy and self-explanatory or because of the analytical capabilities of the tasks super critical to that transformation is developing a leadership ethos that recognizes the value and stewardship of adaptive standards for continuous learning and ethical use of AI technologies. This paper, therefore, discusses the ethical dilemmas that are evidently present in AI adoption in organizational contexts. These range from data protection and algorithmic bias to ethical implications in AI-based decision-making, cumulatively summing up to a rather tortuous ethical jungle through which the leaders should guide their organizations to a responsible deployment of AI technologies.

articleTitle: A Part of AI-Actuated Systems in Developing Analysis and Experiments in Various Sectors and Producing Innovative Products
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Advance Computing and Innovative Technologies in Engineering (ICACITE)
abstract: Artificial Intelligence (AI) is the new revolution developing in tradition and transforming the operation of diverse industries into a highly innovative base. The current research paper is holding in a profound insight into AI, which could impact the Research and Development (R&D) processes and product development. AI technologies are the way to help companies increase their ability to innovate, optimize processes, and provide consumers with products or services according to variable market requests. They first give an overview of AI technologies and how they are applied in the corporate R&D and product development frameworks. It considers how the utilization of AI-powered algorithms, for instance, machine learning, natural language processing, and computer vision, allows firms to process their scale of data easily, acquire valuable insights from the data, and be able to make better decisions based on the developed insight. This allows companies to identify those trends that are about to take place, predict consumer preference, and even optimize innovation strategies. On the other part, the paper also identified how AI enables companies to improve the R&D cycle while reducing the time to bring new products to the market. Technology allows companies to expedite the innovation process and, on the other hand, still be able to save quality and reliability through automation and optimization of many stages of development and product lifecycle, starting from ideation through to prototype, testing, and iteration.

articleTitle: Enhanced 403 Bypass Mechanism for Web Security
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Advance Computing and Innovative Technologies in Engineering (ICACITE)
abstract: A website is a collection of web pages and related content that is identified by a common domain name and published on at least one web server. The term web application refers to an application program that is usually stored on a remote server and is accessed through a web browser. Also, some kinds of web applications require a special type of web browser to access them. We are not able to access those types of web applications using regular web browsers. In general, web applications typically use server-side scripts such as PHP and ASP for storing and retrieving information/data. In addition, they use some kinds of technology. There are also web applications that use both client-side and server-side scripts to display the data/information to users, such as JavaScript and HTML. The organization or company can be contacted through online forms, online forums, shopping carts, content management systems, etc. Users can communicate with the organization or company through the use of online forms, forums, shopping carts, etc. We know that technologies will keep on building and the more websites the more vulnerable they will be so companies have to handle the security of their web application. Thus, securing them is known as web security. so the security teams have to find the loopholes and report them and then there is a vulnerability called 403 by-pass. Next, we will discuss what it is. If you don’t have permission to access a website or other resource, you’ll receive a 403 Forbidden Error message Web servers store everything else. It is usually the website itself that causes problems, but you can try refreshing the page Websites have become very more accessible to the page, clearing your cache and cookies and disconnecting from any VPN might be sometimes very much helpful.

articleTitle: Implementation of AI Based Algorithm and its Complications and Security Constraintsion in HE System
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Advance Computing and Innovative Technologies in Engineering (ICACITE)
abstract: The rapidly emerging uptake of AI within higher education brings with it a set of opportunities for innovation and efficiency but also a great set of ethical concerns, particularly around issues of fairness and transparency. The paper bases the discussion on ethics that needs to underpin the implementation of AI systems, where the context of the higher education landscape serves centrally on fairness and transparency. Therefore, these would definitely change the contours of teaching, learning, and administration. The AI-driven technologies bring about a personalized learning experience, predictive analytics in student success, and enable the smoother running of administrative duties. As AI starts to affect more critical decisions, like admissions, grading, and resource allocation, the questions and drives for fairness and transparency begin to become clear. This illustrates that the biases possibly residing within the data used to train AI algorithms therefore need to be the subject of paramount concern in ensuring fairness. They are either conscious or unconscious and work to further some form of existing inequality and discrimination. Addressing such biases requires very careful data collection, preprocessing, and algorithm design for equitability to assure fairness for the students, irrespective of their demographic or background. Transparency is no less important: all the participants of the higher education process, the students, the faculties, and administrations should be aware of the way the decisions have been made by AI systems. Moreover, transparent AI systems, which are subject to being scrutinized, can be held responsible for the outcomes, spotting mistakes or bias.

articleTitle: A Novel Way of Optimizing Technique Design using Artificial Intelligence to Improve Employee Working Template
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Advance Computing and Innovative Technologies in Engineering (ICACITE)
abstract: Artificial Intelligence (AI) is fast becoming one of the core aids of organizational dynamics because of their massive influence on the operational processes and very essence of the organizational culture. This is a research paper that delves into the multilateral influence of AI in relation to employee behavior, engagement, and performance within the organizational setup. The inclusion of AI technologies in the organizational setup is pushing the way for data-driven decision-making paradigms. This can be realized through the development of an increasingly supportive atmosphere through the customization of communications, training, and development initiatives according to individual needs and preferences of the employees. Individualized experiences also boost the engagement, motivation, and consequently the performance of the employee, as they have a feeling of being valued and understood within the organizational setting. However, the fusion of AI with organizational culture also brings very significant challenges; the most important of these is the possibility of unconscious AI bias on the part of algorithms, especially for the perpetuation or worsening of the existing biases in their decision-making processes. Organizations should, therefore, implement strong governance mechanisms that ensure AI technologies are used ethically.

articleTitle: The Techniques used for Sustainable Communication System FR 6-G type of N/W
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Advance Computing and Innovative Technologies in Engineering (ICACITE)
abstract: Inthe midst of the global commercialization of 5G technology, research institutions worldwide are turning their attention to the future, anticipating the emergence of 6 G networks that prioritize both high-quality service and energy efficiency. The envisioned 6G landscape foresees a revolutionary integration of traditional terrestrial mobile networks with emerging space, aerial, and underwater networks, ushering in a new era of ubiquitous, anytime-anywhere network access. This paper conducts an exhaustive survey on the wireless evolution towards 6 G networks, focusing on fundamental architectural changes. Key aspects include pervasive 3D coverage, the infusion of artificial intelligence across the network, and an enhanced protocol stack. Additionally, the survey delves into prospective technologies crucial for establishing sustainable and socially seamless networks, encompassing terahertz and visible light communication, novel communication paradigms, blockchain applications, and symbiotic radio technologies. The ultimate objective of this work is to offer illuminating insights that can guide subsequent research endeavors in the development of environmentally conscious 6 G networks.

articleTitle: An Integration of AI Technique in the Field of Healthcare Industry
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Advance Computing and Innovative Technologies in Engineering (ICACITE)
abstract: Over the last few years, the field of intelligent machines (AI) has experienced fast improvements in software algorithms to hardware deployment, and varied uses, especially in the area of healthcare. This thorough study aims to capture recent developments in AI uses within biomedicine, spanning disease diagnoses, living support, biological computation, and research. The primary goal is to record recent scientific successes, discern what is happening in the technological environment, perceive the enormous future scope of AI on biomedicine along and serve as a source of stimulus for researchers through related fields. It is obvious that, similar to the development of AI itself, the use of it in biology continues to remain in its infant state. This review expects ongoing breakthroughs and improvements that will push the limits and broaden the range of AI uses in the near future. In order to communicate the changing possibility of AI in biology, the study dives into individual case studies. These include anticipating of epileptic seizure events and the uses of AI in treating a faulty urine bladder. By studying these cases, the overview seeks to explain the visible impact of AI off healthcare and reinforce the chance of immediate developments in this evolving and promising field.

articleTitle: The Way of Machine Learning Based Solicit for Detecting Deceit in Online Based Transaction System with Security
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Advance Computing and Innovative Technologies in Engineering (ICACITE)
abstract: Detection of fraud still remains one of the most important challenges that continue to stir up research and following implementation of advanced technologies in the field of financial transactions, like machine learning.
