These rulings highlight the promise of the proposed method for accurately diagnosing seizures in patients who are experiencing muscular spasms and acknowledge the potential for improved impartial outcomes.

articleTitle: The Vibration Spectrograms as well as EL System for Assessing the Cutting Tool and Insert Condition
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Advance Computing and Innovative Technologies in Engineering (ICACITE)
abstract: In-process damage to cutting instruments can result in surface deterioration, leading to substantial financial losses. Detecting potential failures before they escalate to critical stages is vital, making Tool Condition Monitoring (TCM) indispensable. Previous research has predominantly focused on Machine Learning (ML)-based TCM, particularly Deep Learning (DL). To enhance the resilience of TCM frameworks in noisy cross-domain machining environments, a deeper understanding of deep neural networks, their hierarchical compositionality, and distributed modeling is necessary. This study delves into these intricacies and proposes an innovative approach using Ensemble Learning, combining CNN architectures such as AlexNet, ResNet-50, LeNet, Stand-5, and VGG-16. These architectures are applied to monitor real-time spindle vibrations associated with diverse milling cutter configurations, including both healthy and defective states. The collected data, transformed into time and frequency domains, was processed using graphical techniques, specifically spectrograms. The Ensemble Learning algorithm was meticulously trained, rigorously tested, and validated with diverse datasets, demonstrating promising results. This approach marks a significant advancement in creating a robust TCM framework capable of effectively identifying and mitigating damage in cutting instruments within complex machining environments.

articleTitle: Adaptation of Change in the Learning System with the use of Artificial Intelligence to Ensure Better Strategy
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Advance Computing and Innovative Technologies in Engineering (ICACITE)
abstract: The most disruptive technologies underpinned by advancements in Artificial Intelligence (AI) in recent times have been the avant-garde for transformative changes in various sectors,” Impacting operational paradigms and strategic. The higher education institutions, akin to the vanguard cradles of innovative knowledge, are exactly in the forefront of navigating the complicated dynamics of AI integration into their frameworks-academic and administrative, at that. The current study aims to delve deeper into the multifarious process of AI technologies in higher education settings in an effort to bring clarity to the current landscape, identify prevailing challenges, and unveil potential benefits and opportunities that AI heralds for academia. This mixed-methods approach will include quantitative information coming from surveys among the HE professionals and qualitative insights derived from in-depth interviews, in order to present an all-inclusive view regarding the role of AI in reshaping educational methodologies and administrative efficiency and the output of learning by students. This means that institutions are on the scale regarding the embrace of AI in their place, including institutional readiness, resource availability, and culture needed to facilitate the adoption of technology.

articleTitle: An Intensive Review on 6G and its Future Technological Developments using New Technology Integration
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Advance Computing and Innovative Technologies in Engineering (ICACITE)
abstract: As 5G deployment picks up steam, there’s been a noticeable change in the field of wireless research toward imagining what 6G will look like for communication in the future. The purpose of this article is to present the anticipated communication requirements and technology for the 6G future. The creation of digital twin realms that accurately replicate the biological and physical worlds in real time is the key to the future of connectedness as it is currently envisioned. The goal of this integration is to bring experiences from the digital, biological, and physical realms together. The development of novel man-machine layouts through productive local devices, the ubiquitous distribution of general computing across individual devices and the cloud, as well as multi-sensory integration of data for the creation of multi-verse corresponds and exciting mixed-reality experiences, and accurate sensing and actuation for efficient control of the physical world are emerging themes that are shaping 6G system specifications and technologies. The 6G air link and network will be supported by artificial intelligence, which will use data, computation, and energy as key resources to achieve higher performance. This paper also explores other revolutionary technologies that will likely shape 6G: cognitive spectrum sharing, integrating localization and sensing into system design, meeting strict latency and reliability performance requirements, new network architecture concepts involving sub-networks while RAN-Core convergence, and creative security and privacy strategies.

articleTitle: The Detection Of Spam in Various OM Through Ontological Method
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Advance Computing and Innovative Technologies in Engineering (ICACITE)
abstract: Many individuals use the opinions posted on social media these days when deciding what goods or services to purchase. Opinion spam identification is a challenging task because individuals and organizations can both create bogus evaluations for various reasons. They create fictitious reviews to deceive readers or use automation to trigger the detection system by elevating or lowering the status of the target products to harm their reputations or boost them. In this work, we offer a novel method to detect opinion spam with good accuracy by leveraging knowledge-based Ontology.

articleTitle: The Ai Illustration in Shifting the Technical Education System to Digital Era
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Advance Computing and Innovative Technologies in Engineering (ICACITE)
abstract: Higher education with the integration of Artificial Intelligence (AI) is a paradigm shift, which will reform pedagogical approaches and revolutionize administrative processes. This paper discusses the transformative effect that AI is likely to have on pedagogy and administration in institutions of higher learning, and its main purpose will be to shed light on opportunities and challenges that arise from this technological revolution. The pedagogical dimension outlines AI technologies that disrupt the traditional classroom and provide learning experiences that are customized to each student’s requirements. The analysis of student data by AI helps personalize content and interventions, leading to higher levels of learning engagement and thus improvements in academic performance. Besides, AI-equipped learning platforms go ahead to assist students in interactive and immersive experiences while learning. For instance, they use AR (Artificial Reality) in VR (Virtual Reality) artificial reality and AR to mimic real-life scenarios in which learners interact with and actualize skills learned in the real world. In addition, the AI algorithms allow the environment of automation of administrative functions, including admissions and enrollments, management systems, academic advisement, among others. Machinelearning and natural language processing-powered AI systems can assist in administering the efficient, fast, and data-driven decision-making process by helping process and get actionable insights from huge loads of data. In addition, the AI chatbots serve as virtual assistants for students and faculty to assist in prompt responses to the inquiries and getting required information, hence improving the efficiency of administrative activities.

articleTitle: A Structured Architecture Development for 6G Technology for the Accurate Communication
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Advance Computing and Innovative Technologies in Engineering (ICACITE)
abstract: Following the worldwide pandemic, the next age will bring with it never-before-seen possibilities as well as problems due to the revolutionary merging of the biological, digital, and physical domains of human experience. In order to seamlessly link these realms, a whole new infrastructure is needed to envision 6 G, a dramatic paradigm change. Breaking down architecture into its component parts of platform, works, orchestration, and specialization yields new ideas. Within a heterogeneous cloud architecture, the 6 G landscape that is being envisioned embraces an attitude of openness, scalability, flexibility, and platform agnosticism. Extremely specific architecture supports the complex decomposition of converged applications as well as services into micro-services with serverless operations. This innovative framework also has an open resource orchestration architecture. Important characteristics of these architectural possibilities are explained, with a focus on how they might be adjusted to the constantly changing technology landscapes of the future. At the airinterface leveled 6 G plans to use sub-Terahertz spectrum, use state-of-the-art technologies for sharing spectrum, optimize air-interface design using $\mathrm{AI} / \mathrm{ML}$ methods, combine radio sensing and communication, and meet strict latency, reliability, while synchronization requirements. As this thorough review explains, to fully use these radio technology breakthroughs, 6 G network design advances must occur concurrently.

articleTitle: The Role AI in Supporting Medical Data Field with Machine Learning Technique
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Advance Computing and Innovative Technologies in Engineering (ICACITE)
abstract: Artificial Intelligence (AI) has great potential to improve population health overall and transform the way healthcare is delivered. But integrating AI into healthcare comes with dangers that should be carefully considered to avoid unforeseen consequences. In response to this worry, the High-Level Expert Sort on AI of the European Commission has published extensive ethics guidelines towards “trustworthy” AI, providing practitioners and stakeholders with insightful information to guarantee moral and reliable AI applications. The emerging discipline of AI ethics studies has switched its focus from formulating abstract principles into practical suggestions as a reply to the European Commission’s initiatives. Interestingly, trustworthy AI is interpreted, relevant, and used differently in different situations and domains. This work contributes by illustrating how the general AI the HLEG, trustworthy AI standards may be used in the healthcare industry. A case study is provided that assesses how machine learning is now used in Copenhagen, Denmark, to assist in identifying cardiac arrest during emergency calls. An multidisciplinary team of the thinkers, administrators, social scientists, technological, legal, and medical professionals performed the evaluation. They used Z-Inspection ${ }^{\circledR}$ to uncover particular ethical trade-offs and obstacles related to practical uses of AI in healthcare. This multidisciplinary approach seeks to clarify intricate trade-offs and highlights the need for careful human scrutiny when dealing with the socio-technical elements of AI in care.

articleTitle: AI-Infused Research and Development in Universities: Accelerating Scientific Discovery
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Advance Computing and Innovative Technologies in Engineering (ICACITE)
abstract: The past decade has witnessed the role that artificial intelligence (AI) has in university research and development (R&D) processes emerge as a very potent catalyst for accelerating scientific discovery. It thus seeks to explore the transformative impacts that AI-infused R&D is likely to bring in universities, focusing mostly on key mechanisms, challenges, promising avenues for future exploration, and technological breakthroughs in the field. The traditional methodologies of R&D have seen a massive revolution through the entry of AI, which now poses uncharted capabilities in data analysis, pattern recognition, and predictive modeling. The application is able to thoroughly search vast sets of data in an unrealistically short period, so as to reveal latent structures, patterns, and other actionable insights, with the help of machine learning algorithms, neural networks, and natural language processing techniques. This paradigm shift in R&D supports a more agile, data-driven approach to scientific inquiry that allows researchers to better focus their efforts with precision and alacrity on the most vexing, complex problems. The biggest gain to be reaped from infusing $A I$ in R&D is the hastening of the pace of experimentation and hypothesis testing. AI systems thus enable researchers to iterate very quickly by automating repetitive tasks and offering the best designs for experimentation. This will, in effect, bring down the time-todiscovery cycle. Equally, AI simulations allow for the possibility of in silico virtual experiments, thus reducing overreliance on capital-intensive and unwieldy laboratory experiments.

articleTitle: Comparative Analysis of Interconnecting Converters for Clustered DC Microgrids
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Advance Computing and Innovative Technologies in Engineering (ICACITE)
abstract: As power systems evolve towards a more decentralized and interconnected structure, their topological structure is changing. Developing an electric grid which is sustainable and secure requires harvesting as much renewable energy as possible. To maintain sensitive loads such as electronic systems and commercial equipments, utilities are rapidly moving towards more flexible methods of power generation. As sources powered by DC, ESS (energy storage systems) and devices acting as load incorporated in electric power systems grow in popularity, microgrids based on direct current are becoming increasingly popular. A DC Microgrid typically consists of multiple interconnected sources, loads, and energy storage systems, and converters are essential components based on power electronic devices that facilitate the efficient operation of the microgrid. DC Microgrids also do not need to worry about the existence of harmonics, synchronization issues and the regulation of frequency or control of reactive power, however the conventional systems powered by AC have to. Even so, clustered DC Microgrids are being considered as a cost-effective solution to cope up with widespread distributed generation, ESS and loads that can be controlled. With clustering, the reliability on the whole will be increased, utilization of the resources will be optimized, and backup system investments will be reduced. Although DC Microgrids can be linked through the passive components (like tielines or power transformers), they pose some challenges as far as the question of controllability and modularity is concerned. The clustering of DC Microgrids has also been made possible by the use of Interconnecting Converters (ICs). Due to this, ICs function as energy routers in DC Microgrid Clusters, connecting and managing interconnections between interconnected DC Microgrids.

articleTitle: Automated Pothole Detection and Mapping for Road Maintenance
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Advance Computing and Innovative Technologies in Engineering (ICACITE)
abstract: Road deterioration leads to safety hazard and, therefore, it includes failure to address potholes in urban infrastructure. This study has developed an autonomous system that incorporates advanced sensing technology towards pothole detection and mapping. The unit comprises of an MPU6050 IMU which determines pothole roughness and a satellite navigation receiver for GPS positioning of potholes. Using IMU sensors results in high-frequent acquisition of accelerometers’ and gyroscopes’ readings that enables detecting, identifying, and classifying the size and severity of a bump upon its occurrence within no time. Thereafter, GPS module provides accurate coordinates for every discovered pothole that can be reliably located within a map interface. It comprises a data-summary section that helps in gathering specific information such as depth, their severity, and also the size of the potholes. These details are elaborate, detailed reports that advice road maintenance bodies about what parts should be repaired first and on which areas to direct their resources. The feature also entails a dynamic map view, which helps to see where the potholes are located on road network. The system correctly detects over 90& of the potholes, and classification accuracy among others exceeds 85&. The combination of real time data collection and mapping substantially enhances safety while achieving higher than average reliability levels for road maintenance. It is an important step toward data guided preventative roads management systems which can save the country resources and improve its road safety and life span of roads.

articleTitle: A Systematic Comparative Analysis of Influence of Artificial Intelligence (AI with DS) in Developing Smart Learning System
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Advance Computing and Innovative Technologies in Engineering (ICACITE)
abstract: As the day dawns for each technology to penetrate its way to various sectors, higher education seems to be the first field at the leeway of integration, especially with Artificial Intelligence (AI) coming to play. This paper discusses the interacting dynamics of AI and higher education infrastructure with a focus on the most impacted areas of learning spaces. It explores the manner in which AI would influence the design and use of smart learning spaces, including the effectiveness within higher education institutions. AI integration into higher learning infrastructure sees a paradigm shift on a large scale, where traditional learning environments turn into dynamic and adaptive spaces. It is in this paper that we bring out and discuss in great detail the multifaceted roles that AI plays in shaping smart learning spaces. It uses AI-driven technologies, for example, machine learning algorithms, natural language processing, and intelligent tutoring systems, to enable tailormade and participative learning experiences. In addition, this paper discusses the influence of AI on the architecture and planning of learning spaces. Analyses with AI give valuable information on how spatial layouts, environmental factors, and even furniture settings may be changed to let student engagement, collaboration, and knowledge retention reach its full potential. Further, AI-based monitoring systems are adaptive enough to follow changes in learning behavior in real time, thus empowering teachers to be adaptive by redesigning pedagogy and the learning experience according to individual students’ needs and interests.

articleTitle: The Integration of Artificial Intelligence and its Technological Optimizations Models to Enhance the Smart Marketing Management
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Advance Computing and Innovative Technologies in Engineering (ICACITE)
abstract: The role of artificial intelligence (AI) in marketing management has been slowly but evidently cropping up as one of the pivotal forces in the massive change of traditional approaches toward decision-making and strategy formulations, given the highly dynamic business environment of today. This paper will try to explore the far-reaching contribution of AI into marketing management and unveil its transformation potential from data into decisions. In the current digital era, data has been accelerating, and this actually means it throws challenges and opportunities at the marketing manager. AI, especially harnessed through machine-learning algorithms, helps marketers to navigate big troves of data with a rate of accuracy and speed not equaled by any other method previously. AI algorithms are unrivaled with data processing and are applied in marketing for trend analysis, from patterns of consumer behavior down to market trends, to churn out actionable insights that marketers can leverage. In the same note, one of the major advantages of using AI in marketing management is the fact that it leads to better personalization. Through AIdriven tools, the marketers can offer individual experiences per each customer and thus build stronger connections and drive up involvement. From the use of predictive analytics with refined segmentation techniques, AI offers a platform through which the marketer can deliver segmented content or offers to their target, hence providing relevance to the different sections of the audiences.

articleTitle: Ai’s Uses in Industry 7.O: An Industry Growth
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Advance Computing and Innovative Technologies in Engineering (ICACITE)
abstract: During the age of technology revolution, Artificial Intelligence (AI) was leading from the front row with regard to changing the modern business landscape. This research paper plunges deep into the impacts of AI on businesses from an economic, technical perspective; hence, these impacts are very significant and meaningful to study the evolution within the industry. This comprehensive economic analysis of the dynamics and technical advances AI is causing puts into perspective the far-reaching, multifaceted ways AI is shaping business across sectors. The general economic analysis reveals that AI’s impact is radical and wide in today’s businesses. The AI technologies greatly improved productivity and efficiency, reducing associated costs and increasing profitability to a very great extent for businesses. The evolution from the traditional workflow and organization to enable streamlined operations with optimized resource allocations was revolutionary and replaced with AI-driven automation. This paper discusses, therefore, how AI-powered analytics and predictive modeling are assisting businesses to make data-based decisions and thereby be more market-competitive. It will further look into the effect of AI on the employment dimensions, presenting issues of opportunity and challenge in the dimension of automation and transformation of the workforce. At a technical level, AI is actually a real revolution in the way business can be done and, in general, innovation can be sought.

articleTitle: A Well Design of Customer Centric Based Financing Service through Biometric Based Veritable System using Personalized AI Integrated System
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Advance Computing and Innovative Technologies in Engineering (ICACITE)
abstract: The modern banking landscape is subject to change, and in this backdrop, customer-centricity has emerged as the most supreme goal for any financial institution looking for upliftment in user experience, encouraging loyalty, and attaining sustainable growth. The paper delves at a junction of two technologies: biometric identification and artificial intelligence (AI)—as potential key drivers towards the enhancement of customer-centricity in bank operations. Against this background discussion, and through an in-depth analysis of current trends, challenges, and opportunities, this study will therefore provide clear and explicit implications for integrating biometric authentication and AI-enabled personalization into banking services. Biometric identification is the use of individual physiological or behavioral characteristics that validate identity, providing unrivaled security and ease in financial transactions. With the integration of biometric sensors in smartphones and other digital gizmos, customers enjoy uninterrupted access to their accounts either by fingerprint, face, or iris recognition-no passwords or PINs that sometimes can be a real bother. This paper undertakes a study on the efficacy of using biometric authentication for fraud risks, the benefits of streamlining the authentication process, and how all this can, therefore, result in trusting and satisfied customers. Biometrics combined with AI-driven personalization algorithms signal a change in the paradigm of banking customer experiences.

articleTitle: A Way Towards Next-Gen Networking System for the Development of 6G Communication System
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Advance Computing and Innovative Technologies in Engineering (ICACITE)
abstract: In this talk, the advancements announced by sixth-generation mobile communication (6G) as compared to the earlier fifth-generation (5G) system are carefully examined. The analysis, based in existing academic works, underscores the goal of improving diverse communication aims across various services. This study finds five crucial 6G core services designed to meet distinct goal requirements. To explain these services thoroughly, the framework presents two central features and delineates eight significant performance indices (KPIs). Furthermore, a thorough study of supporting technologies is performed to meet the stated KPIs. A unified 6G design is suggested, imagined as a combination of these supporting technologies. This design plan is then explained by the lens of five prototype application situations. Subsequently, possible challenges contained in the developing track of the 6G network technology are carefully discussed, followed by suggested solutions. The debate ends in an exhaustive examination of possibilities within the 6G world, seeking to provide a strategy plan for future research efforts.

articleTitle: The Roadmap of Creating and Implementing CBS Through Artificial Intelligence
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Advance Computing and Innovative Technologies in Engineering (ICACITE)
abstract: Artificial Intelligence (AI) radically changes the new leading edge of economic and technical innovations in all modern business. This research paper focuses on the multifaceted influence of AI on the modern business landscapes. It looks at the role of AI in unlocking new potentials through economic and technical advancements. AI technologies revolutionize conventional operational approaches in businesses with help to streamline companies, therefore allowing them for better efficiency and use of data-driven insights. This has now made room for businesses to optimize the resource allocation, forecast market trends, and even personalize experiences relevant for their customers in such dynamic market environments with the help of cutting-edge AI algorithms. It allows organizations to automate and take decisions that assist in changing market requirements and consumer needs through applying machine learning, natural language processing, and computer vision. Further still, the paradigms have shifted from the new and evolving innovations propelled by AI, which have actually fostered new business models and markets. AI has reshaped the dynamics of labor, consumption, and value creation. In addition, gig economy platforms fueled by AI, such as recommendation systems that power digital marketplaces, have reconfigured the dynamics of work, consumption, and value creation at an international level. AI further empowers mankind and small businesses in a growingly networked world that enables access to global markets and democratizes entrepreneurship.

articleTitle: A Well Structured System for Learning and also Evaluating the Outcome for the Better Learning using Artificial Intelligence in Higher Pedagogy
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Advance Computing and Innovative Technologies in Engineering (ICACITE)
abstract: Artificial Intelligence (AI) is evolving as a very important force in changing pedagogical frameworks and learning methodologies amidst the swiftly changing landscape of higher education. Hence, the present paper is an effort to outline the various dimensions of the role played by $A I$ in pedagogy at the higher education level, delving into its ramifications, challenges, and prospects. The following study, therefore, gives a measure of effectiveness in an extensive literature review and empirical assessment of AI to improve learning outcomes, the personalization of educational experiences, and encourage inclusion within the learning process. Informed through detailed discussions with experts and a literature review, the methodology to be adopted is a mix of both quantitative research through AI-driven learning analytics and a qualitative view of educators and students. These preliminary findings underline potential for AI further in adaptive learning, predictive analytics, and automated assessment while throwing into sharp relief critical ethical consideration points and challenges around data privacy and the digital divide. In this discussion, an analysis of the potential for AI to reimagine education is reflected within the framework of strong ethical frames and inclusive policies.

articleTitle: Ethical Design and Implementation of AI in the Field of Learning and Education: Symmetry Learning Technique
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Advance Computing and Innovative Technologies in Engineering (ICACITE)
abstract: The infusion of Artificial Intelligence (AI) in primary education promises the increased learning experiences and achievement among students, but in the face of these pluses, consideration of child privacy ethically comes as a major concern. This paper seeks to look into the nuanced role that leveraging AI technologies play in a manner that augments primary education while, at the same time, ensuring in the process protection to children’s privacy rights. The education sector has also been covered with artificial intelligence lately, which brings a place where facilities for individual learning, according to the exact requirement and style of learning of the student, can be put in place. More so, the basic level of education-that is from where the actual foundation of skills lies-a huge potential remains in terms of AI-based applications among students, in their engagement, autonomy, and academic attainment. Examples of such AI tools will be adaptive learning platforms, intelligent tutoring systems inspired towards practice, and educational games focusing on the diverse needs and preferences of the learner, hence redefining traditional approaches in pedagogy. However, the very penetration of AI into the primary education system raises mostly ethical questions, connected with child privacy. Using the capacities of AI-driven platforms, a child literally emits plenty of sensitive data from personal identifiers up to learning preferences and behavioral patterns.

articleTitle: Vision Based Littering Detection and Face Tagging using multi-model Architecture
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Advance Computing and Innovative Technologies in Engineering (ICACITE)
abstract: In this research, a new framework has been introduced to detect illegitimate littering action using multi-model architecture based on computer vision methods. The methodology aims to address the pervasive issue of littering by leveraging computer vision techniques. It utilizes a multi-model architecture, integrating pose detection, object detection and face recognition algorithms to identify relation between joints of a person and object held by them. Also, face tagging method is performed to mark the person as potential litterer which was not previously introduced in existing literature. This study conducted multiple trials which showed effectiveness of the model in real-world instance. Results showed overall precision of 0.947 and recall of 0.857 over a significant number of trials. The experimental analysis for individual components of this model has been discussed in ablation. With its potential to significantly mitigate the impact of littering, this innovative approach holds great promise for creating cleaner and more sustainable communities.

articleTitle: A Detailed Review Analysis of GPS used in Drone Technology and its Challenges
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Advance Computing and Innovative Technologies in Engineering (ICACITE)
abstract: In the current environment, the rise in robotic aerial vehicles (UAVs) has made a significant position in the business market, finding uses in various industries, trade, and pleasure activities for people of all ages. Each UAV is built with specific functions, leveraging advanced technologies suited to its meant tasks. However, the aspect of security regularly tends to be ignored, especially in the case of cheap UAVs missing strong security systems. This mistake poses a risk to the data communicated during their operation, possibly endangering the communication systems or the basic control of flight functions, which includes takeoff and landing. In many instances, these weaknesses subject UAVs to prospective cybersecurity risks, leading to illegal access and influence. Such safety hazards could result in physical or ethical harm, as bad players may abuse the vulnerable UAVs to steal private information, receive pictures, or conduct illegal activities. This paper throws light on the usage of a GPS flaw found in the industrial drones made by 3D Robotics. This specific weakness opens the door for evil users to gain authority over the UAV’s autonomy, allowing them to carry out illegal activities, such as flying in limited spaces as airports or as private areas. The discovery of this weakness shows that it’s urgent for Robots to adopt more powerful security systems. Emphasizing the safe functioning of GPS systems is crucial, given that, currently, military the Global Positioning System remains the single choice with a secure framework. It also serves as an encouragement to action for improving the overall security framework of business UAVs, protecting against possible dangers and ensuring appropriate utilization in various environments.

articleTitle: The Development of AI Navigated Innovative System Design to Enhance the Interactive Learning Sessions
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Advance Computing and Innovative Technologies in Engineering (ICACITE)
abstract: And now, it is taking the same position on these tracks of promises toward better learning experiences, improved administrative efficiencies, and individualized education pathways with Artificial Intelligence (AI). In all these breakthroughs, ethical concerns must be accompanied by delicate balancing. This paper shall, therefore, seek to explore the very wide multiplicity of ethical considerations that the AI age poses on higher education, where a fine balance has to be struck. There is increasing development in the rapid AI technological advances being adopted and integrated into various facets of education, with heated debates raised over issues touching on privacy and data security, bias, and mitigation of biases, and accountability. On the one hand, the great possibility to individualize learning according to the needs of every learner finds the right place within the integration of AI. On the other hand, there is room for seeing the risk of widening the existing gaps even further. It is, therefore, part of the institution’s role to ensure that this attention is given to ensuring the institution’s AI applications reduce bias, are characterized by diversity, and build cultures of inclusiveness.

articleTitle: The Design of Future Corporate Hierarchies: Re- Thinking Management Structures Through Artificial Intelligence
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Advance Computing and Innovative Technologies in Engineering (ICACITE)
abstract: These are some of the central sources of hype: the promises of substituting most of the ordinary managerial functions with artificial intelligence (AI) technologies within corporate environments. The paper explores the manner in which AI is revolutionizing business corporate hierarchies, examining the urgency of reinventing traditional management paradigms in line with moving landscapes. The old-form corporate hierarchies always emanated rigid top-down structures, where the decision-making authority cascaded from the upper echelon of the executives down to the lower tiers. The emergence of AI further provides an opportunity for redefinition in manners so as to lend the organizational framework more dynamism and responsiveness. Analytics-based AI and automation tools may help corporates rationalize the decision processes, efficiently deploying resources, and bettering the operational ability of the organization. The role to be played by corporate hierarchies needs to be redrawn on the canvas, rethought, and reconfigured, and one of the most important, indispensable decisions to be taken pertains AI systems can process large volumes of data and accordingly, at any point in time, help in making a data-driven decision at any echelon within the organization. Most importantly, this also nurtures a culture of innovation and agility within the organization since empowerment further to the front line is also inclusive of some level of decentralization in decision-making. In fact, managerial roles are being redefined by AI predictive analytics.

articleTitle: A Way of Safe Wireless Networks using IMU/UWB/Vision through Sensor Networks
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Advance Computing and Innovative Technologies in Engineering (ICACITE)
abstract: In current military and private spheres, the demand for exact localization within the home of mobile agents, especially small unmanned aircraft (UAVs), has attracted significant attention. This paper shows a new method to indoor UAV localization using Ultra-WideBand technology, combined with a cost-effective Motion Measurement Unit (IMU) while vision-based devices. A vital improvement to the positioning process is brought through the inclusion of an additional Kalman filter (EKF). The utilization of an inexpensive and low-cost IMU with the modeling phase, paired with the inclusion of vision odometer measurements for identifying marks in the closeness of the landing area, forms a key aspect of this method. The addition of range data plays a key role in reducing mistakes affiliated with the limited capabilities of gyroscopes and accelerometers, which are inherent in inertial devices. By deploying these multi-modal technologies that the suggested approach achieves a surprising level of precision, with data showing an amazing precision equal to 10 centimeters. This development holds potential for improving the operating effectiveness of small UAVs in indoor settings, offering a robust solution that joins Ultra-WideBand technology, IMU, while vision-based sensors throughout the framework of an Extension Kalman Filter.

articleTitle: Security in the World of Internet of Things (IoT): Overcoming Challenges
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Advance Computing and Innovative Technologies in Engineering (ICACITE)
abstract: Internet of Things (IoT) is turning out to be more prominent in our everyday existence, with smart home appliances and industrial control systems serving as examples. But the proliferation of IoT devices and internet connectivity increased the potential of security breaches. Botnet attacks, injection attacks, Domain Name Systems (DNS) spoofing attacks, firmware assaults, zero-day attacks, brute- force attacks, and cryptographic attacks may be used against IoT devices. These assaults may result in the loss of data, illegal access, and even physical damage to infrastructure and people. There are various potential courses of action. Machine Learning subpart of Artificial Intelligence have the capacity for finding and prevent dangers in real time. With blockchain technology, an IoT network can have a secure and unbreakable a record of every exchange and data transfers. Hardware-based security techniques, such as secure boot and trusted execution environments, may protect IoT devices against attacks that seek to compromise the underlying hardware or firmware. Standardizing security procedures may ensure that all devices can work together safely and achieve a given degree of security. The use of privacy-enhancing technology, IoT data may be kept confidential and sensitive information disguised.

articleTitle: A Well Designed Personalized and Optimized Model System Implementation for Specific Education System
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Advance Computing and Innovative Technologies in Engineering (ICACITE)
abstract: Diversified learners and their learning needs have always posed a big challenge in the education discipline. Special education, on the other hand, calls for individual interventions to avert all forms of learning styles, abilities, and challenges. The most recent development in the range of Artificial Intelligence (AI) technologies enables revolutionary opportunities in the Special Education sphere with personal approaches meeting unique requirements for each learner. This research paper, therefore, tends to delve much into the detail of AI-driven solutions designed to address the special needs and educational requirements of learners with disabilities. In other words, with the use of artificial intelligence, machine learning algorithms, natural language processing, and adaptive learning systems, AI has the potential to provide time-varying personalized interventions, which reflect the strengths, weaknesses, and individual interests of the learner. These methods, if need be, should be tailor-made to maximize output, encourage participatory learning from the students, and help special learners feel more independent and empowered..

articleTitle: Economic Levels Forecasting System By Evaluating with more Accuracy Using ML, DL and AI Systems
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Advance Computing and Innovative Technologies in Engineering (ICACITE)
abstract: The rise of Artificial Intelligence (AI) as a formidable tool in economic predictions is set to change earlier methods with unprecedented possibilities in processing big data sets and finding subtle patterns. The paper discusses the state-of-the-art impact of deploying machine learning models in economic forecasting. We intend to verify the effective implementation of AI techniques in predicting economic trend models through robust analysis, comparing with other methods currently in use, and their impacts on the decision-making processes. The paper begins with a brief background on the need for economic forecasting in a plurality of fields, i.e., government policymaking, financial markets, and corporate strategy formulation. Traditional forecasting methods are much criticized, and it frequently discusses limited efficacy in capturing complex and nonlinear relationships dynamically adapted to the market conditions. Machine learning algorithms, on the other hand, promise very flexible data-driven techniques that would expose underlying insights very deeply in diverse sources, from financial indicators to consumer behavior and to macroeconomic variables. This will be our focus: To analyze performance across the machine learning model spectrum in economic forecasting tasks—ranging from GDP growth projections to stock market forecasting. This is through empirical analyses that capture the exactitude and robustness of AI-driven forecasts with rich datasets spanning multiples of those economic indicators and historical trends.

articleTitle: Using In-Memory for intelligent Computing tech to Improve Deep Learning models in GCC
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Advance Computing and Innovative Technologies in Engineering (ICACITE)
abstract: To speed up fundamental computing activities like matrix-vector multiplication, in-memory computing (IMC) executes numerical calculations utilizing physical processes like charge collecting and current summation. IMCs have a great lot of promise for memory-intensive processing applications like deep learning and machine learning, but their design and implementation are quite difficult because of nonidealities in circuits and devices. An overview of current options and research prospects for deep learning accelerators employing novel memory technologies that might be used via IMC is provided in this article. The prerequisites include device technology, computer primitives, and digital, analog, and hybrid design approaches. Finally, the primary IMC device problems and metrics are examined and compared.

articleTitle: Modelling of Fuzzy Logic Based System for the Implementation of Model for Healthcare System with Accurate Prediction
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Advance Computing and Innovative Technologies in Engineering (ICACITE)
abstract: Budgetary restrictions force healthcare institutions to endure ongoing deterioration, which calls for better building capital deterioration modeling. A more sophisticated predictive model is essential to implementing a proactive maintenance approach and lowering unexpected failures. Hospitals now make subjective deterioration estimates based just on an individual’s age, which creates uncertainty. This research addresses the shortcomings of existing approaches by putting forward a novel stochastic degradation prediction model. The model, a fuzzy Markovian technique based on hybrid genetic algorithms, reduces subjectivity by anticipating based on the most recent observed circumstances. The model uses a nonhomogeneous transition matrix of probabilities (TPM) with fuzzy membership functions of condition, maturity, and relative degradation rate due to the paucity of data on the condition evaluation of important infrastructure. Genetic algorithm calibration improves TPM accuracy by addressing the limitations of expert-based models. A sensitivity analysis checks for changes in output when parameters are changed, ensuring the resilience of the model. Real hospital datasets are used for validation against a cutting-edge stochastic model, and the results show improved performance over existing approaches. In order to provide the best possible administration of healthcare facilities, this approach offers to assist decision-makers in creating effective maintenance of data-driven capital renewal strategies.

abstract: In this innovative quest for more efficient irrigation, we investigate the combined use of sensor technology and machine intelligence to optimize agricultural water usage. We collect precise data on essential variables, including water flow, temperature, humidity, soil moisture, and water level, every 15 days by promptly deploying sensors in the field to monitor them in real-time. We use the vast amount of data available to us to train machine learning models, including Recurrent Neural Networks (RNN), K-Nearest Neighbours (KNN), Artificial Neural Networks (ANN), and Convolutional Neural Networks (CNN), specifically for streams that are anticipated to have a certain distribution. CNN has exceptional precision with a decoding accuracy of 94.5% in visual signal interpretation, surpassing ANN, KNN, and RNN which achieve lower accuracies of 91.1%, 88.7%, and 83.6% respectively. Our investigation uncovers a fluid interaction between sensor data and model training, leading to each model exhibiting unique characteristics. These findings not only showcase the accuracy with which machine learning can distribute water, but they also signify a noteworthy progress in resource-efficient and sustainable agriculture. In addition to generating mathematical discoveries, our research establishes the foundation for advanced irrigation systems that smoothly integrate mechanical and natural processes in agricultural fields.

articleTitle: AI Healthcare Industry in Life Science Industry: A Perspective View
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Advance Computing and Innovative Technologies in Engineering (ICACITE)
abstract: The main goal of this study is to look at how well the innovation system for AI healthcare technology is working in the life science business and find things that are getting in the way of progress. A lot of different types of research were used for this study. It combines both quantitative and qualitative data from tertiary studies, business-related written sources, and conversations with 21 experts and 25 life science management leaders to get new ideas. The results make it clear that innovation system performance is being held back by a lack of resources and poor communication from top healthcare experts about what they need to improve healthcare with AI technology innovations. The study says that to deal with these problems, policymakers need to make changes that increase the resources that are available and come up with clear goals and visions for how AI technology can improve healthcare. Using the socio-technical technological advancement System (TIS) approach in the healthcare setting, the study adds to our knowledge of how the innovation system works and how different parts of it affect each other. Overall, this study throws light on the complicated ways that innovation works in the life science field. It gives lawmakers, industry workers, and other interested parties useful information for pushing AI healthcare technology forward in a sociotechnical framework.

articleTitle: Artificial Intelligence in HMI System
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Advance Computing and Innovative Technologies in Engineering (ICACITE)
abstract: We now stand at the brink of a technological revolution: the hotel industry is about to be transformed through the implementation of artificial intelligence (AI). This paper looks into AI adoption, focusing on the importance of adopting AI in the hotel industry, its alignment with industry requirements, and how staff satisfaction is affected. The hotel business, according to such dynamic market tendencies of the recent past, and growing pressure on efficiency and personalization of guest experiences in light of competitiveness, meant there were chances to explore innovative technologies, and AI happened to be one such puzzle piece. “AI-driven systems could forecast volumes and timing with a probability above 50%. The best benefit is that the entry of AI into the hotel industry is not any strategic issue of modernization. Today’s guests demand personal, tailor-made service and frictionless experiences, which data and AI enable them to do, with insights and recommendations developed specifically for them. Such AI-powered platforms empower hotels to predict guest needs, optimize price strategy, and curate offerings based on requirements that can ignite an acceleration of revenues and loyalty. However, the successful implementation of AI in hotels will depend on good power technology, including workforce integration and employee satisfaction. However, displacement risk for jobs aside, AI has the ability to reinforce human roles and allow employees to practice involvement in much more creative, emotionally intelligent, and people-skilled kinds of tasks.

articleTitle: Automatic Guidance Vehicle using Modularised Instruction Cards
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Advance Computing and Innovative Technologies in Engineering (ICACITE)
abstract: In this respect, modularity of instruction cards can be employed. This gives the AGV an adaptable and flexible technology. Technology should be in a position to personalise the operating of AGVs concerning the activities and locations within a facility. Small-scale firms have a lot of unpredictable challenges, and therefore, they need to have settings of their production and processes change at their convenience. It is easy to AGV behavioural changes with modularised instruction cards in use. The adaptability of the AGV can, therefore be made according to the industrial requirement in time using unique instruction cards in use for the said process. This adaptability will enable small-scale organizations to have their automation implemented in stages and in a cost-effective manner. That is will ensure that firms with fewer resources enjoy sustainable production. This paper, therefore seeks to enhance the GPS navigation using RFID technology. Indoor interference impairs the accuracy and reliability of a GPS signal. This restricts accurate positioning, which is required to carry out efficient material-handling activities. Signal latency and inconsistency: GPS signals can be slow in big urban areas or if the sky is hidden. This can lead to inaccurate or delayed navigational instructions. RFID cards will be mounted around the building in a manner that provides accurate waypoints for the navigation of the AGV. They will carry the location of information and AGVs navigate with accurate task completion.

articleTitle: The Latest Technology and its Integration for the Development of Healthcare(Medical)
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Advance Computing and Innovative Technologies in Engineering (ICACITE)
abstract: Healthcare advances that use Artificial Intelligence (AI) to analyze data, use devices, and identify patients offer new possibilities for better patient care, cutting costs, and growing the medical sector. The age of specialized human health tests has begun. It uses noninvasive instruments, sound, visual the use of photography, electronic health tools, embedded health instruments, fluidic diagnostic tracking, and combined data analysis to provide people with tailored medical suggestions. These technologies contribute to early identification and comprehending of health issues linked to chronic illnesses and general health using information analysis and AI-driven ideas. Notable uses include a Parkinson’s and Huntington’s Under certain circumstances, diabetes, cancer, kidney disease, heart problems, elderly care, and a number of healthcare areas. Industry changes are expected as a result of the latest breakthroughs in outdoor monitors, AI-driven evaluation of data, and healthcare testing technologies. AI systems give data to people and health workers, possibly better their way of life and cutting healthcare costs. These include: tracking the effectiveness of medicines, finding chronic illnesses early, and offering individualized care using medical trends and DNA. In relation to healthcare studies and sensor tracking, this study explains new technologies and advances in diverse fusion methods, materials, and processes. Precise diagnostic info, small merchandise dimensions, and cost are high considerations. Healthcare workers, patients, consumers all benefit from more personal health care services thanks to the merging of AI with information streams. The text highlights both advantages and hurdles while showing the way toward upcoming displays and academic papers that follow a path of growth in the industry.

articleTitle: A Development of Cloud Based Robotics Design Networks for Industry Applications
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Advance Computing and Innovative Technologies in Engineering (ICACITE)
abstract: In modern robots, the usage of computationally expensive models involving deep neural networks, also referred to as DNNs, for tasks such as the localization of operations awareness, planning, and object recognition is becoming prominent. Nevertheless, resource-constrained machinery, such as low-power aerial vehicles, often lack the requisite internal computing resources to easily run cutting-edge simulations of neural networks. Cloud robotics appears as an answer, allowing robots to offload processing to centralized computers for greater precision models. Nonetheless, the ignored downside of cloud robots lies in the possible delay and data loss experienced during contact over crowded wireless networks. This study discusses the Robot Transferring responsibility Problem, exploring when and where robots should offload sense tasks that improve accuracy while reducing the costs involved with cloud communication. The method involves framing shifting as a sequence decision-making issue concerning robots and suggesting a remedy using sophisticated reinforcement learning. Through models and hardware tests employing advanced thinking DNNs, what was suggested sharing strategy improves vision task efficacy by 1.3 2.6 times as a result of standard strategies, allowing robots to increase their sense accuracy while incurring minimal communication via cloud costs.

articleTitle: Implementation of AI used Algorithms Design Models for to Create Healthcare Smart System
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Advance Computing and Innovative Technologies in Engineering (ICACITE)
abstract: In the field of healthcare spending prediction, various methods, including probabilistic and neural draws near, have been suggested, yet an insufficient stress has been placed on assessing their forecasting powers, alongside ensemble techniques. This work tries to assess different models of statistics, such as persistence (a starting point) and autoregressive mixed moving average (ARIMA), next to computational models of neurons such as multiple-layer perceptron (MLP) as well as lengthy short-term memory (LSTM). The main focus swirls around forecasting weekly average expenses on specific pain medicines. Further, an ensemble model, merging results from ARIMA, MLP, while LSTM, was adjusted for improved accuracy. The study scrutinizes the effect of shuffling conditioning data and adding breakdown in MLPs, when likewise, mixing training data and leaving out dropout in LSTMs while instruction. The results show the better performance of the combined approach over the individual’s dedication, ARIMA, MLP, and LSTM techniques across both pain medicines. Notably, for MLP models, keeping an order of training inputs while instituting dropout gave ideal results, while to stay LSTM models, changing training data without applying dropping proved beneficial. This study underlines the implications of applying statistical, neural, while combined techniques in time-series predictions for healthcare results.

articleTitle: Corporate Agility and AI: Enhancing Adaptive Strategies for a Dynamic Technological Landscape
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Advance Computing and Innovative Technologies in Engineering (ICACITE)
abstract: Thus, in the fast-changing technology environment, the most critical question that faces any organization is not “whether” to go for corporate agility but to “what degree” and “how best” to develop that flexibility. The present paper considers corporate agility to intersect with artificial intelligence (AI) and, in this regard, seek how to perfect more adaptive strategies in the dynamic business environment. In a business world characterized by an unmatched complexity and uncertainty, a constant ability to respond and adjust for changed circumstances has become a new currency to continue in success. Starting with the definition of corporate agility in the modern paradigms of business and underlining its importance, the paper defines corporate agility as an organization’s capability to be aware, foresee, and respond to the shifts in markets, new technologies, and competitive pressures. It will cover the basic principles of flexibility, responsiveness, and resilience in the agility and what it may mean or imply at the organization’s side of structures, processes, and cultures. It aims at establishing the transformative potential of AI technologies for organizational agility. All of this enables the organization to look for trend analysis and trends within varied, big data sets, and even anticipates strategic opportunities and threats in real time. While the former is fast emerging as a standard tool in the extraction of critically important information from data, algorithms of machine learning, advanced analytics, and predictive modeling help in empowering agile choices amidst varying uncertainties for the decision-maker to keep them informed with actionable intelligence.

articleTitle: AI and Image Processing Based Intelligent Personal Assistive tool for Alzheimer’s Patient
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Advance Computing and Innovative Technologies in Engineering (ICACITE)
abstract: The concept of an Alzheimer’s Patient Notification System stands as a comprehensive support mechanism, incorporating medication reminders and real-time alerts for missed doses. In this design, the system not only provides reminders but also detects if the patient is present or absent during medication time. If the patient is observed in front of them or detected as absent, the system triggers an immediate SMS notification to their designated guardians or family members. Moreover, in case of an emergency situation, the system is designed to promptly notify the guardians, ensuring timely support and intervention. This system amalgamates medication management, proximity detection, and emergency response to create a holistic support structure for Alzheimer’s patients and their caregivers

Documents are created at every phase of the data generation lifecycle to improve communication, aid in decision-making, and highlight the need of careful data work. articleTitle: The Design of new Way of Fuzzy Trees for the Implementation of Strategic Plan of Medical System for the Personalised Care
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Advance Computing and Innovative Technologies in Engineering (ICACITE)
abstract: Reliability stands as a vital feature in varied systems, particularly in healthcare systems. These systems need specific mathematical models because reliability engineering views them as complicated and unpredictable. Although the structure function accurately captures actual systems, its use in the context of partial or uncertain data is hampered by current deterministic approaches. This research uses fuzzy decision structures (FDTs) to evaluate incomplete data and suggests a novel method for building the structural function. Here, input and output characteristics are understood as values from the structure function and as component states, respectively. The reliability study of a system of health care, namely the four-component, 36-state vector laparoscopic surgical system, serves as an example of the technique. Furthermore, three benchmark systems with 243, 108, et 512 state vectors in respectively, are used to evaluate the suggested approach. When state vectors are randomly removed (from 5% to 90%) prior to the generation of the structure function, uncertainty is introduced. For each of the systems that utilize a 50% deletions rate, the error rate stays below 0.2%. The research concludes that handling missing data in health care facilities is a good fit for reliability analysis based on FDT.

articleTitle: The Balancing of GN to Optimize the 5G Communication
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Advance Computing and Innovative Technologies in Engineering (ICACITE)
abstract: Frequently, the widespread belief that green technology provides energy that is both environmentally friendly and economical is held without a comprehensive analysis of the costs involved. The objective of this research is to evaluate and contrast mobile networks that are focused on renewable energy with those that are traditional in nature. In order to fathom the numerous variables necessary for advocating the green/renewable approach or the conventional one, a mathematical model is presented. The results indicate that green networks have the potential to be significantly more cost-effective than conventional networks, by approximately twofold, as illustrated by a cloud radio access network. The research highlights the criticality of enhanced operational control in green technology in comparison to conventional approaches for producing equivalent power. By incorporating a wide range of variables including sites, cities, countries, geographical areas, and equipment manufacturing characteristics, the proposed model facilitates the forecasting of forthcoming compromises in the overall efficacy of green networks. The ability to predict outcomes provides service providers, investors, and network purveyors with the knowledge necessary to determine the most advantageous ratio between the two categories of networks.

articleTitle: Transformation from 5G N/W to 6G N/W Through Technology Inclusion
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Advance Computing and Innovative Technologies in Engineering (ICACITE)
abstract: For us, figuring out where we are or where our resources are has always been important. While technology has greatly benefited this quest, real-time interior locating remains a daunting problem, from conventional instruments like sextants to contemporary outside GPS devices. With the introduction of 5G mobile networks, network-based location became a practical option. With the help of sophisticated radio technologies, decreased end-to-end latency, specialist control protocols, and increased processing power at the network edge, 5G’s full promise for indoor and outdoor placement could now be realized. This study provides a thorough introduction to network-based positioning, examining advanced machine-learning-supported solutions as well as underlying ideas. A detailed comparison of learning methods used in network-based positioning is a significant addition. The article provides a forward-looking strategy to positioning using these advanced networks, as we expect the progression to 6G networks. Various application examples from different sectors are offered to highlight the topic’s practical ramifications, with a focus on industrial industry vehicular applications. The goal of the material is to be both insightful and educational, serving as a useful tool for comprehending and managing the rapidly changing field of location-based technology.

articleTitle: An Intensive Review Analysis about Fuzzy Logic usage in Smart Medical Care System
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Advance Computing and Innovative Technologies in Engineering (ICACITE)
abstract: This paper presents a novel automated approach to medical data classification using an interval type-2 fuzzy thinking system (IT2FLS) and wavelet transformation (WT). Wavelet coefficients are highly discriminative features that serve as condensed reconstructions of the underlying data. Uncertainty and high-dimensional data provide issues that are addressed by the combination of WT and IT2FLS. With the use of fuzzy c-means (FCM) clustering for unsupervised structure learning and evolutionary algorithms for supervised parameter adjustment, the IT2FLS employs a hybrid learning approach. The use of WT streamlines this computationally demanding learning process, lowering computational load and improving IT2FLS performance. Well-known medical datasets (Cleveland heart disease and Wisconsin breast cancer) from the UCI Collection for machine learning are used for experimental assessments. Computed performance measures include area under the receiver operator characteristic curve, sensitivity, specificity, and accuracy. The findings demonstrate the better efficacy of the wavelet-IT2FLS methodology in comparison to other machine learning techniques, such as adaptive neuro-fuzzy inference system, fuzzy ARTMAP, support vector machine, and probabilistic neural network. The suggested approach has potential to assist clinicians and medical professionals in making decisions.

articleTitle: Development of Medical IOT System for the Prediction of Heart Disease
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Advance Computing and Innovative Technologies in Engineering (ICACITE)
abstract: There are many uses for the Internet from Things (IoT) in fields like industry, healthcare, and farming. The worldwide popularity of the Internet about Medical Things (IoMT) has grown thanks to a big increase in personal tech, especially in health tracking systems. IoMT is very important for lowering death rates by finding diseases early, but it is very hard for it to predict heart illnesses from clinical records. Heart disease detection has been the subject of studies in the past, but their accuracy is still not great. In response, a new IoMT framework is suggested for predicting heart disease. This framework uses modified Salp Cluster Optimizer (MSSO) alongside an Adaptive Fuzzy Inference System for Neuro-Fuzzy (ANFIS). The Levy flight method makes the MSSO-ANFIS model better at searching, going beyond the limits imposed by conventional gradient-based discovering in ANFIS. Heart disease can be predicted by looking at medical records that include things like heart rate, age, sex, difficulty breathing, cholesterol, and blood sugar. The suggested model does a better job than others at classifying sensor data using MSSO-ANFIS. It achieves an impressive 99.45% accuracy and 96.54% precision. This program proves that MSSO-ANFIS is good at predicting diseases and shows that it is better than other methods.

articleTitle: The Various Techniques in Mmcn: An Overiview
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Advance Computing and Innovative Technologies in Engineering (ICACITE)
abstract: Molecular communications provide a fresh approach to deciphering complex biological systems. The topic of mobile molecular communication networks is examined in this article, with a focus on calcium signaling within a population of mobile cells. Taking inspiration from conventional communication networks, we investigate multi-modality behavior using a multimedia method. We initially utilize a random walk model to study the stochastic mobility of biological cells and the dynamic features of cellular networks. Next, a mathematical model is proposed to explain how calcium signals arise and propagate throughout mobile networks. We further provide a thematic framework and expand our study to a multimedia context. Using this approach, we study two forms of calcium signaling transmission: waveform transmission and concentration transmission. To further explain our findings, we use simulations to show the patterning of calcium signal waveforms. The results show that the surroundings have an impact on performance. Additionally, the simulation shows performance differences between the two transmission methods, confirming the features that our proposed multimedia theme has.

articleTitle: Development of Fuzzy Based Models for Detection System with More Accuracy for the Implementation of Healthcare/Clinical System
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Advance Computing and Innovative Technologies in Engineering (ICACITE)
abstract: Many electronic infection detection systems often use binary classification techniques, which identify patient data as either pathology-indicating or normal in relation to different forms of infections. The Moni-ICU system, which is used in the critical care units of Vienna General Hospital, is noteworthy for introducing a novel third category called borderline. This categorization indicates patient data that partially satisfies the corresponding needs by closely aligning with virus-related clinical concepts or infections related to healthcare (HAI) surveillance categories. The probability of classifying patient data into normal, borderline, of pathological categories with respect to infection-related medical ideas and HAI definitions was calculated by integrating fuzzy sets of propositional fuzzy rules. This deviation from dichotomous approaches prevents the possible misunderstanding of borderline findings with normal ones, a major difficulty in binary classifications. Data collection included a thorough analysis of 5099 individuals treated over a two-year period, including adult patients across 10 ICUs at Vienna General Hospital. The Moni-ICU knowledge base, which includes fuzzy sets and rules for four top-level HAI definitions and 10 infection-related clinical concepts, made the categorization process easier. In order to verify the accuracy and dependability of the system, the assessment focused on how suitable borderline classifications were in relation to normal values for related HAI criteria.

articleTitle: A Strategic Design of Personalized Based Learning System for Improving the Experience of Outcome Based Education
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Advance Computing and Innovative Technologies in Engineering (ICACITE)
abstract: With changing dynamics in higher education, methodologies driven by data, and the integration of artificial intelligence (AI) are emerging as perhaps the most transformative forces that are sure to overhaul traditional models of teaching and learning. This paper looks into the rapidly rising discipline of data-driven education and how its fostering factors could bring their contributions to helping realize the proposed vision for a new future of personalized learning experiences within higher learning institutions. Therefore, the general objective of the study is to establish how integrated AI technologies within the educational data analytics system are poised to support the heterogeneous needs of learners, boost teaching modalities, and eventually improve academic gains. In fact, large datasets of students’ demographic, learning preferences, performance, and academic datasets will offer deep insights into individual learning trajectories, which, in turn, will be the basis for tailoring educational interventions. The research is much relevant to the study that all the researched approached, including machine learning algorithms, techniques of natural language processing, and predictive analytic models, be studied. It allows educational stakeholders to observe patterns in such data and thus predict student behavior for the prescription of personalized learning pathways. This enabled students to access personalized content, receive continuous feedback, and at the same time have an interactive learning experience that was tailored to their level of proficiency and style of learning.

articleTitle: IP & IoT Based Waterbody Surveillance (Monitoring) Process Implementation for Floods Alert System
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Advance Computing and Innovative Technologies in Engineering (ICACITE)
abstract: This think about offers a novel strategy for observing riverbed water levels utilizing computer vision, picture handling, and the Web of Things. Surge escalated appraisals may be computed by comparing the level of the stream with the shoreline. Client notices are encouraged utilizing Ubidots, an Online of Things (too called IoT) framework that gets concentrated information. Social media destinations are utilized to inform the open when water levels rise over basic levels. As a controlling gadget, the plan coordinating a Banana Pi 3 B show that comes with a Banana Pi 5MP sensor bundle. This work’s fundamental commitment is the integration of picture handling with IoT clouds. creating a cutting-edge surge checking instrument to combat warming temperatures, locate flood zones, and caution individuals to circumstances that may be perilous. In this inquire about, stream level and bank level are decided by comparing the adequacy of edge discovery calculations. articleTitle: A Well Structured Strategy Development via AI Integrated Analytics Systems to Improve Performance of Education
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Advance Computing and Innovative Technologies in Engineering (ICACITE)
abstract: Perhaps the two goals that have been most emphatically underscored within the changed landscape of higher education include personalized education and the optimization of student outcomes. Artificial intelligence (AI) thus comes on the horizon as a more decisive force, especially considering the field of learning analytics. This research paper investigates the application of AI-driven learning analytics in universities. The main objective is to clarify if, in fact, it is able to predict students’ performance with more precision and effectiveness than traditional methodologies. This identified the inclination of the present study because of the default limitations in learning analytics that were noticed: the dependence on static and historical data with linear predictive models. The AI model developed by us has been quite successful in predicting at-risk students much earlier in the course, which gives the educators a fair chance for timely interventions. Valuable insights related to factors that most significantly influence student success and, therefore, potentially uncover areas that need pedagogical enhancement are brought to light by further analysis. These findings have several implications. The integration of AI in learning analytic systems thus provides ways through which educational policymakers or university administrators could easily customize the educational strategies according to individual student needs, hence developing a supportive and more efficient learning environment. This would therefore add to a growing pool of empirical evidence that AI has great potential in LA improvement in educational technology.

articleTitle: The Implementation of NGCPS to Integrate AI in Order to Get the Accurate Decision Making
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Advance Computing and Innovative Technologies in Engineering (ICACITE)
abstract: This has ushered in a new era of interconnectivity of Cyber-Physical Systems (CPS), where the physical entities are also networked with the computational systems and henceforth open new opportunities and challenges. This paper presents the development of some of the capabilities of real-time decision-making in artificial intelligence (AI)-based techniques in CPS for improved efficiency, reliability, and adaptability of the concerned system in a given domain. On this, our research builds over and thereby clearly understands the complex interrelationships of the physical processes and computational intelligence in CPS frameworks. We highlight the following specific characteristics of CPS—distribution, heterogeneity, and real-time requirements—that are enforcing novel ways of supporting decisions. Towards the end, we will reinforce the CPS supported by autonomous decision-aid that capitalizes on the use of frontrunner AI technologies, like machine learning, deep learning, and reinforcement learning, to gain agility in responding to dynamic environments and the occurrences of events. For this purpose, the major challenge addressed in the paper is the seamless and easily achievable integration of AI algorithms in CPS architectures, ensuring scalability, robustness, and real-time performance at the same time.

articleTitle: AI Integrated ST Modern System for Designing Automated Standard Affirmation System
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Advance Computing and Innovative Technologies in Engineering (ICACITE)
abstract: This is a phenomenal approach toward a game-changer in AI-driven software testing and assures quality automation of the software product, facilitating faster, more exact, and very comprehensive checking of the software product.
