This would present a very solid architecture that would lay the ground for leveraging the capabilities of artificial intelligence (AI) in the automation and enhancement of the software testing process. The framework assumes that AI integrated with software testing can make a giant leap in test coverage, precision, and efficiency, which eventually ensures software with higher quality. A number of key constituents, each with the aim of tackling specific challenges that the software testing lifecycle poses, join to form the foundation of the Mitra framework. It includes at its very base machine learning (ML) algorithms and natural language processing (NLP) techniques that automatically produce and optimize test cases. Not only does this bring down the manual effort in creating test cases, but it also betters the detection capability for not-identified cases earlier, especially edge cases, which helps in bettering the test coverage. Other than that, the very important feature of the framework includes AI for better predictive analysis. The system is able to predict potential future software defects based on the historical data of software defects and test results, hence alerting the testers at an early time for correction before the issues become bigger defects. This predictive capability helps reduce the investment of time and resources taken in finding and fixing defects and further provides the ability to prioritize testing efforts considering their likelihood and the severity of potential defects.

articleTitle: The Technical Ethics used in Bad and SD Methods: A Deep Review
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Advance Computing and Innovative Technologies in Engineering (ICACITE)
abstract: Artificial intelligence (AI) is the process by which human-designed systems analyse available data and make judgements based on predetermined criteria in order to accomplish particular objectives. The incorporation of artificial intelligence (AI) has sparked a deep ethical conversation among key players, including tech companies, businesses, educational institutions, and legislators. AI’s ethical problems have prompted the creation of ethical frameworks that aim to control its application for the good of society, the defence of human rights, and the maintenance of individual autonomy and privacy. This paper provides a critical evaluation and summary of the fundamental concepts behind the use of artificial intelligence, with a focus on the GDPR’s (General Data Protection Regulation) approach. The rights of data subjects, data protection legislation, and data subjects’ permission are crucial considerations in the context of “privacy by design.”

articleTitle: A Development of AI Connected System with Adaptive Assessments Method for Evaluation Methods in Education Field
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Advance Computing and Innovative Technologies in Engineering (ICACITE)
abstract: Thus, assessment methods bear importance in the ever-blooming state of education, as they are determinant of how a student progresses in his or her studies. Traditional ways of assessments have been very informative, but they do not fulfill the standard of adaptability and providing personalized feedback to students coming up with diversified learning processes. To these challenges, new hopes lie in Artificial Intelligence (AI) of being a modern look into reforming the evaluation methods. It is in this view that the current research paper explores the potential of AI-powered adaptive assessments in revolutionizing primary education. The present review paper gives a detailed discussion of multifaceted benefits and implications of integrating AI into assessment practices through review available relevant literature, new technology updates, and research. At its core, AI-powered adaptive assessments provide the ability to dynamically tailor the test-taker experience based on the attributes of a highly unique student profile. The assessments use machine learning algorithms to analyze real-time answers from students and their learning patterns, what they are strong or weak in learning. Such comprehensive understanding would enable the delivery of more customized feedback and learning pathways, thus ensuring that students receive much more engaging and effective learning environments.

articleTitle: The Novel use of AI and ML System Integration in Developing Spruce Metropolis
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Advance Computing and Innovative Technologies in Engineering (ICACITE)
abstract: This paper presents a pioneering routing protocol, particularly in urban infrastructures, by the utilization of a combination of SDN and machine learning technologies, mostly Naïve Bayes, to the programmer. The emerging Internet of Things and 5 G will offer new improvements in connectivity and infrastructure management in smart cities. This paper therefore targets transportation systems of smart cities in order to reduce end-to-end delays and reduce air congestion through predictive routing optimization. The proposed framework is conducted through several steps, among them the generation of a complete dataset derived from the real-world traffic simulations, and realized through the utilization of a mechanism that is commonly known as the Simulation of Urban Mobility (SUMO). This will help the proposed protocol to know the good approaches based on predictive routing with the help of defined Naïve Bayes algorithms in the SDN controller. This architecture introduces a central controller responsible for coordinating communication in the network. The evaluation of the performance of existing routing methods, including multipath routing, optimized link state routing (OLSR), and along with Q learning, shows the importance of the proposed SDN-Naïve Bayes approach. The metrics are packet delivery ratio, throughput, packet loss ratio, end-to-end delay, packet jitter, etc., which will show the effectiveness of the new protocol when enjoying the high quality of the network. The proposed protocol has great potentials in improving the efficiency and reliability of communications in smart city environments using the capacities of SDN and ML. Introducing changes in the route in a predictive manner will not only optimize the use of resources, but also help in the achievement of reliable and reliable connectivity, which holds importance for the development of urban infrastructure.

articleTitle: A Novel and Accurate Method of Diagnosis via AI and ML for Smart HC System
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Advance Computing and Innovative Technologies in Engineering (ICACITE)
abstract: Recent breakthroughs in the internet of Issues (IoT), computing through the cloud, and the use of AI have changed the standard healthcare system, making a case for smart health care. By combining key technologies including IoT and AI, there is a major improvement in medical services. The merging of IoT and AI offers multiple possibilities within the healthcare industry. This study piece presents a new artificial intelligence- and internet of things convergence-based framework for disease detection in smart health care systems, emphasizing especially on cardiovascular diseases and diabetes. The suggested model includes separate steps, including data collection, preparation, classification, and parameter modification. Utilizing Internet of Things devices like smartwatches along with sensors enables smooth collection of information, while AI methods harness this data for the detection of illnesses. The technique presents a new approach, applying to the Crowd Search Optimizer algorithm-based Flowed Long and Short-Term Memory (CSO-CLSTM) approach to disease detection. CSO is applied to improve both ‘weights’ while ‘bias’ factors of the CLSTM framework, while the isolation Fg (iForest) method is implemented to remove outliers. Through testing with health care information, the CSO-LSTM model got excellent accuracy ratings of 96.16% when 97.26% in identifying heart disease while diabetes, respectively. Consequently, the suggested CSO-LSTM model appears as a solid and reliable method of disease evaluation in digital healthcare systems, showing its potential for broad application.

articleTitle: Exploring Applications, Challenges, and Future Research Paths in of crops of plants to yield better crops: Security Frameworks
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Advance Computing and Innovative Technologies in Engineering (ICACITE)
abstract: Of crops is a system designed to provide a broad variety of crops services by integrating cutting-edge information technologies including big data analytics, blockchain, cloud computing, Internet of Things (IoT), artificial intelligence (AI), and more. Patients may now get improved health services and support without having to adopt a disease-centric approach thanks to this innovative breakthrough. Sensitive medical data may be compromised as a result of the security flaws brought about by the implementation of Of crops. Of crops must create a strong architecture that analyzes inputs, access points, key controls, and integrity to guarantee data security in order to solve these problems. This study suggests a safe, all-inclusive Of crops framework Done It examines how security frameworks are presently implemented in Of crops, offers performance comparisons, and ends with suggestions for future study directions for specialists in the subject.

articleTitle: Culinary Fusion:Vegetable Recognition Recipe Generation
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Advance Computing and Innovative Technologies in Engineering (ICACITE)

authors.preferredName: Kanduri Purna Venkata Siva Sai Vara Vishnu
authors.firstName: Kanduri Purna Venkata Siva Sai Vara

abstract: The presented paper aims to propose a novel way to implement advanced deep learning and natural language processing in vegetable recognition and recipe generation. The proposed work uses the YOLOv8 object detection framework, which is first trained on a very meticulously obtained dataset of 20, 708 images from the website Roboflow, to perform intelligent partitioning into three sets: Finally, the proposed methodology has attained 88% accuracy in predicting different vegetables. On detecting vegetables in any input image, the model uses OpenCV to detect those vegetables from the PALM API. It takes the names of the detected vegetables as prompts along with the preferences selected by the user in terms of the language and the number of recipes and gives the output recipe using the PALM API in the form of five different language translations, Telugu, Malayalam, Hindi, Kannada, and Tamil. The output recipes are also provided in text and audio format to cater to users of all linguistic backgrounds. This results in a holistic system that ensures a hassle-free and user-friendly approach to vegetable recognition, its recipe generation, and, finally, the enrichment of the culinary experience and promotion of cultural diversity, even in the kitchen.

articleTitle: Enhancing Self-Driving Control and Sensing Systems with Cloud Computing ING with AI and BD
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Advance Computing and Innovative Technologies in Engineering (ICACITE)
abstract: A vast amount of research has been done on vehicular networking because it is continuously required for infotainment, safety, efficient traffic management, and normalization. As the vehicles are installed with various communication systems, computer power, storage, and enhanced sensing capabilities, the ITS is continually updating. Vehicular Cloud Computing (VCC) is one of the fundamental techniques that assimilate the vehicle resources not only to the problems of the vehicular networks but also to make fast decisions. The article discusses a complete and state-of-the-art survey of VCC along with its categorization, making attention to its use, cloud configurations, critical management, inter-cloud communication, and privacy/security issues. We develop a VCC framework while considering the previous work, contrasting it with traditional CC and giving emerging issues of the work. VCC is practically and profitably reformed in the literature, and it credits the intelligent vehicular networks for making the autonomous traffic, advanced vehicle control, and sophisticated sensing systems.

articleTitle: An Intensive Review and Assessment of Impacts of AI in the Field of Teaching(Edu)
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Advance Computing and Innovative Technologies in Engineering (ICACITE)
abstract: The deployment of Artificial Intelligence (AI) has been huge in the recent past years, and potentially, the changes might be very high in all areas of higher education. This paper undertakes an attempt to explore the multifaceted impacts of AI on the scope of teaching and learning in higher education, aiming at reaching a comprehensive view of potential implications. Rapid development at present of AI technologies and their penetration into various social spheres make it increasingly important that educators, policymakers, and stakeholders clearly understand what impacts they are bringing and will bring to the educational paradigms. The use of AI in higher education covers everything from personalized learning experiences to the highest administrative efficiencies. One of the most important effects related to personalized learning is the fact that it produces AI-driven algorithms that can use, analyze, and adopt great datasets with respect to fine-tuning educational content and how the very content is delivered to the individual student. It aids in engaging the students more effectively in difficult concepts and active learning, while having further understanding on such topics that eventually increases the learning outcome. Second, with AI-empowered learning platforms, adaptive assessment techniques are possible, which provide educators a dynamic, more responsive space to measure student learning progress and provide feedback. Second, the space of research and development of education has been under the influence of AI technologies.

articleTitle: A Deep Analysis of Implementation of Technical Strategy using AI in MBS
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Advance Computing and Innovative Technologies in Engineering (ICACITE)
abstract: In this dynamically changing contemporary bussiness landscape, Artificial Intelligence (AI) represents a transformation enabler that realigns industries, redefines the operational paradigm, and readjusts economic dynamics. The paper undertakes an exploration of the deeper meaning of an AI-powered transformation: such investigations, economic, and technical dimensions in order to outline insights indispensable for businesses that have to steer the intricacies of a 21st-century market in Isabela State University, Echague Campus. It is in the center where the capabilities for augmentation and automation are. Several of the AI technologies that are empowering businesses toward unlocking new efficiencies, improving decision-making, and leading toward innovation include predictive analytics and natural language processing. It is AI that allows organizations to obtain actionable insights, optimize the use of resources, reduce risks, and increase competitiveness with the help of enormous amounts of data. To this end, this paper reveals very concrete economic benefits from the adoption of AI, which are cost-saving, revenuegenerating, market-expanding, and customer-retaining impacts through case studies and empirical analysis. However, if this shift in the role of AI materializes, it remains to depend on an array of technical and ethical challenges. Central to these is the imperative for effective data infrastructure and governance that will contribute to securing data integrity, privacy, and safety. In addition, such studies as the role of machine learning, computer science, and domain-specific knowledge experts require an interdisciplinary collaboration during the design and development of AI systems.

articleTitle: An Empirical Analysis and Overview of a Green 6-G Paradigms and its Various Implementation Applications
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Advance Computing and Innovative Technologies in Engineering (ICACITE)
abstract: The advent of green 6G technologies holds promise for revolutionary improvements across different areas such as data transmission speed, latency, and traffic volume. Incorporating features like sub-terahertz communication and advanced multiple-input multiple-output (MIMO) technologies, Green 6 G networks aim to surpass the data transmission rates of 5 G while slashing latency to a mere fraction. However, this rapid expansion in network data transfer poses notable hurdles concerning data processing systems and energy usage. Despite strides in energy-efficient computing methods such as green cloud and edge computing, unresolved issues persist, including substantial energy consumption during data migration and idle server power usage. To tackle these challenges, this study proposes a novel strategy called “In-Network Computing” (INC), which relocates processing tasks from hosts to network devices, leveraging idle resources to alleviate data transmission burdens and mitigate pressure on cloud computing resources. In contrast to edge computing, INC exhibits advantages in the 6 G landscape due to the enhanced computing capabilities and application awareness of network devices. The proposed approach prioritizes energy efficiency by minimizing data centre inputs and integrating host and network node computing environments through virtualization and software-based models. The paper introduces innovative implementations by implementing green 6 g paradigms, focusing on task scheduling and the creation of a prototype system utilizing low-power multicore processors. Experimental validation across diverse application scenarios demonstrates substantial reductions in system energy consumption and network traffic.

articleTitle: AI-Integrated CMS for HE System Implementation in Structured Way
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Advance Computing and Innovative Technologies in Engineering (ICACITE)
abstract: The modern, changeable, competitive educational environment of today compels the institutions of higher learning to enhance administrative operations efficiency while meeting employees’ and users’ needs, students’, instructors’, and staff at large, with resource constraints and the availability of new technology. The incorporation of artificial intelligence (AI) into the campus management system, therefore, brings an improved, effective approach that assures administrative workflows are well-defined, from which improvement in operational efficiency can be realized, consequently leading to improved institutional effectiveness. This study is thus a review of the implications and benefits an AI-integrated Campus Management System bears for institutions of higher education. AI technologies, such as machine learning, natural language processing, and analytics power these systems. They have a potential capability of automating typical administrative tasks, synthesizing huge volume datasets to inform decision-making, and offering experiences for stakeholders that are fully personalized. This paper will thus be organized in the following way: first, discussion of the current challenges that face higher education management is presented in order to administer; and, second, resource limitations, data complexity, and third, scalability needs. The rest of the paper then discusses how AI promises to transform this whole arena by essentially automating repetitive activities that range from processing applications for admissions to scheduling of courses and delivering to students all the associated support services.

articleTitle: The Implementation of AI in Examining J,S And Ep in Workplace
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Advance Computing and Innovative Technologies in Engineering (ICACITE)
abstract: This has thus brought broader discussions with respect to the impact it could make regarding jobs, skills, and employment patterns as AI becomes integrated into work processes. This research paper tries to demonstrate the multifarious changes that AI is going to usher in the modern workplace and the complex dynamics that are influencing the future of work. The first section discusses changes to the job roles, whereby AI technologies will automate the routine tasks and augment human capabilities. It measures that some jobs are going to disappear while others are undergoing radical change, all leading to new class formations of employment. The article also puts its focus on the potential by which AI can better workers’ jobs by relieving them of mundane duties and allowing them to concentrate on activities that need creativity, critical thinking, and emotional intelligence. Second, this paper considers the skills necessary in an AI-driven economy and derives what should be done for workforce development. It illustrates the increase in importance of such key areas of digital literacy and data analysis and problem-solving. However, it also underscores continued importance for person-centered attributes like empathy and flexibility. The paper also looks at the question of lifelong learning and upskilling initiatives that actually provide the people with the right competencies to live effectively in the environment driven by AI. It further explores how the distribution, rewards, and the nature of work-related patterns that are constituted by AI are going to change.

articleTitle: The Development of SWMS with LT and FT Environment in Fog Based IOT Environment
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Advance Computing and Innovative Technologies in Engineering (ICACITE)
abstract: In the increasing urbanization times, the ever-rising amount of waste is becoming a critical problem for the city authorities. This paper proposes a new paradigm for urban waste management by integrating fog computing into distributed IoT systems. Our proposed architecture meets the requirements of low latency, fault tolerance, and minimization of fog nodes, which ensures the processing of waste data quickly with an enhanced level of efficiency. Strong application of fault-tolerant mechanisms guarantees and enhances the reliability of the components of the application and ensures a robust waste management ecosystem. By using IoT technologies, this novel architecture will be dynamically adapted to the conditions imposed by the handling of waste in urban cities and is a step forward towards the sustainable and smart evolution of the cities. iFogSim-based simulation shows the performance of the proposed system, and it has the great improvements in terms of latency and network usage, which makes it a step toward the realization of a smart and eco-friendly urban landscape.

articleTitle: The use of Integration of H Level Communication with the Extended Identity Power Process to Have Intelligent Vehicles: An Empirical Review
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Advance Computing and Innovative Technologies in Engineering (ICACITE)
abstract: The arrival of sixth-generation (6 G) wireless technology has ushered in a new era of connectivity, promising innovative services such as the Internet of Things (IoT) and, more importantly, when it is stimulating research into sixthgeneration networks (6G). However, the widespread integration of artificial intelligence (AI) into intelligent vehicles faces significant challenges. These challenges include limited resources, lack of high-quality labelled data, and lack of AIoptimized architecture. Edge Intelligence is emerging as a promising solution that aims to seamlessly integrate artificial intelligence with intelligent vehicles. This paper describes the key requirements and trends driving the understanding of 6 G networks, with an emphasis on self-learning techniques to develop intelligent vehicles. This study suggests a framework focused on automated learning based on onboard awareness, with the goal of reducing human intervention by automating data processing and model development. This architecture uses a Generative Adversarial Network (GAN) to aggregate labelled data for Al training, ensuring scalability, adaptability and efficiency. A case study in a connected traffic network demonstrates the effectiveness of the architecture for intelligent vehicles. The proposed architecture not only addresses the challenges of 6 G networks but also aligns with their requirements for efficiency, adaptability, and human-centricity By leveraging self-learning mechanisms, it paves the way for autonomous adaptation and evolution in dynamic network environments.

articleTitle: A Detailed Review on Challenges in the Computational Frameworks in Building 6G for Healthcare System
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Advance Computing and Innovative Technologies in Engineering (ICACITE)
abstract: In the modern age of Sixth-generation (6G) connections, the merging of the Intellect Internet of Issues (IIoT) plays a crucial part in improving storage and processing of data powers. The core goal of 6 G is to provide extremely small delay, high speed, and improved quality of service so as to enable smooth contact among network points. Within the medical industry, it is important to fit all facilities at state-ofthe-art technology to allow clever diagnoses, patient-centric therapies, and a range of healthcare services, outside the confines of a medical facility and online. To ensure the health care sector’s readiness and flexibility to cutting-edge technology, giving varied uses from robotic treatments to remote patient tracking via portable technologies in Active Adaptive Living (AAL) environments is important. The intelligent connecting platform serves as the backbone, managing various networking hubs and input devices to offer time-sensitive healthcare services. This paper presents a new reference layered communication system designed for realtime conversation among nodes and devices. By studying the future aspects of the 6 G system, the paper shows its potential uses in healthcare, hoping to improve treatment effectiveness and smartly combine services. The suggested structure attempts to build a strong basis for the changing world of healthcare apps in the framework of 6 G technology.

articleTitle: Revolutionizing the Present Education System Through AI-Driven Learning Platform with Hybrid Techniques
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Advance Computing and Innovative Technologies in Engineering (ICACITE)
abstract: Enter artificial intelligence (AI) technology, and it begins to change the landscape in higher education. This paper describes the developing paradigm of AI-driven learning environments and their revolutionary effects on 21st-century higher education. As personalized and adaptive learning experiences gain further ground, these new opportunities enable AI-driven systems to provide revolutionized pedagogical practices, improved student engagement, and boosted learning outcomes. The nature of AI in learning environments is customization: to refine the learning experience to every single, individual need, and preference of the student. The AI algorithms, capable of handling a huge amount of data, can make a proper evaluation of students, including their strengths, weaknesses, learning preferences, and others, for the improvement in learning and thus cater to them with personalized content and recommendations. This does set up a rich and transparent learning environment but also allows students to insist on owning their own learning. That democratization of education would therefore be paramount not just in handling disparities in access, but also encouraging a diverse and inclusive learning community.

articleTitle: The Technical use of Mobile Robots in Developing Smart Cities in Integration with Vins
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Advance Computing and Innovative Technologies in Engineering (ICACITE)
abstract: The handling of independent mobile robots in complex settings presents a difficult task. Overcoming problems related to incorrect labeling and frequent tracking loses, particularly in difficult scenes, goes beyond the powers of point-based visual SLAM and simultaneous mapping (vSLAM) methods. This study presents a creative real-time, alongside resilient point-line oriented monocular visual inertial Navigation (VINS) system designed for mobile robots in urban areas that are ready for 6 G advances. To enhance resilience in tracking difficult scenes, we implement EDLines alongside adaptive kappa correction for swift capture of a higher share of extended line attributes within all derived line features. A new real-time line feature-mapping technique is presented to track this retrieved line features between subsequent frames minus the necessity about computing descriptors, giving an increase of three in performance compared with the traditional LSD and KNN matching strategy based on LBD descriptors. Moreover, a tightly linked sensor fusion optimization scheme is built to attain precise state estimates, covering point-line characteristic reprojection errors and accelerometer device (IMU) residuals. Through tests on freely available standard datasets, our VINS system shows better localization precision real-time performance, and stability when compared to other modern SLAM systems. This VINS system enables the accurate location of robots on the move in smart cities defined by complicated surroundings.

articleTitle: Big Data: A Technical Preview of Technology
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Advance Computing and Innovative Technologies in Engineering (ICACITE)
abstract: The spaceless accessibility of data has dramatically changed the environments of decision making in the digital age. “Big data” technically refers to datasets that are not only large, but also diverse & fast, thus speeding up the process of managing them with traditional procedures & tools. However, with this more abundance of data, making use of these information, and extracting particular utilities from them will have to be explored and studied. Firstly, decisions must be made that give significant insights from such diverse and changing data which move from the level of transactions, consumer comprehension to the network interpersonal. Massive data analytics, which is an implication of large-scale data analysing by firing on huge data collections, brings such value. The objective of this article is to pursue some of the different kinds of analytical methods and software tools that can be used to analyze data, as well as the alternative decision-making facilitation modes which may be achieved through advanced analytics.

articleTitle: Machine Learning Techniques for Effective Content- Based Approach in the Detection of Fake News
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Advance Computing and Innovative Technologies in Engineering (ICACITE)
abstract: All functionalities required in the process of fake news detection, from data preparation to model building, have been done within the project, smoothly integrated into Flask for user interaction. The first step of data processing requires the import of the packages and the merging of real and fake news datasets. Data cleaning includes the removal of duplicates, text cleaning, and insightful visualization of characteristics using Seaborn and Matplotlib. Tokenization via TF-IDF Vectorization, Feature Selection, and Data Splitting paves the way for an extensive suite of Classification Models from Logistic Regression and SVC to KNN, Random Forest, Stacking, and even Voting Classifiers. Additionally, Flask provides functions for user registration, signing in, and an inbuilt SQLite database to store the user data. User input text is set to be translated and preprocessed for prediction using the best-fit pre-trained model. The outcome will then be shown to the user on the frontend. The novelty with the extension here is the models like the Voting Classifier (XGB + PA + Boosting) that have been introduced, which gives a $100 \%$ accuracy. More importantly, it extends the usability feature by allowing the user to provide text at the front end and get real-time predictions, thus enriching the overall user experience. In more ways than one, this project, from its approach toward fake news detection to its diversity of methodology and user-centered design, is going to be the most apropos project in the coming days to the emerging landscape of information integrity.

articleTitle: The Development of HP Based ML Model for Reliable Computational Intelligence System
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Advance Computing and Innovative Technologies in Engineering (ICACITE)
abstract: many educational institutions employ data mining to keep track of their students’ records, particularly their academic achievements, which is more significant. To improve their achievements, students’ academic performances, as well as the institutions’ overall results, must be evaluated. Furthermore, the prediction of students’ academic accomplishment educational data mining has been a growing research area machine learning techniques are used to gather information from educational warehouses. As a result, this research proposes the hybrids pedagogical statistical model, a novel approach for analyzing student performance, to improve educational quality for students. The suggested methodology assesses student performance using diverse parameters that result in suitable outcomes. In addition, for obtaining the findings and accurately categorising student performance, the framework illustrates the synergy between the j 48 separator and the enn-based segmentation method. The model is put to the test using the weka environment’s benchmark schooling dataset., which is available online. The findings suggest that the proposed model outperforms previous studies in assessing edm student performance.

articleTitle: An Integration of AI and Traditional Methodology in the Education Field in Order to: Transform the Trends
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Advance Computing and Innovative Technologies in Engineering (ICACITE)
abstract: Within such accelerating and fast-paced environments of change, it has been realized and observed that the adoption and integration of artificial intelligence (AI) technologies are transforming into very powerful and promising forces for bringing about revolution in different dimensions of teaching, learning, and administrative functions. This paper provides an in-depth and critical review of current trends, challenges, and implications associated with embedding AI in higher education contexts. Based on an integration of academic literature, empirical evidence, and expert views, this paper provides nuanced understanding for the multi-dimensional implications that AI portends for higher education institutions across the globe. The first section looks into the varied applications of AI in different domains of higher education. Not only that, with advanced AI, AIED is now advancing to the extent that it will be integrated into some of the more honest, mundane functions in education such as admissions, enrollment management, and student support services by providing personalized learning platforms and adaptive tutoring systems. The following sections discuss, through the help of some case studies and real-world examples, how these AI-powered solutions are essentially helping improve pedagogical effectiveness, optimize institutional operations, and enhance overall student outcomes.

articleTitle: Hybrid Algorithm Generation for the Development of Medical System using FC, AI & ML
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Advance Computing and Innovative Technologies in Engineering (ICACITE)
abstract: This study introduces a pervasive hospital (PH) infrastructure for denture fabrication that consists of many 3D printing facilities. In order to maximize efficiency, the PH system divides up the printing jobs across several 3D printing facilities as it handles orders from dental clinics. Interestingly, this system adds two novel components that set it apart from other models. In the first place, it plans ahead of time for the possibility of reprinting, which eliminates the need for later replanning. In order to save travel time, it also works with home delivery companies, and have become more popular after the COVID-19 epidemic. The work models both printing and shipping durations using interval type-II irregular fuzzy numbers, which are appropriate given the inherent uncertainty related to these unique elements. The $\mathbf{P H}$ system’s activities are then strategically planned to use the interval type-II fuzzy blended integer-linear processing (FMILP) model that has been designed and optimized. A useful case study is provided to demonstrate how well the suggested technique works. The experimental findings reveal a significant decrease in order completion time, demonstrating that the system may improve efficiency in operation by up to 9%.

articleTitle: Novel Based Design of System for the Purpose of Supply Chain with Fuzzy Logic Algorithms and its Models
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Advance Computing and Innovative Technologies in Engineering (ICACITE)
abstract: Lean concepts and techniques have been adopted by a wide range of businesses, with the goal of increasing the effectiveness of company processes by reducing expenses, waste, intake and effort. But previous analyses haven’t explicitly addressed how lean supply chains are in healthcare environments. This work presents a new way for assessing how well lean concepts and practices are used in healthcare chain of custody, and then it validates the methodology in a healthcare setting. An extensive literature overview on leanness assessment and multi-grade fuzzy logic is presented at the beginning of the study. Next, a conceptual model for measuring leanness is developed and validated by means of interviews with academic specialists, namely those who focus on leanness in healthcare settings. A healthcare business is chosen as an example after receiving helpful input from experts. This is due to the organization’s desire to engage and dedication to putting lean concepts into practice, which guarantees a strong basis for projects with the potential to be transformational. Experts working for the case-study company confirm the estimated leanness index, which is the outcome of multi-grade fuzzy logic used in leanness assessment. In the end, the analysis pinpoints areas where the organization’s procedures are lacking, providing guidance for future improvements.

articleTitle: AI Integrated Model Design for Education System for Analytical Computation (Mathematics)
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Advance Computing and Innovative Technologies in Engineering (ICACITE)
abstract: Artificial Intelligence (AI) has digitized almost everything, and so is the case with mathematics education. The paper discusses the potential of AI technologies in changing experiences and outcomes for learners in mathematics. This study, in the form of investigation, attempts to look into multifaceted roles: how AI can be leveraged for developing personalized learning pathways, for the facilitating mechanisms of adaptive assessments, and for providing immersive, interactive learning environments to students of varied proficiency levels. One example of the introduction of AI in math education would be paradigmatic of viewing it as a shift from traditional approaches to those that are far more student-tailored. The artificial intelligence system, through machine learning algorithms and data analytics, can diagnose the learning requirements and preferences of an individual student and can bring about customization in the learning module accordingly. This will give room for flexibility in dealing with different learning paces, inclusive of allowing the students to better understand the concepts that they consider to be hard. The paper goes ahead to articulate that AI-fueled tools can be used effectively to improve the learners’ engagement and motivation. Students will grasp complex mathematical theories, problems, or practice in a naturally interactive, fun way through gamified learning experiences and interactive simulations. These immersive technologies are conducive not only for the learning process to be made enjoyable but for recording better knowledge and developing critical thinking and problem-solving abilities. In addition, it describes the way AI enables formative as well as summative assessment in the educational context.

articleTitle: The Development of Skyborne Kind of Base Stations for the Communication in 5G as well as 6G Networks
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Advance Computing and Innovative Technologies in Engineering (ICACITE)
abstract: In recent times, breakthroughs in collaboration and internet communications, combined with a rising demand for high-fidelity, a low-late last-mile connection, illustrate the pressing requirement for highly efficient sharing methods. This study dives into the exploration during utilizing wireless-enabled drones as flying base stations within a framework of the next-generation cellular networks. The rise of Flying Ad Hoc Communities (FANETs), acting as groups of movable relays to flexibly spread broadband connection, presents an enticing possibility in the world of next-generation high-availability telecommunications. The details of mobility, switching efficiency, energy administration, optimal placement, node location, and related multi-objective improvements are carefully examined, building the basic structure of this study. The focus stretches to improving the current wireless network core to support novel use cases and reduce the running costs that accompany diversity ad hoc deployments. Through an indepth review, this paper aims at bringing novel insights to the field, leaving light on avenues for enhancement for cellular infrastructure to foster seamless incorporation of cellular-enabled unmanned aerial vehicles as pivotal components in the rapidly changing landscape of the next-generation communication networks.

articleTitle: Automation Industry Control Strategy Implementation through Intelligent Automation System
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Advance Computing and Innovative Technologies in Engineering (ICACITE)
abstract: The mobile network evolution of this century faces an unprecedented challenge upon the advent of 5G (fifth-generation) networks and beyond to cater to different demands on automation and digitization. Indeed, one expects that these networks will have to support a very heterogeneous set of services and devices with peculiar demands in terms of speed, reliability and latency. It is required to solve these issues with advanced technologies in radio transmission, resource allocation, and network creation, which in turn raises the complexity and heterogeneity of the network infrastructure. One promising approach is to integrate automation and digitization based on artificial intelligence technologies. In particular, AI has shown great potential in solving various network-related problems such as predicting channel conditions, optimizing resource allocations, autonomously managing networks, and enhancing security. However, the current efforts to integrate AI into wireless networks often result in using specific AI algorithms to solve specific problems, since there is a lack of an integral framework to fully exploit the capability of AI for various network missions. This work builds upon the concept of intelligence slicing and proposes an absolutely new way of slicing the intelligence module to cater to the solution of different network problems in an automated and digitized way. Different AI algorithms can, therefore, be applied to the best extent required by the context in a way that provides flexibility and scalability in network management and optimization. By means of intelligence slicing, the network operator is going to utilize AI functions to achieve performance, reliability, and security in 5G mobile networks and beyond. Two representative examples are introduced to illustrate the effectiveness of intelligence slicing: the neural network-dependent medium prediction mechanism and anomaly ascertainment from the perspective of industrial network security. The concept of intelligence slicing and automation, on the other hand, is provided for the realization of the overall promise of Al for wireless networks. This is because it is a flexible and scalable solution for network management, optimization, and security beyond mobile into the 5 G era.

articleTitle: They Way of Utilising A Anatomical Based Drones in NGMN A Detailed And Intensiveperformance Analysis
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Advance Computing and Innovative Technologies in Engineering (ICACITE)
abstract: The escalating demand for wireless data, primarily, underscores the demand for alternative network solutions beyond traditional terrestrial infrastructure. Particularly in scenarios like large gatherings or natural disasters, maintaining stable connectivity poses significant challenges for network operators. Unpredictable events such as earthquakes emphasize the critical importance of reliable communication Infrastructure for disaster relief efforts. However, conventional cellular systems often struggle to provide consistent connectivity in such situations. Empirical research illustrated and underscored the potential and capability of drone-based solutions with respect to enhancing user experience, additionally ensuring stable network access, especially when conventional terrestrial infrastructure is compromised. Given these advantages, integrating drones into 5G/6G wireless networks is actively being explored. However, the large-scale deployment of drones presents certain challenges. Stochastic theory, widely employed in analyzing wireless networks due to its ability to model connectivity and randomness across various scenarios, has been Instrumental in several studies. Theoretical findings are validated through Monte Carlo simulations, demonstrating distinct characteristics of drone mobile networks, such as utilizing many antennas and operating at low transmission rate levels. The research delves into a comprehensive evaluation of drone-based mobile networks at the system level, providing mathematical expressions for key metrics such as signal-to-interference-plusnoise ratio (SINR), spectral efficiency (SE), and outage probability. It incorporates LOS and NLOS propagation, as well as multi-slope path loss. The paper adopts a combination of three-dimensional Brownian (random) motion and deterministic motion models to establish performance limits in practical drone cellular areas, allowing exploration of various mobility patterns, Including random Brownian motion. It considers both LOS and NLOS propagation scenarios, with parameters such as path-loss exponents and Nakagami-m fading distributions. The paper provides a detailed description of the network topology and propagation models employed in the analysis.

articleTitle: A Mantle of Chatbots in the Place of Pedagogy and Learning to Generate Tools to Provide Assistance using A-I
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Advance Computing and Innovative Technologies in Engineering (ICACITE)
abstract: AI-based chatbots have recently come up as powerful tools across many domains, and their application in primary education is relatively new but fast-evolving. This research report will thus try and explore AI chatbots as a supporting tool for students in their assistance and guidance in the learning process. In modern digitalized pedagogin practices and modern learning environments using emerging technologies, AI chatbots unlock a way to even more personalized learning and student support. This paper introduces a brief explanation of how AI chatbots can actually help improve primary education through individual help and guidance to the students. This study, therefore, tends to look at the benefits of functionalities of AI chatbots and what they bring to the primary education system and, at the same time, the challenges or problems that it comes with, through reviewing literature from the past, case studies, and empirical evidence. Further, it discusses the possible implications of AI chatbots on the student learning outcomes, engagement, and general academic performance. One of the advantages available to the university is that the students would have eased access to learning material, academic staff, and NLP combined with machine learning algorithms helps a chatbot understand the queries of the student. Thus, it gives instant feedback to the student and provides learning resources in line with the style of learning of the said student. This approach personalizes the learning process, making it more inclusive and student-centered. It, therefore, responds to the diversity of the needs of learners in primary schools. Moreover, AI chatbots are tools of high value in supplementing teacher-student interactions.

articleTitle: Implementation of AI Collaboration in IOT-Enabled Systems for Better Response
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Advance Computing and Innovative Technologies in Engineering (ICACITE)
abstract: Artificial Intelligence (AI)-driven flexible methods play a crucial part in saving resources within the world of Internet about Things (IoT)-enabled smart healthcare devices. The tiny size and wireless data sharing capabilities of Body networked sensors (BSNs) have gained significant attention in current medical media technologies. The long-term feasibility of an effective health system hangs on the high vitality economy, communication dependability, and longer battery lives of personal sensing devices. Addressing the necessity to improve sensor-based wearable methods in BSNs across collecting information, healthcare tracking, and analysis, this work presents key advances. Firstly, a groundbreaking framework is suggested to simultaneously improve energy efficiency, storage lifetime, and dependability for smart and interactive healthcare. Secondly, the study proposes an Adaptive Transmission Info Rate (ATDR) method, improving energy usage by changing the active duration of the sense node over the continually changing wireless channel. Additionally, an Adaptable Routing System (SARA) is built, adding a dynamic origin routing system for an efficient in terms of energy and quickest path, breaking from conventional navigation methods. The trial setting uses real-time datasets, showing widespread and cost-effective treatment through smart devices. The results suggest that the proposed methods beat standards in terms of magnified energy savings, improved reliability, and extended battery lifetime for handheld devices.

articleTitle: A Development of Aquatic Landscape Type of Drones for the Implementation for Future Technology
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Advance Computing and Innovative Technologies in Engineering (ICACITE)
abstract: Cutting-edge, cost-effective hardware components allow the development of vast automated underwater drone systems for marine uses. This talk focuses on the CORATAM along with HANCAD projects, covering key issues in organizing and speaking within networks of underwater drones. Our plan supports a novel approach: (i) adopting eclectic communication by outfitting some drones at long-range electronics while others hold shorter-range devices, and (iii) employing autonomous control for enhanced endurance and scaling. This approach ensures individual drones stay simple and cheap. Currently, we are currently engaged in the process of building 25 test drones using easily available components. The article dives into current hardware creates and the results of simulation-based studies where groups of as many as one thousand underwater drones successfully surveyed a 20 km -long location constantly for 24 hours. The results confirm the practicality of our approach in building a large-scale robotic underwater unmanned aircraft system that is simultaneously efficient and affordable.

articleTitle: OMN-IBUS Type of Networking System for the Communication System in 6G
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Advance Computing and Innovative Technologies in Engineering (ICACITE)
abstract: The scientific community and industry have been working together in recent years to shift computational resources off centralized cloud systems to decentralized computing, or ‘edge’ computing. This change is a result of the cloud system’s inability to keep up with the growing demands of emerging relationships, which are marked by the spread of time-sensitive applications like sophisticated robotics, augmented reality/virtual the truth technologies, self-driving cars, and vital remote control of Internet of Things applications. Decentralized computing at the border is still in its infancy and lacks a full platform, despite the critical role that it will play in future distributed systems. This article presents OMNIBUS, a novel decentralized edge architecture. This approach uses moving vehicles as resources for processing and storage, enabling the continuous delivery of computational capability to end-devices across many locations. Scalability and flexibility are two characteristics that set OMNIBUS distinct from other edge computing solutions. The suggested method, which is based on mathematical models of prediction, determines computational capacity for particular locations by learning the direction and time of vehicle movements. It also presents a theoretical foundation for learning, improvement, and caching amid dynamic conditions caused by moving vehicles, specifically for sequential concurrent conversion. OMNIBUS’s scalability allows for almost infinite growth, which might result in a significant increase in network speed.

articleTitle: The Development of 6-G Technology in Integration with AI type of Synergy
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Advance Computing and Innovative Technologies in Engineering (ICACITE)
abstract: In this scientific study, the mutual connection between 6G technology, which and machine intelligence (AI) comes center stage. Delving on to the potential connections, the paper suggests that the merging of 6G and AI holds the secret to opening new possibilities in diverse fields. A thorough analysis emerges, showing the transformative effect that this mixture can have on the critical sectors such as medical care, transport, augmented reality education, resource management, robots, as well as solving challenges in public safety and battle. While the paper highlights the hopeful possibilities that lie to come it carefully admits the simultaneous increase of risks. In light of this understanding, the paper provides a detailed review of the security risks that are inherent in this technology nexus. Furthermore, a careful study of potential prevention methods is given, underscoring the necessity of proactive measures for maximizing the benefits while protecting against possible dangers. The merger of 6G and AI, as anticipated in this academic discourse, arises not only as a trigger for revolutionary developments but also as a territory needing careful consideration of ethics and security imperatives. The paper consequently acts as a leading light, directing the debate towards a future what the fusion of 6G while AI adds positively to our progress while carefully handling related challenges.

articleTitle: A Novel Based Clinical Support System Creation for an Emergency Clinical Needs via FLBA
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Advance Computing and Innovative Technologies in Engineering (ICACITE)
abstract: In the world of developing artificial intelligence within medicine, clinical decision support platforms (CDSS) play a growing role in improving care and diagnostic effectiveness. Addressing doubts inherent in health taking decisions, fuzzy logic (FL) appears as a powerful tool. This work shows a FL-based CDSS developed for measuring kidney functioning in posttransplant patients, an important part of patient care. Utilizing data drawn from the School of Dialysis at the College of Medicine Hospital Frederic II of Naples, to statistically appropriate group is chosen based on predefined criteria for admission. The CDSS includes four fuzzy inference methods, tracking kidney function through metrics including proteinuria while the rate of filtration (GFR). The applied systems show amazing accuracy, topping 90%. The result is given in easily comprehensible images, allowing doctors to naturally watch patients’ clinical state. The overall goal is to improve drug amounts and reduce medication mistakes. This study contends that the established CDSS, designed for assessing and follow-up from kidney-transplanted consumers, is easily usable in clinical practice.

articleTitle: Agility of in Deep Learning Algorithms in Developing Conflicting Attacks Protections and to Secure Vulnerabilities
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Advance Computing and Innovative Technologies in Engineering (ICACITE)
abstract: Deep learning methods have brought revolution to a variety of applications: from image recognition to natural language processing, and many others. However, their most important vulnerability, when used in adversarial conditions, is a matter of concern that remains up to today. Most importantly, adversarial attacks insinuate the design of input in a way to be capable of bringing errors in the model, hence exposing significant vulnerabilities. This paper investigates the nature of such vulnerabilities and proposes the enhancement of model robustness through comprehensive methodologies. First of all, adversaries would be considered under the threat landscape and classified according to their complexity and impact, should one materialize. The second section would detail all available defense mechanisms, again classified based on strengths and limitations. We propose using the ensemble of adversaries, regularization methods, and dynamic network architecture. We validate this using the empirical testing of the technique over several datasets and models, subjected to a battery of rigorous tests.

articleTitle: Using Big Data Insights and AI to Strengthen Clinical ONCOLOGY Decision-Making in the Medical Field
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Advance Computing and Innovative Technologies in Engineering (ICACITE)
abstract: Big data integration is becoming increasingly important in the changing healthcare landscape for informed clinical decision making. This in-depth review explores the challenges and applications of big data in healthcare, highlighting how it can improve clinical decision-making processes. 211 papers published from 2019 to 2023 were thoroughly examined, and the results provide relevant insights into the many ways and means of applying big data analytics to healthcare. Through a comprehensive review of a wide range of academic literature, this review not only presents current issues but also suggests new directions and solutions for action. It provides a comprehensive set of current and future directions for the use of Big Data in healthcare, making it an invaluable resource for academics. This article seeks to assist researchers in choosing suitable approaches by means of a methodical review of the literature, so promoting a more coherent and cooperative research environment. Through an analysis of the subtleties of research pertaining to healthcare, the review adds to the current conversation on how to use Big Data insights to drive improvements in clinical decision-making for better patient outcomes.

Author Keywords: Review research on big data analytics

articleTitle: Integration of Fuzzy Model with the IOT Model to Achieve Better Health(Medical) Care Design System
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Advance Computing and Innovative Technologies in Engineering (ICACITE)
abstract: The Internet of Things is a pervasive network that utilizes sensor-equipped devices by the billions to observe the real-world environment. The Internet of Things technology presents considerable potential for the development of various industries, including medical treatment, where it can decrease the impact that the combination of old age and chronic ailments puts on health care systems. This paper tends to put forward a secure hierarchical routing approach, so-called Fuzzy Logic-based secure Hierarchical Routing using the Firefly Algorithm, to mitigate the issued challenges in IoT technologies for healthcare. A Fuzzy Trust Framework, an Inter-cluster Routing Framework, and a Firefly Algorithm-based Clustered Framework are the three main components of the proposed FSRF. The Fuzzy Security Framework identifies the trustworthiness of IoT devices in the network to resist routing attacks. The Firefly Algorithm-based Colony Framework selects IoT devices as cluster head nodes using the fitness function that measures the trust level, residual power hop count, connectivity radius, and centrality. FSRF goes further to apply an on-demand routing technique to ensure efficient data transmission. Simulation analysis compared with the current protocol was presented that showed that FSRF significantly improves the network lifetime, and energy efficiency, but security is the issue that needs further concern to improve the system.

articleTitle: The Controlling OF Viability of LM Controller in ULR System
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Advance Computing and Innovative Technologies in Engineering (ICACITE)
abstract: The Leap Motion Controller is an affordable marker-less optical sensor that uses a range of characteristics to follow the movements of the human hand. Individuals with disabilities are the focus of upper limb rehabilitation treatment, which uses continuous motion exercises to promote healing. However, patients’ motivation may be impacted by the repeated nature of these activities, which might be viewed as boring or demoralising. Serious games have been included into therapy to improve motivation and enjoyment in order to address this. This study looks at the feasibility, repeatability, and accuracy of using a Leap Motion Controller (LMC) in conjunction with a serious game to aid with upper limb rehabilitation. The results of experimental feasibility tests, which recreate upper limb motions detected by the LMC using an industrial robot, show good tracking accuracy. On the other hand, noted restrictions concerning quantifiable workplace are addressed..

articleTitle: A New Technology for Higher end Communication Using Quick and Optimised Computational N/W Implementation for Clinical Field
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Advance Computing and Innovative Technologies in Engineering (ICACITE)
abstract: Sixth-generation (6G) networks are able to completely transform the healthcare sector. 6 G technology has the potential to significantly impact fields like telesurgery and epidemic/pandemic management due to its unparalleled efficiency enabling seamless remote patient monitoring and bolstering smart healthcare (s-health) solutions. Healthcare services will be able to use 6 G ‘s communication capabilities to get around geographical and temporal limitations. Current approaches to 6 G network performance management tend to ignore the wide range of network devices and communication technologies involved and only address specific issues, even though they frequently concentrate on specific techniques like resource allocation, reservation, traffic shaping, and scheduling. This study introduces a novel architecture for performance management, a clever framework for 5 G and 6 G network-based healthcare apps, which, in order to overcome these difficulties, dynamically satisfies the demanding requirements of smart health applications. The core of this architecture is the utilisation of network slicing technologies, which are critical to realising the full potential of 5 G and 6 G networks. Unlike previous approaches, the smart framework for healthcare applications in 5G/6G networks automatically adapts to the unique requirements of smart health applications, taking into consideration the diversity of devices and services. Results from mininet-WiFi simulated environments demonstrate that this architecture may be used in virtualized settings to meet the performance needs of s-health applications.

articleTitle: A Development of Personalized Content Creation Technology Model using NLP and AI Integrated System
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Advance Computing and Innovative Technologies in Engineering (ICACITE)
abstract: With the recent advances in AI technologies, AIdriven Natural Language Generation (NLG) has emerged as one of the most powerful new technologies with a transformative potential across almost all domains, and that includes content generation and personalization. The work covered in this paper relates to the development of AI-driven NLG, the areas of application, and the impacts it brings in revolutionizing the way content is prepared in the process of content personalization. Digital content developments and their proliferation across channels with their infinite volume have necessitated finding scalable, efficient means of content generation. NLG systems are powered by AI and use machine learning algorithms combined with natural language processing techniques to provide for automatic generation of human-like text. Traditional methods of content creation generally require a lot of time and resources, as they are normally done in a manual way, from writing the content to its editing and proofreading. On the other hand, NLG systems are able to output content in bulk, allowing the everincreasing demand for new and exciting material to be met. Due to this sophistication in the systems, one can easily change their outputs and, therefore, it can be able to optimize the communication effectiveness for higher user engagement.

articleTitle: The Techniques used for EFC Networks to Get Increased Efficiency in High End Applications
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Advance Computing and Innovative Technologies in Engineering (ICACITE)
abstract: Enhancing energy efficiency in wireless networks is crucial in today’s context due to the increasing demand for higher capacities, better data rates, and improved quality of service in next-generation networks. This necessity drives the move toward energy-efficient architectures to reduce power consumption and decrease the carbon footprint, emphasizing the need for green communication strategies. To address these challenges, a comprehensive framework that integrates various techniques is essential for the development of energy-efficient 5G networks. Our proposed framework consists of three principal components:1.Energy-Efficient Architectures: Focuses on structuring network components and systems to minimize energy usage while maintaining or enhancing network performance.2.Energy-Efficient Resource Management: Involves the strategic allocation and management of network resources to optimize energy efficiency.3.Energy-Efficient Radio Technologies: Includes the adoption of innovative technologies such as Simultaneous Wireless Information and Power Transfer (SWIPT), Massive MIMO, D2D communication, and relay-based coverage enhancement to reduce energy consumption.Further, the framework explores specific strategies such as:– Optimizing cell size and integrating relay and cooperative communications to better manage network load and energy use.– Employing efficient resource allocation techniques to maximize the energy efficiency of the network operations.– Implementing linear precoding techniques and Minimum Mean Square Error (MMSE) detection schemes for downlink transmission, which are adapted to meet per-antenna power constraints and hybrid power constraints, making the system practically implementable

articleTitle: The Intersection of Blockchain and Real Estate: Opportunities, Challenges, and Future Prospects
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Advance Computing and Innovative Technologies in Engineering (ICACITE)
abstract: Blockchain technology is approaching the real estate market, and this turn of events is expected to be radical for the industry. This paper explores potential benefits, challenges, and visions of the future for the association between blockchain technology and real estate. The research starts by overviewing blockchain technology itself, its most critical features, and its practical application in many spheres. After this, the current state of the real estate market is analyzed. This investigation points to continuing difficulties and leftovers in terms of transactions and management, including low levels of trust and openness and the high costs associated with mediators. Finally, the research paper provides a list of potential applications of blockchain technology in the real estate industry. Some of the most remarkable examples are tokenization of possessions, extensive opportunity for ownership, applying smart contracts for automation of transactions, and ownership verification using blockchain. These technologies could increasingly alleviate the necessity for mediators and, as a result, boost morale and confidence among the stakeholders and become more transparent and efficient. Nevertheless, the paper also identifies factors and barriers that would hamper the spread of blockchain in real estate. Some of them are regulatory barriers and legal aspects, technical limitations, and shrug from properties and existing businesses. In the last part of the investigation, the paper outlines potential effects of blockchain on real estate over the next years. Some of them include formation of new business models, projected expansion and adoption, and implications of real estate investment and ownership. In conclusion, research provides a beneficial investigation and some recommendations for real estate market participants facing the same pros and cons of adopting blockchain technology.

articleTitle: A Systematic Investigating Of Differences Among Automation as well as Wage Distribution System using ML Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Advance Computing and Innovative Technologies in Engineering (ICACITE)
abstract: Technological changes have made automation an increasing fear for income equality. The paper will present an insightful view of the intricate relations between AI-based automation and wage distribution within an economy. Principally, it seeks to rationalize the channels through which automation impacts income distribution and to examine the policy remedies. The article sets the enormous growth of automation within a broader context of the technological revolution, looking precisely at the effects that AI is causing for other disciplines. The effects of the distribution of income are not very clear whether automation will have an effect on productivity and economic growth, despite it mostly increased the productivity in history. This is changing with AI on the horizon to be competent in dealing with complex cognitive tasks. Hence, this raising view brings up questions in regard to their implication on wage distribution along the skill spectrum, when automation is said to only affect and take away low-skilled labor. The aim of this article is to synthesize empirical evidence on AI-driven automation and its consequences for income inequality, based on an extensive literature review of existent papers. The paper examines how automation affects different labor market segments, whereby the study displacements of routine task-based jobs and creations of new job opportunities that demand complementary skills. The paper also explains how automation impacts workers’ bargaining power and the distribution of gains from trade between labor and capital.

articleTitle: The Various Technical Security to be Taken Into Considerations for Implementation of Artificial Intelligence in Various Applications
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Advance Computing and Innovative Technologies in Engineering (ICACITE)
abstract: As it rapidly develops, AI implementation reveals an extremely complex ethical dimension in the shift to society. Inasmuch as AI technologies now begin to invade spheres such as health, finance, education, or transportation, increasing relevance is brought to its consideration of development and deployment in an ethical way. Hence, the current paper attempts to get to the core of the issue concerning the role of ethical leadership in decisively dealing with the moral and social implications that arise from the implementation of AI. AI is bristling with potentials, promising to bring efficiency not just in the decision-making process but in productivity across domains. So in the midst of all these promises, AI poses quite a few ethical dilemmas and social problems. The ethical problems that are posed by the deployment of AI range from those concerning algorithmic fairness and privacy violation to even ethical problems concerning the exacerbation of socio-economic inequality and an erosion of human autonomy, which can be manifold and enormous. From this perspective, ethical leadership comes as a serious linchpin to pave a way forward in the ever-increasing ethical intricacies that are quite inherent in the times of AI. Such commitment to moral principle, transparency, and stakeholder involvement makes the ethical leader much better placed to help grapple with the ethical dimensions of AI technologies by organizations and policymakers. This is where the onus on the ethical leaders comes in reducing the risks of AI -induced harm and maximizing, through the creation of a culture of ethical awareness and accountability, the benefits that can be bestowed on society.

articleTitle: A Machine Learning Algorithm For Developing A Smart Health System
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Advance Computing and Innovative Technologies in Engineering (ICACITE)
abstract: The merging of revolutionary technologies like deep learning has greatly affected the healthcare sector, changing diagnosis and decision-making processes. This study tries to explore the role of neural networks in Digital Health research by examining 192 records drawn from the database used by Scopus. Employing a carefully made search term, the study tries to identify nations that excel in book output, primary research subjects, top funding backers, and common research terms in this domain. Notably, the debut paper on AI in smart health appeared in 2011, signalling the origins of a sizeable surge of academic output. India has emerged as the leader in performing study in this area, showing a remarkable growth trend. Furthermore, the research shows that Access from the IEEE is the top magazine, having the largest number of papers within this area. This extensive review serves as an important tool for scholars, policy makers, and healthcare workers, giving deep insights into the development of artificial intelligence in Smart Health study. The results show a positive trend, demonstrating that artificial intelligence in Connected Health is set for substantial increase in the future. The creativity and sincerity of this study highlight its importance in developing knowledge and defining the future environment of healthcare innovation.

articleTitle: Automated gear inspection using Image Processing and Machine Learning Techniques
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Advance Computing and Innovative Technologies in Engineering (ICACITE)
abstract: The creation of a robotic transmission inspection system that harnesses the power of image processing and artificial intelligence systems is presented in this report This system consists of components that have been developed to perform three tasks, which are the fault diagnosis, sorting, and wear evaluation of gear teeth. The automatic fault diagnosis module use image processing to find the problems like cracks, chips, and wear at the surface of gear teeth. The sorting module has an imaging system that analyzes the gear images and moves the gears further to their own subgroup with the use of a conveyor belt and a robotic arm. The inspection algorithm takes advantage of image processing and machine learning in the analytic tasks of assessing the surface texture and wear zones of gear teeth. The system consists of the modules without direct gear measurement, profile measurement as well as analysis of wear via the neural networks. Different types of gears are being tested using image processing and machine learning to assess their condition and establish the credibility of the system in detecting gear faults, sorting gears, and analyzing gear wear.

articleTitle: The Creation of Intelligent Surfaces for the Purpose of Next-Gen Wireless Networks
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Advance Computing and Innovative Technologies in Engineering (ICACITE)
abstract: In preparation of the changing environment of 5th wave (5G) and prospective networks of cells, this study explores new methods to meet challenges that result from the erratic character of the communication medium. Traditionally viewed as a chance factor, the relationship between broadcast radio waves with surrounding factors lowers signal quality in modern times of wireless communications. This paper performs a full literature review on customizable autonomous surfaces (RISs) alongside their uses, stressing the chance for network managers to control radio wave features and minimize environmental spread problems. RISs allow effective control over waveform parameters, including the amplitude, phase, number, and polarization, that without needing complex encoder, decoder, or radio wave processing methods. Leveraging technical developments, metasurfaces, reflectarrays, phase shifts, and liquid crystals appear as potential options for RIS application, placing them as pioneers in the realization of 5G as well as subsequent networks. The study dives into current actions in the RIS-operated mobile phone network area and covers core research issues that deserve exploration to feed unlocking the full promise of RISs at wireless communication networks.

articleTitle: A Layout of Bridging Learning Process to fill the Gaps Through AI to make the Technical Education for Better Access
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Advance Computing and Innovative Technologies in Engineering (ICACITE)
abstract: Today, it is inclusive of one of the cornerstones in the realization of equal access and potential. However, despite great progress, primary learning opportunities still show great disparities, especially in communities all over the world that remain underserved.
